# stripe

## STRIPE_ACCEPT_QUOTE
Tool to accept a quote in Stripe. Use when you need to accept a finalized quote, which will create an invoice, subscription, or subscription schedule based on the quote's configuration.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AcceptQuoteRequest",
  "required": [
    "quote_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "quote_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Quote Id",
      "examples": [
        "qt_1ShVsZQvM72TjFrblaAdWSKO"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the quote to accept. Must start with 'qt_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for accepting a quote."
}
```

## STRIPE_ACTIVATE_BILLING_ALERT
Reactivates a billing alert, allowing it to trigger again. Use when you need to resume monitoring usage thresholds and receiving notifications for a previously deactivated alert.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ActivateBillingAlertRequest",
  "required": [
    "alert_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "alert_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Alert Id",
      "examples": [
        "alrt_test_61TqtjUCspxvN2BLE41QvM72TjFrb7oW"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the billing alert to reactivate (e.g., 'alrt_12345')."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for activating a billing alert."
}
```

## STRIPE_ADD_INVOICE_LINES
Tool to add multiple line items to a draft Stripe invoice. Use when you need to add additional charges, services, or credits to an existing invoice that is still in draft status.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddInvoiceLinesRequest",
  "required": [
    "id",
    "lines"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "in_1ShW0rQvM72TjFrbwFesEshn"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the invoice to add lines to. Invoice must be in draft status."
    },
    "lines": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "LineItem",
        "properties": {
          "amount": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Amount",
            "examples": [
              2500,
              -500
            ],
            "description": "Cost in cents (or smallest currency unit). Accepts negative values for credits."
          },
          "period": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "LineItemPeriod",
            "required": [
              "start",
              "end"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "end": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "End",
                "examples": [
                  1675209600
                ],
                "description": "Period end timestamp (Unix timestamp in seconds)."
              },
              "start": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Start",
                "examples": [
                  1672531200
                ],
                "description": "Period start timestamp (Unix timestamp in seconds)."
              }
            },
            "description": "Time period for revenue recognition.",
            "additionalProperties": false
          },
          "pricing": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Pricing",
            "required": [
              "price"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "price": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Price",
                "examples": [
                  "price_123ABC"
                ],
                "description": "ID of the price to use for this line item."
              }
            },
            "description": "Price ID reference.",
            "additionalProperties": false
          },
          "metadata": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Metadata",
            "examples": [
              {
                "order_id": "ORD-123",
                "department": "sales"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Set of key-value pairs for custom storage.",
            "additionalProperties": {
              "type": "string"
            }
          },
          "quantity": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Quantity",
            "examples": [
              1,
              5,
              10
            ],
            "description": "Non-negative unit count for this line item."
          },
          "discounts": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "title": "LineItemDiscount",
              "properties": {
                "coupon": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Coupon",
                  "examples": [
                    "SUMMER25OFF"
                  ],
                  "description": "ID of coupon to apply to this line item."
                },
                "discount": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Discount",
                  "examples": [
                    "di_1J2x3y4z5A6b7c8d"
                  ],
                  "description": "ID of existing discount to apply to this line item."
                },
                "promotion_code": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Promotion Code",
                  "examples": [
                    "promo_123ABC"
                  ],
                  "description": "ID of promotion code to apply to this line item."
                }
              },
              "description": "Discount to apply to the line item."
            },
            "title": "Discounts",
            "description": "Coupons, promotion codes, or existing discounts to apply to this line item."
          },
          "tax_rates": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "title": "Tax Rates",
            "examples": [
              [
                "txr_123ABC",
                "txr_456DEF"
              ]
            ],
            "description": "IDs of tax rates to apply to this line item."
          },
          "price_data": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "PriceData",
            "required": [
              "currency"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "product": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Product",
                "examples": [
                  "prod_123ABC"
                ],
                "description": "ID of product this price will belong to. Required if product_data is not provided."
              },
              "currency": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Currency",
                "examples": [
                  "usd",
                  "eur",
                  "gbp"
                ],
                "description": "Three-letter ISO currency code in lowercase."
              },
              "unit_amount": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Unit Amount",
                "examples": [
                  2500,
                  1000
                ],
                "description": "Price in cents (or smallest currency unit). Required if unit_amount_decimal is not provided."
              },
              "unit_amount_decimal": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Unit Amount Decimal",
                "examples": [
                  "25.50",
                  "10.99"
                ],
                "description": "Precise price amount as a decimal string. Required if unit_amount is not provided."
              }
            },
            "description": "Inline price creation parameters.",
            "additionalProperties": false
          },
          "description": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Description",
            "examples": [
              "Additional service charge",
              "Consulting fee"
            ],
            "description": "Text label for tracking purposes, displayed on the invoice."
          },
          "discountable": {
            "type": "boolean",
            "title": "Discountable",
            "examples": [
              true,
              false
            ],
            "description": "Whether discounts apply to this line item. Defaults based on line type if not specified."
          },
          "invoice_item": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Invoice Item",
            "examples": [
              "ii_123ABC"
            ],
            "description": "ID of existing unassigned invoice item to add to this invoice."
          }
        },
        "description": "Line item to add to the invoice."
      },
      "title": "Lines",
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "Multiple line items to attach to the invoice. At least one line item is required."
    },
    "invoice_metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Invoice Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "batch_id": "batch_123",
          "updated_by": "system"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs to attach to the invoice itself.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to add multiple line items to an invoice."
}
```

## STRIPE_ADVANCE_TEST_CLOCK
Advance a test clock to a future timestamp. Use for testing time-based billing scenarios. Requires test mode API keys (test_helpers endpoints are only available in test mode). The advancement is asynchronous; monitor the status field to track completion (status changes from 'advancing' to 'ready').

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AdvanceTestClockRequest",
  "required": [
    "clock_id",
    "frozen_time"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "clock_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Clock Id",
      "examples": [
        "clock_1ShVujQvM72TjFrbk2ukwczY",
        "clock_1Mr3I22eZvKYlo2Ck0rgMqd7"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the test clock to advance (format: clock_*). Obtain this from creating a test clock or listing existing test clocks."
    },
    "frozen_time": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Frozen Time",
      "examples": [
        1700086400,
        1735689600
      ],
      "description": "Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) to advance the clock to. Must be greater than the clock's current frozen_time. Maximum advance: 2 subscription intervals ahead, or 2 years if no subscriptions."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for advancing a test clock."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "StatusDetails": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "StatusDetails",
      "properties": {
        "advancing": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Advancing",
          "required": [
            "target_frozen_time"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "target_frozen_time": {
              "type": "integer",
              "title": "Target Frozen Time",
              "description": "The frozen_time that the test clock is advancing towards."
            }
          },
          "description": "Details present when status is advancing."
        }
      },
      "description": "State details of the test clock."
```

## STRIPE_APPLY_CUSTOMER_BALANCE
Manually reconciles remaining amount for a customer_balance PaymentIntent by applying funds from customer's cash balance. IMPORTANT: This action only works with PaymentIntents that have 'customer_balance' in their payment_method_types. The customer_balance payment method type must be enabled in your Stripe account settings. Use this when you need to apply funds from a customer's cash balance account to complete or partially fund a PaymentIntent.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ApplyCustomerBalanceRequest",
  "required": [
    "intent"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "amount": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Amount",
      "examples": [
        1000,
        5000
      ],
      "description": "Amount intended to apply to this PaymentIntent from the customer's cash balance. A positive integer representing how much to charge in the smallest currency unit (e.g., 100 cents to charge $1.00 USD, or 100 to charge \u00a5100 JPY for zero-decimal currencies). The maximum amount is the amount of the PaymentIntent. When omitted, defaults to the remaining amount requested on the PaymentIntent."
    },
    "intent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Intent",
      "examples": [
        "pi_3ShVtrQvM72TjFrb01sJOj4A"
      ],
      "description": "The PaymentIntent identifier. Must be a PaymentIntent that uses 'customer_balance' as a payment method type."
    },
    "currency": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Currency",
      "examples": [
        "usd",
        "eur",
        "gbp"
      ],
      "description": "Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase. Must be a supported currency."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for applying customer balance to a PaymentIntent."
}
```

## STRIPE_ARCHIVE_BILLING_ALERT
Tool to archive a billing alert in Stripe, removing it from list views and APIs. Use when you need to permanently archive a billing alert. This action is non-reversible.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ArchiveBillingAlertRequest",
  "required": [
    "alert_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "alert_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Alert Id",
      "examples": [
        "alrt_1234567890abcdefghijklmn"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the billing alert to archive."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_ATTACH_CUSTOMER_SOURCE
Attach a payment source (card token or source object) to a customer for future charges. IMPORTANT: This is a legacy API. For new integrations, use the PaymentMethods API instead (STRIPE_ATTACH_PAYMENT_METHOD). The source parameter accepts: - Card tokens (tok_xxxx) created client-side via Stripe.js or mobile SDKs - Source objects (src_xxxx) for alternative payment methods NOTE: PaymentMethod objects (pm_xxxx) cannot be used with this endpoint. Use STRIPE_ATTACH_PAYMENT_METHOD for those. In test mode, you can use test tokens like 'tok_visa'. In live mode, tokens must be created client-side for PCI compliance.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AttachCustomerSourceRequest",
  "required": [
    "customer_id",
    "source"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "source": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Source",
      "examples": [
        "tok_visa",
        "src_18eYalAHEMiOZZp1l9ZTjSU0",
        "tok_mastercard"
      ],
      "description": "The source to attach. Can be a card token ID (tok_xxx) or source object ID (src_xxx). In test mode, you can use 'tok_visa' or 'tok_mastercard'. In live mode, tokens must be created client-side using Stripe.js, Elements, or mobile SDKs. Note: Cannot use PaymentMethod IDs (pm_xxx) - use STRIPE_ATTACH_PAYMENT_METHOD for those."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "order_id": "12345",
          "customer_note": "VIP customer"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "customer_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer Id",
      "examples": [
        "cus_TepgbPtsfXMJ9A",
        "cus_9s6XKzkNRiz8i3"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the Stripe customer to attach the source to."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_ATTACH_INVOICE_PAYMENT
Attaches a PaymentIntent or Out of Band Payment to an invoice's payments list. When the PaymentIntent status changes to succeeded, the payment is credited to the invoice. Use when you need to associate an existing payment with a specific invoice.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AttachInvoicePaymentRequest",
  "required": [
    "invoice"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "invoice": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Invoice",
      "examples": [
        "in_1Nj68C2eZvKYlo2CGmFJak8q",
        "in_1ShVoKQvM72TjFrbRUjmO62j"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the invoice to attach the payment to."
    },
    "payment_intent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Intent",
      "examples": [
        "pi_3ShVqyQvM72TjFrb0En17IPQ",
        "pi_1234567890abcdefghij"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the PaymentIntent to attach to the invoice. Must be a PaymentIntent that can be attached to the invoice. Either payment_intent or payment_record must be provided, but not both."
    },
    "payment_record": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Record",
      "examples": [
        "pyr_1234567890abcdefghij"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the PaymentRecord to attach to the invoice. This is used for Out of Band payments. Either payment_intent or payment_record must be provided, but not both."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for attaching a PaymentIntent or Out of Band Payment to an invoice.\n\nNOTE: Either payment_intent or payment_record must be provided, but not both."
}
```

```json
  "required": [
    "data",

  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "id",
        "object",
        "amount_due",
        "amount_paid",
        "amount_overpaid",
        "amount_remaining",
        "amount_shipping",
        "attempt_count",

        "period_start",
        "post_payment_credit_notes_amount",
        "pre_payment_credit_notes_amount",
        "starting_balance",
        "status_transitions",
        "subtotal",
        "total"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Id",
          "description": "Unique identifier for the invoice object"
        },
        "lines": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Lines",
          "required": [
            "object",
            "data",
            "has_more",
            "url"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "url": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Url",
              "description": "List access URL"
            },
            "data": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "object",
                "title": "LineItem",
                "required": [
                  "id",
                  "object",
                  "amount",
                  "currency",
                  "discountable",
                  "discounts",
                  "livemode",
                  "metadata",
                  "period"
                ],
                "properties": {
                  "id": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Id",
                    "description": "Unique line item identifier"
                  },
                  "amount": {
                    "type": "integer",
                    "title": "Amount",
                    "description": "Amount in cents"
                  },
                  "object": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Object",
                    "description": "Always 'line_item'"
                  },
                  "period": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "title": "Period",
                    "required": [
                      "end",
                      "start"
                    ],
                    "properties": {
                      "end": {
                        "type": "integer",
                        "title": "End",
                        "description": "Period end (inclusive)"
                      },
                      "start": {
                        "type": "integer",
                        "title": "Start",
                        "description": "Period start (inclusive)"
                      }
                    },
                    "description": "Time period covered"
                  },
                  "invoice": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Invoice",
                    "description": "Invoice ID containing item"
                  },
                  "currency": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Currency",
                    "description": "Three-letter ISO currency code"
```

## STRIPE_ATTACH_PAYMENT_METHOD
Attaches a PaymentMethod to a Customer. Use when you need to save a payment method for future use with a specific customer. The PaymentMethod must be in a detached state before attaching.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AttachPaymentMethodRequest",
  "required": [
    "payment_method_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_1234567890abcdef",
        "cus_TepCTQwMu8SvQH"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the customer to which to attach the PaymentMethod. Either customer or customer_account must be provided."
    },
    "customer_account": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer Account",
      "examples": [
        "acct_1234567890abcdef"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the Account representing the customer to which to attach the PaymentMethod. Either customer or customer_account must be provided."
    },
    "payment_method_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Method Id",
      "examples": [
        "pm_1234567890abcdef",
        "pm_card_visa"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the PaymentMethod to attach to the customer. The PaymentMethod must be in a detached state."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_ATTACH_PRODUCT_FEATURE
Tool to attach a feature to a product. Use when you need to add a feature to a product's capabilities. This creates a product_feature object linking the feature to the product.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AttachProductFeatureRequest",
  "required": [
    "product_id",
    "entitlement_feature"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "product_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Product Id",
      "examples": [
        "prod_NWjs8kKbJWmuuc",
        "prod_TydxPQvePHEptg"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the product to attach the feature to. Product IDs typically start with 'prod_'."
    },
    "entitlement_feature": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Entitlement Feature",
      "examples": [
        "feat_61UAiKJTgy3SzdVoN41P3BKO35fWyWFE",
        "feat_test_61QGU1MWyFMSP9YBZ41ClCIKljWvsTgu"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the Feature object to attach to this product. Feature IDs typically start with 'feat_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for attaching a feature to a product."
}
```

## STRIPE_CANCEL_PAYMENT_INTENT
Cancels a PaymentIntent when in cancelable state. Use when a PaymentIntent is no longer needed to prevent further charges. For PaymentIntents with status='requires_capture', the remaining amount_capturable will be automatically refunded.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CancelPaymentIntentRequest",
  "required": [
    "payment_intent_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "payment_intent_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Intent Id",
      "examples": [
        "pi_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the PaymentIntent to cancel."
    },
    "cancellation_reason": {
      "enum": [
        "duplicate",
        "fraudulent",
        "requested_by_customer",
        "abandoned"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cancellation Reason",
      "examples": [
        "duplicate",
        "requested_by_customer"
      ],
      "description": "Reason for canceling this PaymentIntent. Must be one of: 'duplicate', 'fraudulent', 'requested_by_customer', or 'abandoned'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for canceling a PaymentIntent."
}
```

## STRIPE_CANCEL_QUOTE
Tool to cancel a Stripe quote. Use when you need to cancel an existing quote that is in 'draft' or 'open' status. Once canceled, the quote cannot be finalized or accepted by the customer.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CancelQuoteRequest",
  "required": [
    "quote_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "quote_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Quote Id",
      "examples": [
        "qt_1ShVs9QvM72TjFrbNJwlOGdN"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the quote to cancel. Starts with 'qt_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for canceling a Stripe quote."
}
```

## STRIPE_CANCEL_SETUP_INTENT
Cancels a SetupIntent that is no longer needed. Use when a SetupIntent is in 'requires_payment_method', 'requires_confirmation', or 'requires_action' state. Note: SetupIntents linked to Checkout Sessions cannot be canceled through this method.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CancelSetupIntentRequest",
  "required": [
    "setup_intent_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "setup_intent_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Setup Intent Id",
      "examples": [
        "seti_1ShVXSQvM72TjFrbhydZ16hv"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the SetupIntent to cancel."
    },
    "cancellation_reason": {
      "enum": [
        "abandoned",
        "requested_by_customer",
        "duplicate"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cancellation Reason",
      "examples": [
        "abandoned",
        "requested_by_customer"
      ],
      "description": "Reason for cancellation. Must be one of: 'abandoned', 'requested_by_customer', or 'duplicate'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for canceling a SetupIntent."
}
```

## STRIPE_CANCEL_SUBSCRIPTION
Cancels a customer's active Stripe subscription at the end of the current billing period, with options to invoice immediately for metered usage and prorate charges for unused time.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CancelSubscriptionRequest",
  "required": [
    "subscription_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "prorate": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Prorate",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, generates a proration invoice item for unused time remaining in the current billing cycle."
    },
    "invoice_now": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Invoice Now",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, generates a final invoice for any un-invoiced metered usage."
    },
    "subscription_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subscription Id",
      "examples": [
        "sub_1OXR5YLkZnJ0gJgX8XjYq7Z7"
      ],
      "description": "Identifier of the subscription to cancel."
    },
    "cancellation_details": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Cancellation Details",
      "description": "Specifies reasons for cancellation. Common keys: 'comment' (free-form text) and 'feedback' (e.g., 'customer_service', 'low_usage', 'switched_service'). Example: {'comment': 'Switching services.', 'feedback': 'switched_service'}",
      "additionalProperties": true
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_CANCEL_SUBSCRIPTION_SCHEDULE
Cancels a subscription schedule and its associated subscription immediately (if active). Use when you need to stop scheduling of phases while leaving any existing subscription in place. Only succeeds if the schedule status is 'not_started' or 'active'.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CancelSubscriptionScheduleRequest",
  "required": [
    "schedule"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "prorate": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Prorate",
      "description": "If the subscription schedule is 'active', indicates if the cancellation should be prorated. Defaults to true if not specified."
    },
    "schedule": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Schedule",
      "examples": [
        "sub_sched_1ShVtXQvM72TjFrb7RpCRXdE",
        "sub_sched_1Mr3owLkdIwHu7ix38CXMudt"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier for the subscription schedule to cancel (e.g., sub_sched_1Mr3owLkdIwHu7ix38CXMudt)"
    },
    "invoice_now": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Invoice Now",
      "description": "If the subscription schedule is 'active', indicates if a final invoice will be generated that contains any un-invoiced metered usage and new/pending proration invoice items. Defaults to true if not specified."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for canceling a subscription schedule."
}
```

## STRIPE_CANCEL_TERMINAL_READER_ACTION
Tool to cancel the current reader action. Use when you need to halt any ongoing operation on a Stripe Terminal reader device such as payment collection, setup intent processing, or input collection.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostTerminalReadersCancelActionSetReaderDisplayRequest",
  "required": [
    "reader_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "reader_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reader Id",
      "examples": [
        "tmr_FDOt2wlRZEdpd7",
        "tmr_GUdgOws6gw46M7"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the Reader to cancel the action on. Must start with 'tmr_' followed by alphanumeric characters."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for canceling a terminal reader action."
}
```

## STRIPE_CAPTURE_CHARGE
Tool to capture payment on an uncaptured charge. Use when a charge was created with capture=false and you're ready to capture the payment.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CaptureChargeRequest",
  "required": [
    "charge"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "amount": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Amount",
      "examples": [
        1000
      ],
      "description": "The amount to capture in cents (or smallest currency unit). If not specified, the full amount is captured. Cannot exceed the original, uncaptured amount of the charge."
    },
    "charge": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Charge",
      "examples": [
        "ch_3ShVn2QvM72TjFrb0VmUaQFY"
      ],
      "description": "The identifier of the charge to be captured. Typically starts with 'ch_'."
    },
    "receipt_email": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Receipt Email",
      "examples": [
        "customer@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "The email address to send the receipt to. Overrides the charge's receipt_email. Maximum 800 characters. Receipts are not sent in test mode."
    },
    "transfer_group": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Transfer Group",
      "examples": [
        "group_12345"
      ],
      "description": "Transaction group identifier. May only be provided if not previously set."
    },
    "statement_descriptor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Statement Descriptor",
      "examples": [
        "Order #1234"
      ],
      "description": "Statement descriptor text for non-card charges with 22-character limit. For card charges, ignored if statement_descriptor_suffix is provided."
    },
    "transfer_data_amount": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Transfer Data Amount",
      "examples": [
        1000
      ],
      "description": "The amount to transfer to the destination account without creating an Application Fee object. Must be used with Stripe Connect."
    },
    "application_fee_amount": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Application Fee Amount",
      "examples": [
        100
      ],
      "description": "An application fee amount to add to this charge, not exceeding the original amount."
    },
    "statement_descriptor_suffix": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Statement Descriptor Suffix",
      "examples": [
        "Order 1234"
      ],
      "description": "Suffix concatenated to account's statement descriptor prefix for card charges."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for capturing a charge."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "Refund": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Refund",
      "required": [
        "id",
        "object",
        "amount",
        "created",
        "currency"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Id",
          "description": "Unique identifier for the object."
        },
        "amount": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Amount",
          "description": "Amount, in cents (or other smallest currency unit)."
        },
        "charge": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Charge",
          "description": "ID of the charge that was refunded."
        },
        "object": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Object",
          "description": "String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value."
        },
        "reason": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Reason",
          "description": "Reason for the refund, either user-provided or generated automatically."
        },
        "status": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Status",
          "description": "Status of the refund."
        },
        "created": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Created",
          "description": "Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch."
        },
        "currency": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Currency",
          "description": "Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase."
        },
        "metadata": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Metadata",
          "description": "Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object.",
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "receipt_number": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Receipt Number",
          "description": "This is the transaction number that appears on email receipts sent for this refund."
        },
        "balance_transaction": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Balance Transaction",
          "description": "Balance transaction that describes the impact on your account balance."
        }
      },
      "description": "Refund object details."
    },
    "Wallet": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Wallet",
      "required": [
        "type"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Type",
          "description": "The type of the card wallet, one of amex_express_checkout, apple_pay, google_pay, masterpass, samsung_pay, or visa_checkout."
        },
        "dynamic_last4": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Dynamic Last4",
          "description": "(For tokenized numbers only.) The last four digits of the device account number."
        }
      },
      "description": "Card wallet details."
    },
    "Address": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Address",
      "properties": {
        "city": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "City",
          "description": "City, district, suburb, town, or village."
        },
        "line1": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Line1",
          "description": "Address line 1 (e.g., street, PO Box, or company name)."
        },
        "line2": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Line2",
          "description": "Address line 2 (e.g., apartment, suite, unit, or building)."
        },
        "state": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "State",
          "description": "State, county, province, or region."
        },
        "country": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Country",
          "description": "Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)."
        },
        "postal_code": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Postal Code",
          "description": "ZIP or postal code."
        }
      },
      "description": "Address information."
    },
    "Outcome": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Outcome",
      "properties": {
        "rule": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Rule",
          "description": "The ID of the Radar rule that matched the payment, if applicable."
        },
        "type": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Type",
          "description": "Possible values are authorized, manual_review, issuer_declined, blocked, and invalid."
        },
        "reason": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Reason",
          "description": "An enumerated value providing a more detailed explanation of the outcome's type."
        },
        "risk_level": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Risk Level",
          "description": "Stripe Radar's evaluation of the riskiness of the payment. Possible values for evaluated payments are normal, elevated, highest."
        },
        "risk_score": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Risk Score",
          "description": "Stripe Radar's evaluation of the riskiness of the payment. Possible values are between 0 and 100."
        },
        "network_status": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Network Status",
          "description": "Possible values are approved_by_network, declined_by_network, not_sent_to_network, and reversed_after_approval."
        },
        "seller_message": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Seller Message",
          "description": "A human-readable description of the outcome type and reason, designed for you (the recipient of the payment), not your customer."
        }
      },
      "description": "Details about whether the payment was accepted, and why."
    },
    "Shipping": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Shipping",
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "description": "Recipient name."
        },
        "phone": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Phone",
          "description": "Recipient phone (including extension)."
        },
        "address": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Address",
          "properties": {
            "city": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "City",
              "description": "City, district, suburb, town, or village."
            },
            "line1": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Line1",
              "description": "Address line 1 (e.g., street, PO Box, or company name)."
            },
            "line2": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Line2",
              "description": "Address line 2 (e.g., apartment, suite, unit, or building)."
            },
            "state": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "State",
              "description": "State, county, province, or region."
            },
            "country": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Country",
              "description": "Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)."
            },
            "postal_code": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Postal Code",
              "description": "ZIP or postal code."
            }
          },
          "description": "Shipping address."
        },
        "carrier": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Carrier",
          "description": "The delivery service that shipped a physical product, such as Fedex, UPS, USPS, etc."
        },
        "tracking_number": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Tracking Number",
          "description": "The tracking number for a physical product, obtained from the delivery service."
        }
      },
      "description": "Shipping information for the charge."
    },
    "CardChecks": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "CardChecks",
      "properties": {
        "cvc_check": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Cvc Check",
          "description": "If a CVC was provided, results of the check: pass, fail, unavailable, or unchecked."
        },
        "address_line1_check": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Address Line1 Check",
          "description": "If a address line1 was provided, results of the check: pass, fail, unavailable, or unchecked."
        },
        "address_postal_code_check": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Address Postal Code Check",
          "description": "If a address postal code was provided, results of the check: pass, fail, unavailable, or unchecked."
        }
      },
      "description": "Check results by Card networks on Card address and CVC at time of payment."
    },
    "CardDetails": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "CardDetails",
      "properties": {
        "brand": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Brand",
          "description": "Card brand. Can be amex, diners, discover, eftpos_au, jcb, mastercard, unionpay, visa, or unknown."
        },
        "last4": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Last4",
          "description": "The last four digits of the card."
        },
        "checks": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Checks",
          "properties": {
            "cvc_check": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Cvc Check",
              "description": "If a CVC was provided, results of the check: pass, fail, unavailable, or unchecked."
            },
            "address_line1_check": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Address Line1 Check",
              "description": "If a address line1 was provided, results of the check: pass, fail, unavailable, or unchecked."
            },
            "address_postal_code_check": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Address Postal Code Check",
              "description": "If a address postal code was provided, results of the check: pass, fail, unavailable, or unchecked."
            }
          },
          "description": "Check results by Card networks on Card address and CVC at time of payment."
        },
        "wallet": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Wallet",
          "required": [
            "type"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "type": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Type",
              "description": "The type of the card wallet, one of amex_express_checkout, apple_pay, google_pay, masterpass, samsung_pay, or visa_checkout."
            },
            "dynamic_last4": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Dynamic Last4",
              "description": "(For tokenized numbers only.) The last four digits of the device account number."
            }
          },
          "description": "If this Card is part of a card wallet, this contains the details of the card wallet."
        },
        "country": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Country",
          "description": "Two-letter ISO code representing the country of the card."
        },
        "funding": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Funding",
          "description": "Card funding type. Can be credit, debit, prepaid, or unknown."
        },
        "mandate": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Mandate",
          "description": "ID of the mandate used to make this payment."
        },
        "network": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Network",
          "description": "Identifies which network this charge was processed on."
        },
        "exp_year": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Exp Year",
          "description": "Four-digit number representing the card's expiration year."
        },
        "exp_month": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Exp Month",
          "description": "Two-digit number representing the card's expiration month."
        },
        "fingerprint": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Fingerprint",
          "description": "Uniquely identifies this particular card number."
        },
        "installments": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Installments",
          "description": "Installment details for this payment (Mexico only).",
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "three_d_secure": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Three D Secure",
          "properties": {
            "result": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Result",
              "description": "Indicates the outcome of 3D Secure authentication."
            },
            "version": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Version",
              "description": "The version of 3D Secure that was used."
            },
            "result_reason": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Result Reason",
              "description": "Additional information about why 3D Secure succeeded or failed based on the result."
            },
            "transaction_id": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Transaction Id",
              "description": "The 3D Secure 1 XID or 3D Secure 2 Directory Server Transaction ID (dsTransId) for this payment."
            },
            "authentication_flow": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Authentication Flow",
              "description": "How the customer was authenticated by the issuing bank."
            },
            "electronic_commerce_indicator": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Electronic Commerce Indicator",
              "description": "The electronic commerce indicator (ECI)."
            }
          },
          "description": "For authenticated transactions: how the customer was authenticated by the issuing bank."
        },
        "amount_authorized": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Amount Authorized",
          "description": "The authorized amount."
        },
        "network_transaction_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Network Transaction Id",
          "description": "Populated if this transaction used 3D Secure authentication."
        }
      },
      "description": "Details for card payments."
    },
    "RefundsList": {

      "properties": {
        "url": {

          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Refund",

              "id",
              "object",

              "created",
              "currency"

            "properties": {
              "id": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Id",

              "receipt_number": {

              "balance_transaction": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Balance Transaction",
                "description": "Balance transaction that describes the impact on your account balance."

            "description": "Refund object details."

          "description": "Array of refund objects."
        },
        "object": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Object",
          "description": "String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value. Always has the value list."
        },
        "has_more": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Has More",
          "description": "Whether or not there are more elements available after this set."
        }
```

## STRIPE_CAPTURE_PAYMENT_INTENT
Captures the funds of an existing uncaptured PaymentIntent. Use when the PaymentIntent status is 'requires_capture'.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CapturePaymentIntentRequest",
  "required": [
    "intent"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "intent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Intent",
      "examples": [
        "pi_3ShVqQQvM72TjFrb0oaKtzrK"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the PaymentIntent to capture."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "order_id": "12345"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs for storing additional structured data. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "final_capture": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Final Capture",
      "examples": [
        true
      ],
      "description": "Defaults to true. Set to false to retain uncaptured funds for future captures (requires multicapture support)."
    },
    "amount_to_capture": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Amount To Capture",
      "examples": [
        1000
      ],
      "description": "Amount to capture in smallest currency unit. Must be less than or equal to the original amount. Defaults to full amount_capturable if not provided."
    },
    "statement_descriptor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Statement Descriptor",
      "examples": [
        "MYSHOP ORDER"
      ],
      "maxLength": 22,
      "description": "Custom statement descriptor for non-card charges. Maximum 22 characters."
    },
    "application_fee_amount": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Application Fee Amount",
      "examples": [
        100
      ],
      "description": "Application fee to be transferred to the app owner's Stripe account. Cannot exceed the captured amount."
    },
    "statement_descriptor_suffix": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Statement Descriptor Suffix",
      "examples": [
        "JULY PROMO"
      ],
      "maxLength": 22,
      "description": "Suffix appended to the account's statement descriptor prefix for card charges. Maximum 22 characters."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for capturing a PaymentIntent."
}
```

## STRIPE_CLOSE_DISPUTE
Tool to close a dispute. Use when you want to dismiss a dispute and acknowledge it as lost, indicating no evidence will be submitted. This action is irreversible.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CloseDisputeRequest",
  "required": [
    "dispute"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "dispute": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Dispute",
      "examples": [
        "du_1ShRXCQvM72TjFrbDgp87FQx"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier for the dispute to close. Typically starts with 'du_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for closing a dispute."
}
```

## STRIPE_COLLECT_TERMINAL_READER_INPUTS
Initiates input collection on a Terminal Reader to display forms and collect customer information. Use when you need to gather email, phone, text, numeric, signature, or selection inputs from customers on a physical reader.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostTerminalReadersCollectInputsSetReaderDisplayRequest",
  "required": [
    "reader_id",
    "inputs"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "inputs": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "InputConfig",
        "required": [
          "type",
          "custom_text"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "type": {
            "enum": [
              "email",
              "numeric",
              "phone",
              "selection",
              "signature",
              "text"
            ],
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Type",
            "examples": [
              "email",
              "phone",
              "text"
            ],
            "description": "Type of input to collect. Must be one of: email, numeric, phone, selection, signature, or text."
          },
          "toggles": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "title": "Toggle",
              "required": [
```

## STRIPE_COLLECT_TERMINAL_READER_PAYMENT_METHOD
Tool to initiate payment method collection on a Stripe Terminal Reader. Use when you need to hand off a PaymentIntent to a physical card reader device to collect payment details. The Reader action executes asynchronously with action.status showing 'in_progress' initially.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CollectTerminalReaderPaymentMethodRequest",
  "required": [
    "reader",
    "payment_intent"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "reader": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reader",
      "examples": [
        "tmr_FDOt2wlRZEdpd7",
        "tmr_GUdgOws6gw46M7"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the Reader device."
    },
    "collect_config": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "CollectConfig",
      "properties": {
        "tipping": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "CollectConfigTipping",
          "properties": {
            "amount_eligible": {
              "type": "integer",
              "title": "Amount Eligible",
              "examples": [
                1000,
                5000
              ],
              "description": "Amount in smallest currency unit (cents) for calculating tip suggestions. Must be a positive integer."
            }
          },
          "description": "Tipping configuration settings.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "skip_tipping": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Skip Tipping",
          "description": "If true, prevents the tipping selection screen from displaying."
        },
        "allow_redisplay": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Allow Redisplay",
          "examples": [
            "always",
            "limited",
            "unspecified"
          ],
          "description": "Controls payment method visibility in checkout flows. Values: 'always', 'limited', or 'unspecified' (default)."
        },
        "enable_customer_cancellation": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Enable Customer Cancellation",
          "description": "If true, enables a cancel button on transaction screens allowing customers to cancel."
        }
      },
      "description": "Configuration overrides for payment collection behavior.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "payment_intent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Intent",
      "examples": [
        "pi_1NrpbFBHO5VeT9SUiCEDMdc8",
        "pi_3ShVuEQvM72TjFrb0rvMqzx3"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the PaymentIntent to collect a payment method for."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for collecting payment method on a Terminal reader."
}
```

## STRIPE_CONFIRM_PAYMENT_INTENT
Tool to confirm customer intent to pay with current or provided payment method. Use when ready to finalize a PaymentIntent and initiate the payment attempt. A return_url is required if confirmation needs customer action like 3D Secure authentication.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ConfirmPaymentIntentRequest",
  "required": [
    "payment_intent_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "mandate": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mandate",
      "examples": [
        "mandate_123"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the mandate to use for this payment."
    },
    "shipping": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Shipping",
      "description": "Shipping information for this PaymentIntent.",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "return_url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Return Url",
      "examples": [
        "https://example.com/payment/complete"
      ],
      "description": "The URL to redirect your customer back to after they authenticate or cancel their payment. Required if confirmation requires customer action (e.g., 3D Secure)."
    },
    "off_session": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        {
          "enum": [
            "one_off",
            "recurring"
          ],
          "type": "string"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Off Session",
      "examples": [
        true,
        "recurring"
      ],
      "description": "Set to true to indicate customer is not in checkout flow, or use 'one_off' or 'recurring' for specific off-session types."
    },
    "capture_method": {
      "enum": [
        "automatic",
        "automatic_async",
        "manual"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Capture Method",
      "examples": [
        "automatic",
        "manual"
      ],
      "description": "Controls fund capture timing. Can be 'automatic', 'automatic_async' (default), or 'manual'."
    },
    "payment_method": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Method",
      "examples": [
        "pm_card_visa"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the PaymentMethod to attach to this PaymentIntent."
    },
    "use_stripe_sdk": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Use Stripe Sdk",
      "description": "Set to true when confirming client-side with Stripe.js or mobile SDKs."
    },
    "payment_intent_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Intent Id",
      "examples": [
        "pi_3ShVlaQvM72TjFrb0a5nNR9y"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the PaymentIntent to confirm."
    },
    "confirmation_token": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Confirmation Token",
      "examples": [
        "ctoken_123"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the ConfirmationToken to use for confirmation."
    },
    "setup_future_usage": {
      "enum": [
        "on_session",
        "off_session"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Setup Future Usage",
      "examples": [
        "on_session",
        "off_session"
      ],
      "description": "Indicates intent to reuse payment method. Use 'on_session' if customer is present, 'off_session' for future charges."
    },
    "payment_method_data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Payment Method Data",
      "description": "Hash to create new PaymentMethod with type-specific details. Must include 'type' field (e.g., 'card', 'acss_debit', etc.).",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "payment_method_options": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Payment Method Options",
      "description": "Payment method-specific configuration (e.g., card installments, 3D Secure, BNPL options).",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "error_on_requires_action": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Error On Requires Action",
      "description": "When true, fails payment if PaymentIntent transitions to 'requires_action'. Default is false."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for confirming a PaymentIntent."
}
```

## STRIPE_CONFIRM_SETUP_INTENT
Confirms a SetupIntent to complete customer payment method setup. Use when you need to finalize credential collection after creating a SetupIntent.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ConfirmSetupIntentRequest",
  "required": [
    "setup_intent_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "return_url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Return Url",
      "examples": [
        "https://example.com/return"
      ],
      "description": "URL to redirect customer after authentication. Required for redirect-based payment methods."
    },
    "payment_method": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Method",
      "examples": [
        "pm_card_visa"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the PaymentMethod to attach to this SetupIntent."
    },
    "use_stripe_sdk": {
      "type": "boolean",
```

## STRIPE_CONFIRM_TERMINAL_READER_PAYMENT_INTENT
Tool to confirm a PaymentIntent on a Terminal reader device. Use when you need to finalize a payment transaction on a card reader after the PaymentIntent has been collected on the reader hardware.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostTerminalReadersConfirmPaymentIntentSetReaderDisplayRequest",
  "required": [
    "reader_id",
    "payment_intent"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "reader_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reader Id",
      "examples": [
        "tmr_GUdgOws6gw46M7",
        "tmr_FDOt2wlRZEdpd7"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the Terminal reader. Must start with 'tmr_' followed by alphanumeric characters."
    },
    "confirm_config": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "ConfirmConfig",
      "properties": {
        "return_url": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Return Url",
          "examples": [
            "https://example.com/payment/complete"
          ],
          "description": "The URL to redirect your customer back to after they authenticate or cancel their payment, or a mobile app URI scheme."
        }
      },
      "description": "Optional configuration for confirming the payment intent.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "payment_intent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Intent",
      "examples": [
        "pi_3ShVw1QvM72TjFrb1wuiiSlE",
        "pi_1234567890abcdefghijklmn"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the PaymentIntent to be finalized on the reader."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for confirming a payment intent on a terminal reader."
}
```

## STRIPE_CREATE_ACCOUNTS_CAPABILITIES_CARD_PAYMENTS
Tool to create or update card payments capability for a Stripe Connect account. Use when you need to enable or disable card payment processing for a connected account.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateAccountsCapabilitiesCardPaymentsRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "acct_1RNcLmP3BKO35fWy",
        "acct_1Q11MrQvM72TjFrb"
      ],
      "description": "The account ID for which to enable card_payments capability. Typically starts with 'acct_'."
    },
    "requested": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Requested",
      "description": "To request the card_payments capability for an account, pass true. Pass false to remove this non-permanent capability that was previously requested."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for creating or updating card payments capability."
}
```

## STRIPE_CREATE_APPLE_PAY_DOMAIN
Tool to create an Apple Pay domain registration. Use when registering your domain with Apple Pay to accept Apple Pay payments on your website. Stripe handles the Apple merchant validation process.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateApplePayDomainRequest",
  "required": [
    "domain_name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "livemode"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded."
    },
    "domain_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Domain Name",
      "examples": [
        "example.com",
        "shop.example.com"
      ],
      "description": "The domain name to register for Apple Pay (e.g., 'example.com'). Must be a valid domain. Both top-level domains and subdomains need to be registered separately. Note that www is considered a subdomain."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for creating an Apple Pay domain."
}
```

## STRIPE_CREATE_APPS_SECRET
Tool to create a secret in the Stripe Secret Store. Use when you need to securely persist secrets for use by UI Extensions and app backends.

**Input schema:**

```json
  "type": "object",

  "required": [
    "name",
    "payload",
    "scope_type"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "test_secret_key",
        "api_key",
        "database_password"
      ],
      "description": "A name for the secret that's unique within the scope. This describes the secret's identifier within your application."
    },
    "payload": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payload",
      "examples": [
        "test_secret_value",
        "sk_test_123456"
      ],
      "description": "The plaintext secret value to be encrypted and stored. The encrypted secret value that gets stored securely."
    },
    "expires_at": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Expires At",
      "examples": [
        1735689600,
        1767225600
      ],
      "description": "Unix timestamp indicating when the secret should expire and become inaccessible. Enables automatic secret expiration for enhanced security."
    },
    "scope_type": {
      "enum": [
        "account",
        "user"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Scope Type",
      "examples": [
        "account",
        "user"
      ],
      "description": "The scope type - either 'account' (makes secrets accessible to all dashboard users and app backends) or 'user' (restricts access to one specific dashboard user plus the app backend)."
    },
    "scope_user": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Scope User",
      "examples": [
        "user_1234567890",
        "usr_abcdefghij"
      ],
      "description": "User ID - required when scope_type is 'user', omitted for 'account' type. The user whose secret to create."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_CREATE_BANK_ACCOUNT_TOKEN
Tool to create a single-use token representing bank account details. Use when you need to securely collect bank account information for ACH payments, direct debits, or adding a bank account to a customer or recipient.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateBankAccountTokenRequest",
  "required": [
    "bank_account"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_NffrFeUfNV2Hib"
      ],
      "description": "Create a token for the customer, which is owned by the application's account. Can only be used with an OAuth access token or Stripe-Account header."
    },
    "bank_account": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Bank Account",
      "required": [
        "account_number",
        "country"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "country": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Country",
          "examples": [
            "US",
            "CA",
            "GB"
          ],
          "description": "The country in which the bank account is located (two-letter ISO code)."
        },
        "currency": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Currency",
          "examples": [
            "usd",
            "cad",
            "gbp"
          ],
          "description": "The currency the bank account is in (three-letter ISO code). This must be a country/currency pairing that Stripe supports."
        },
        "account_type": {
          "enum": [
            "checking",
            "savings"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "AccountType",
          "description": "Type of bank account."
        },
        "account_number": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Account Number",
          "examples": [
            "9876543210"
          ],
          "description": "The account number for the bank account, in string form. Must be a checking account."
        },
        "routing_number": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Routing Number",
          "examples": [
            "110000000",
            "021000021"
          ],
          "description": "The routing number, sort code, or other country-appropriate institution number for the bank account. Required for US accounts."
        },
        "account_holder_name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Account Holder Name",
          "examples": [
            "John Smith",
            "Acme Corporation"
          ],
          "description": "The name of the person or business that owns the bank account."
        },
        "account_holder_type": {
          "enum": [
            "individual",
            "company"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "AccountHolderType",
          "description": "Type of entity that holds the bank account."
        }
      },
      "description": "The bank account this token will represent.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for creating a bank account token."
}
```

## STRIPE_CREATE_BILLING_ALERT
Tool to create a billing alert that monitors usage on a billing meter and triggers notifications when a specified threshold is crossed. Use when you need to set up usage-based billing alerts.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateBillingAlertRequest",
  "required": [
    "title",
    "alert_type",
    "usage_threshold"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Title",
      "examples": [
        "API Request Usage Alert",
        "Monthly Usage Threshold Alert"
      ],
      "description": "The title/name of the alert. Maximum 256 characters."
    },
    "alert_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "const": "usage_threshold",
      "title": "Alert Type",
      "description": "The type of alert to create. Currently only 'usage_threshold' is supported."
    },
    "usage_threshold": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Usage Threshold",
      "required": [
        "gte",
        "meter",
        "recurrence"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "gte": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Gte",
          "examples": [
            10000,
            50000,
            100000
          ],
          "description": "The threshold value that triggers the alert when usage meets or exceeds this amount."
        },
        "meter": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Meter",
          "examples": [
            "mtr_test_61TqteDNJ7lrm4G7B41QvM72TjFrbSZU",
            "mtr_abc123"
          ],
          "description": "The Billing Meter ID whose usage is monitored for this alert."
        },
        "filters": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "UsageThresholdFilter",
            "required": [
              "type",
              "customer"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "type": {
                "type": "string",
                "const": "customer",
                "title": "Type",
                "description": "The type of filter to apply. Currently only 'customer' is supported."
              },
              "customer": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Customer",
                "examples": [
                  "cus_abc123",
                  "cus_xyz789"
                ],
                "description": "Customer ID to limit the alert scope to a specific customer."
              }
            },
            "description": "Filter to limit alert scope to specific resources."
          },
          "title": "Filters",
          "description": "Limits the scope of the usage alert. Maximum of 1 filter allowed."
        },
        "recurrence": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "one_time",
          "title": "Recurrence",
          "description": "Defines when the alert fires. 'one_time' means the alert fires only once during the customer's lifetime."
        }
      },
      "description": "Configuration for usage threshold alerts that monitors a billing meter and triggers when the threshold is crossed.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for creating a billing alert."
}
```

## STRIPE_CREATE_BILLING_CREDIT_GRANT
Tool to create a credit grant that allocates billing credits to a customer for use against metered pricing. Use when you need to provide promotional or paid credits to customers.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateBillingCreditGrantRequest",
  "required": [
    "amount",
    "applicability_config"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Q1 2024 Promotional Credits",
        "Enterprise Plan Credits"
      ],
      "description": "Descriptive name for the credit grant displayed in the dashboard (max 100 characters)."
    },
    "amount": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Amount",
      "required": [
        "type",
        "monetary"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "monetary",
          "title": "Type",
          "description": "Type of amount; currently only 'monetary' is supported."
        },
        "monetary": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Monetary",
          "required": [
            "currency",
            "value"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "value": {
              "type": "integer",
              "title": "Value",
              "description": "Positive integer representing the credit amount in the currency's smallest unit."
            },
            "currency": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Currency",
              "description": "Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in lowercase (e.g., 'usd', 'eur')."
            }
          },
          "description": "Monetary amount details when type is 'monetary'.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      },
      "description": "Container for the credit grant amount configuration.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "category": {
      "enum": [
        "paid",
        "promotional"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Category",
      "description": "Classification of the credit grant. Use 'paid' for customer-purchased credits or 'promotional' for complimentary credits. Defaults to 'paid'."
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_TepSlaeMAtF2VJ",
        "cus_12345"
      ],
      "description": "Customer ID receiving the credits. Must provide either customer or customer_account."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "description": "Key-value pairs for storing additional structured data about the credit grant.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "priority": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Priority",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "Application priority (0=highest, 100=lowest). Controls the order in which credits are applied. Defaults to 50."
    },
    "expires_at": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Expires At",
      "examples": [
        1735689600
      ],
      "description": "Unix timestamp when credits expire. Credits never expire if omitted."
    },
    "effective_at": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Effective At",
      "examples": [
        1704067200
      ],
      "description": "Unix timestamp when credits become usable. Defaults to current time if not specified."
    },
    "customer_account": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer Account",
      "examples": [
        "acc_12345"
      ],
      "description": "Account ID representing the customer. Must provide either customer or customer_account."
    },
    "applicability_config": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Applicability Config",
      "required": [
        "scope"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "scope": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Scope",
          "properties": {
            "prices": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "title": "Prices",
              "description": "List of specific price IDs (metered prices only) this grant applies to. Cannot be combined with price_type or billable_items."
            },
            "price_type": {
              "type": "string",
              "const": "metered",
              "title": "Price Type",
              "description": "Use 'metered' to apply to all metered prices. Cannot be combined with billable_items or prices."
            },
            "billable_items": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "title": "Billable Items",
              "description": "List of metered billable item IDs this grant applies to. Cannot be combined with price_type or prices."
            }
          },
          "description": "Scope configuration defining where credits can be applied.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      },
      "description": "Defines what the credit grant applies to (metered pricing, specific prices, or billable items).",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for creating a billing credit grant."
}
```
