## STRIPE_CREATE_PAYMENT_METHOD_DOMAIN
Tool to create a payment method domain object to control where payment methods are shown. Use when registering a new web domain with Stripe to enable payment processing capabilities.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreatePaymentMethodDomainRequest",
  "required": [
    "domain_name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "enabled": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Enabled",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Whether this payment method domain is enabled. If the domain is not enabled, payment methods that require a payment method domain will not appear in Elements or Embedded Checkout. Defaults to true when not specified."
    },
    "domain_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Domain Name",
      "examples": [
        "example.com",
        "mystore.com"
      ],
      "description": "The domain name that this payment method domain object represents. This is the web domain you want to register with Stripe."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for creating a payment method domain."
}
```

## STRIPE_CREATE_PII_TOKEN
Tool to create a single-use token representing PII (personally identifiable information). Use when you need to securely tokenize sensitive personal information like ID numbers for compliance or security purposes.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreatePiiTokenRequest",
  "required": [
    "pii"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "pii": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Pii",
      "properties": {
        "id_number": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Id Number",
          "examples": [
            "000000000"
          ],
          "description": "The id_number for the PII, in string form."
        }
      },
      "description": "Container object for the PII information to tokenize.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for creating a PII token."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "CreatePiiTokenResponse": {
      "type": "object",

## STRIPE_CREATE_PLAN
Tool to create a recurring billing plan with flexible pricing configuration. Use when setting up subscription plans with defined pricing, currency, and billing intervals.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreatePlanRequest",
  "required": [
    "currency",
    "interval"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "description": "Custom plan identifier. Must be unique across account."
    },
    "meter": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Meter",
      "description": "Meter ID tracking metered price usage."
    },
    "tiers": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "PlanTier",
        "required": [
          "up_to"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "up_to": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "integer"
              },
              {
                "type": "string"
              }
            ],
            "title": "Up To",
            "examples": [
              100,
              "inf"
            ],
            "description": "Upper bound of this tier. Use 'inf' for the fallback tier (last tier)."
          },
          "flat_amount": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Flat Amount",
            "description": "Fixed billing amount for the entire tier regardless of units (in smallest currency unit). Cannot be used with unit_amount."
          },
          "unit_amount": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Unit Amount",
            "description": "Per-unit billing amount for the tier (in smallest currency unit). Cannot be used with flat_amount."
          },
          "flat_amount_decimal": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Flat Amount Decimal",
            "description": "Decimal alternative to flat_amount with up to 12 decimal places."
          },
          "unit_amount_decimal": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Unit Amount Decimal",
            "description": "Decimal alternative to unit_amount with up to 12 decimal places."
          }
        },
        "description": "Pricing tier for tiered billing."
      },
      "title": "Tiers",
      "description": "Pricing tiers. Required if billing_scheme is 'tiered'."
    },
    "active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Active",
      "description": "Whether the plan is available for new subscriptions. Defaults to true."
    },
    "amount": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Amount",
      "examples": [
        1000,
        2500
      ],
      "description": "A positive integer in cents (or 0 for a free plan) representing how much to charge. Required for standard billing unless using tiered billing."
    },
    "product": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "ProductInline",
          "required": [
            "name"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "name": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Name",
              "examples": [
                "Premium Plan",
                "Standard Subscription"
              ],
              "description": "The product's name, displayable to customers."
            },
            "active": {
              "anyOf": [
                {
                  "type": "boolean"
                },
                {
                  "type": "null"
                }
              ],
              "title": "Active",
              "default": null,
              "description": "Whether the product is available for purchase. Defaults to true."
            },
            "metadata": {
              "anyOf": [
                {
                  "type": "object",
                  "additionalProperties": {
                    "type": "string"
                  }
                },
                {
                  "type": "null"
                }
              ],
              "title": "Metadata",
              "default": null,
              "description": "Custom key-value pairs for storing additional product information."
            },
            "tax_code": {
              "anyOf": [
                {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                {
                  "type": "null"
                }
              ],
              "title": "Tax Code",
              "default": null,
              "description": "Tax classification identifier for the product."
            },
            "unit_label": {
              "anyOf": [
                {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                {
                  "type": "null"
                }
              ],
              "title": "Unit Label",
              "default": null,
              "examples": [
                "seat",
                "user",
                "GB"
              ],
              "description": "Label representing units of this product (max 12 characters)."
            },
            "statement_descriptor": {
              "anyOf": [
                {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                {
                  "type": "null"
                }
              ],
              "title": "Statement Descriptor",
              "default": null,
              "description": "Text displayed on customer's credit card statement (max 22 characters)."
            }
          },
          "description": "Product details when creating a plan with inline product data."
        }
      ],
      "title": "Product",
      "examples": [
        "prod_NFx123abc"
      ],
      "description": "Product ID (string) or inline product object containing product details. Required if amount is provided."
    },
    "currency": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Currency",
      "examples": [
        "usd",
        "eur",
        "gbp"
      ],
      "description": "Three-letter ISO currency code in lowercase. Must be a supported currency."
    },
    "interval": {
      "enum": [
        "day",
        "week",
        "month",
        "year"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Interval",
      "examples": [
        "month",
        "year"
      ],
      "description": "Billing frequency. Must be one of: day, week, month, or year."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "description": "Custom key-value pairs for storing additional information.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "nickname": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Nickname",
      "description": "Brief description of the plan, hidden from customers."
    },
    "tiers_mode": {
      "enum": [
        "graduated",
        "volume"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Tiers Mode",
      "examples": [
        "graduated",
        "volume"
      ],
      "description": "Tiering mode. Required if billing_scheme is 'tiered'. Either 'graduated' or 'volume'."
    },
    "usage_type": {
      "enum": [
        "licensed",
        "metered"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Usage Type",
      "examples": [
        "licensed",
        "metered"
      ],
      "description": "Usage billing mode. Either 'licensed' (default) or 'metered'."
    },
    "amount_decimal": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Amount Decimal",
      "description": "Decimal alternative to amount (max 12 decimal places). Mutually exclusive with amount."
    },
    "billing_scheme": {
      "enum": [
        "per_unit",
        "tiered"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Billing Scheme",
      "examples": [
        "per_unit",
        "tiered"
      ],
      "description": "Pricing computation method. Either 'per_unit' (default) or 'tiered'."
    },
    "interval_count": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Interval Count",
      "examples": [
        1,
        3,
        6
      ],
      "description": "Billing frequency multiplier. Maximum 3-year interval."
    },
    "transform_usage": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "TransformUsage",
      "required": [
        "divide_by",
        "round"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "round": {
          "enum": [
            "up",
            "down"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Round",
          "examples": [
            "up",
            "down"
          ],
          "description": "Rounding direction after division. Either 'up' or 'down'."
        },
        "divide_by": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Divide By",
          "description": "Divisor for usage transformation. Usage will be divided by this number."
        }
      },
      "description": "Usage transformation rules for the plan.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "trial_period_days": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Trial Period Days",
      "description": "Default trial duration in days for new subscriptions."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to create a Stripe plan with recurring billing configuration."
}

## STRIPE_CREATE_PREVIEW_INVOICE
Tool to preview an upcoming invoice without creating it. Use when you need to show pending charges, renewal fees, discounts, and prorations before finalizing an invoice.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreatePreviewInvoiceRequest",
  "properties": {
    "issuer": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Issuer",
      "required": [
        "type"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Type",
          "examples": [
            "account",
            "self"
          ],
          "description": "Type: account or self (required)"
        },
        "account": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Account",
          "description": "Connected account ID"
        }
      },
      "description": "Connected account issuing invoice.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "currency": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Currency",
      "examples": [
        "usd",
        "eur",
        "gbp"
      ],
      "description": "Three-letter ISO currency code (e.g., usd, eur)"
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_TepU77olhoBKbH"
      ],
      "description": "Customer ID for the invoice preview. Required when using invoice_items, subscription_details.items, or schedule_details.phases. You must also provide at least one of: subscription, subscription_details.items, schedule, schedule_details.phases, or invoice_items."
    },
    "schedule": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Schedule",
      "description": "Subscription schedule ID to preview"
    },

      "type": "array",

        "type": "object",
        "title": "InvoiceDiscount",
        "properties": {
          "coupon": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Coupon",
            "examples": [
              "SUMMER25OFF"
            ],
            "description": "The ID of an existing coupon to apply"
          },
          "discount": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Discount",
            "examples": [
              "di_1J2x3y4z5A6b7c8d"
            ],
            "description": "The ID of an existing discount to apply"
          },
          "promotion_code": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Promotion Code",
            "examples": [
              "PROMO123XYZ"
            ],
            "description": "The ID of an existing promotion code to apply"
          }
        },
        "description": "Discount to apply to the invoice preview."
      },
      "title": "Discounts",
      "description": "Discounts to apply to the invoice preview"
    },
    "on_behalf_of": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "On Behalf Of",
      "examples": [
        "acct_1J2x3y4z5A6b7c8d"
      ],
      "description": "Connected account ID for invoice presentation"
    },
    "preview_mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Preview Mode",
      "examples": [
        "next",
        "recurring"
      ],
      "description": "Preview mode: next (default) or recurring"
    },
    "subscription": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subscription",
      "examples": [
        "sub_1J2x3y4z5A6b7c8d"
      ],
      "description": "Subscription ID to preview"
    },
    "automatic_tax": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "AutomaticTax",
      "required": [
        "enabled"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "enabled": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Enabled",
          "examples": [
            true,
            false
          ],
          "description": "If true, Stripe automatically computes tax on this invoice"
        },
        "liability": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "AutomaticTaxLiability",
          "required": [
            "account"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "account": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Account",
              "examples": [
                "acct_12345ABCDEF"
              ],
              "description": "The ID of the Stripe account that is liable for tax"
            }
          },
          "description": "Stripe Connect account liable for tax.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      },
      "description": "Configuration for automatic tax calculation.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "invoice_items": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "InvoiceItem",
        "properties": {
          "price": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Price",
            "description": "Price ID"
          },
          "amount": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Amount",
            "description": "Amount in cents"
          },
          "period": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "InvoiceItemPeriod",
            "required": [
              "end",
              "start"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "end": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "End",
                "description": "Period end timestamp"
              },
              "start": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Start",
                "description": "Period start timestamp"
              }
            },
            "description": "Period for invoice item.",
            "additionalProperties": false

## STRIPE_CREATE_PRICE
Creates a new Stripe Price for a product, defining its charges (one-time or recurring) and billing scheme; requires either an existing `product` ID or `product_data`.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreatePriceRequest",
  "required": [
    "currency"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "tiers": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "Tier",
        "required": [
          "up_to"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "up_to": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "integer"
              },
              {
                "type": "string"
              }
            ],
            "title": "Up To",
            "examples": [
              100,
              "inf"
            ],
            "description": "Specifies the upper bound of this tier. Can be an integer or 'inf' for the last tier (fallback tier)."
          },
          "flat_amount": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Flat Amount",
            "description": "The flat billing amount for an entire tier (in the smallest currency unit), if any. Cannot be used with `unit_amount`."
          },
          "unit_amount": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Unit Amount",
            "description": "The per-unit billing amount in the smallest currency unit for this tier. Cannot be used with `flat_amount`."
          },
          "flat_amount_decimal": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Flat Amount Decimal",
            "description": "Same as `flat_amount`, but accepts a decimal string with up to 12 decimal places. Suitable for higher precision."
          },
          "unit_amount_decimal": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Unit Amount Decimal",
            "description": "Same as `unit_amount`, but accepts a decimal string with up to 12 decimal places. Suitable for higher precision."
          }
        },
        "description": "Represents a pricing tier for tiered billing (`billing_scheme = 'tiered'`)."
      },
      "title": "Tiers",
      "description": "A list of pricing tiers. Required if `billing_scheme` is 'tiered'."
    },
    "active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Active",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Whether the price can be used for new purchases. Defaults to true."
    },
    "product": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Product",
      "examples": [
        "prod_NFx123abc"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the product this price is for. Required if `product_data` is not provided."
    },
    "currency": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Currency",
      "examples": [
        "usd",
        "eur",
        "gbp"
      ],
      "description": "Three-letter ISO currency code (e.g., 'usd', 'eur'). Must be a supported currency."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "description": "A set of key-value pairs to store additional information about the price.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "nickname": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Nickname",
      "examples": [
        "Monthly Standard Plan",
        "Annual Premium Plan"
      ],
      "description": "A brief, internal-facing description of the price. Useful for distinguishing prices in listings."
    },
    "recurring": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Recurring",
      "required": [
        "interval"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "meter": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Meter",
          "description": "The ID of the meter from which to read usage when `usage_type=metered`. Required if `usage_type='metered'` and not using `product.meter`."
        },
        "interval": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Interval",
          "examples": [
            "day",
            "week",
            "month",
            "year"
          ],
          "description": "Specifies the billing frequency. Must be one of 'day', 'week', 'month', or 'year'."
        },
        "usage_type": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Usage Type",
          "examples": [
            "metered",
            "licensed"
          ],
          "description": "Configures how usage is calculated. Set to 'metered' to bill based on usage, or 'licensed' for a fixed quantity. Defaults to 'licensed'."
        },
        "interval_count": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Interval Count",
          "examples": [
            1,
            3,
            6
          ],
          "description": "The number of intervals between subscription billings. For example, `interval=month` and `interval_count=3` bills every 3 months. Defaults to 1."
        },
        "aggregate_usage": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Aggregate Usage",
          "examples": [
            "sum",
            "last_during_period",
            "last_ever",
            "max"
          ],
          "description": "For `usage_type=metered`, specifies how usage records are aggregated. Options include 'sum', 'last_during_period', 'last_ever', or 'max'. Defaults to 'sum'. This field is ignored if `usage_type` is 'licensed'."
        }
      },
      "description": "Specifies recurring components of a price, such as billing interval and usage type.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "lookup_key": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Lookup Key",
      "examples": [
        "standard_monthly",
        "premium_annual_2024"
      ],
      "description": "A unique, user-defined key to retrieve this price. Case-sensitive."
    },
    "tiers_mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Tiers Mode",
      "examples": [
        "graduated",
        "volume"
      ],
      "description": "Defines how the quantity is applied to the tiers. Either 'graduated' (price is sum of costs from applicable tiers) or 'volume' (price is determined by the tier corresponding to the total quantity). Required if `billing_scheme` is 'tiered'."
    },
    "unit_amount": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Unit Amount",
      "examples": [
        1000,
        2500
      ],
      "description": "The base charge amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for USD). Required if not using `tiers`, `custom_unit_amount`, or `currency_options` with a unit amount for the primary currency."
    },
    "product_data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "ProductData",
      "required": [
        "name"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "description": "The product\u2019s name, meant to be displayable to the customer."
        },
        "active": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Active",
          "default": true,
          "description": "Whether the product is currently available for purchase. Defaults to true."
        },
        "metadata": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Metadata",
          "description": "A set of key-value pairs to store additional information about the product.",
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "tax_code": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Tax Code",
          "description": "A tax code ID that identifies the taxability of this product. Recommended for products that are subject to tax."
        },
        "unit_label": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Unit Label",

## STRIPE_CREATE_PRODUCT
Creates a new product in Stripe, encoding the request as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` by flattening nested structures.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateProductRequest",
  "required": [
    "name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "prod_premium_monthly",
        "SKU12345"
      ],
      "description": "Optional unique product identifier. Stripe generates one if omitted. Useful for idempotency or migrating existing IDs."
    },
    "url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Url",
      "examples": [
        "https://example.com/premium-plan",
        "https://mystore.com/t-shirt-blue"

    "name": {
      "type": "string",

    },
    "active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Active",
      "default": true,

        "type": "string"

        ],
        "properties": {
          "name": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Name",
            "examples": [
              "Purchase Order Number"
            ],
            "description": "Name of the custom field for invoices."
          },
          "value": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Value",
            "examples": [
              "PO-12345"
            ],
            "description": "Value of the custom field."
          }
        },
        "description": "Represents a custom field to be displayed on invoices for sales of this product."
      },
      "title": "Custom Fields",
      "examples": [

          "{\"name\": \"Purchase Order\", \"value\": \"PO-12345XYZ\"}"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Custom fields displayed on invoices for sales (e.g., PO numbers)."
    },
    "shipping_cost": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "ShippingCost",
      "examples": [
        "{\"shipping_rate\": \"shr_1NqXyZ2eZvKYlo2CluUa0oOq\"}",
        "{\"shipping_rate_data\": {\"display_name\": \"Standard Shipping\", \"fixed_amount\": {\"amount\": 500, \"currency\": \"usd\"}}}"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "shipping_rate": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Shipping Rate",
          "examples": [
            "shr_1NqXyZ2eZvKYlo2CluUa0oOq"
          ],
          "description": "ID of an existing ShippingRate. If provided, `shipping_rate_data` must be omitted."

      "examples": [

      ],
      "required": [
        "currency"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "currency": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Currency",
          "examples": [
            "usd",
            "eur"
          ],
          "description": "Three-letter ISO currency code, lowercase. Must be a supported currency."
        },
        "recurring": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Recurring",
          "required": [
            "interval"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "interval": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Interval",
              "examples": [
                "month",
                "year"
              ],
              "description": "Frequency of subscription billing. Must be one of: `day`, `week`, `month`, or `year`."
            },
            "interval_count": {
              "type": "integer",
              "title": "Interval Count",
              "examples": [

              ],
              "description": "Number of intervals between billings (e.g., `interval=month`, `interval_count=3` bills every 3 months). Defaults to 1 if not provided."
            }
          },
          "description": "Specifies a recurring payment plan for a price.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "unit_amount": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Unit Amount",
          "examples": [
            1000,
            0
          ],
          "description": "Price in smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for USD). Zero allowed for free price."
        },
        "tax_behavior": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Tax Behavior",
          "examples": [
            "inclusive",
            "exclusive"
          ],
          "description": "Tax treatment of the price. Must be one of: `inclusive`, `exclusive`, or `unspecified` (inherited from customer/subscription)."
        },
        "currency_options": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Currency Options",
          "examples": [
            "{\"eur\": {\"unit_amount\": 800, \"tax_behavior\": \"exclusive\"}}"
          ],
          "description": "Per-currency pricing options. Keys are three-letter ISO currency codes. Values are dicts with price properties (e.g., `unit_amount`, `tax_behavior`) for that currency.",
          "additionalProperties": true
        },
        "custom_unit_amount": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Custom Unit Amount",
          "examples": [
            "{\"enabled\": true, \"minimum\": 500, \"preset\": 1000}"
          ],
          "description": "Configuration for customer-adjustable unit amount (Checkout/Payment Links). Requires `enabled=True`. Can include `minimum`, `maximum`, `preset`.",
          "additionalProperties": true
        },
        "unit_amount_decimal": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Unit Amount Decimal",
          "examples": [
            "10.50",
            "0.005"
          ],
          "description": "Price as a decimal in smallest currency unit (max 12 decimal places). For fractions of a cent."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data used to create a new Price object as the default price for this product.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "marketing_features": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "MarketingFeature",

        ],
        "properties": {

            "title": "Name",

      ],

    },
    "package_dimensions": {

        "height": {
          "type": "number",
          "title": "Height",

## STRIPE_CREATE_PROMOTION_CODE
Tool to create a promotion code linked to an underlying coupon. Use when you need to generate customer-redeemable codes with optional restrictions.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreatePromotionCodeRequest",
  "required": [
    "coupon"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "code": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Code",
      "examples": [
        "TESTPROMO25",
        "SUMMER2024"
      ],
      "description": "The customer-facing code (alphanumeric only: a-z, A-Z, 0-9). Maximum 500 characters. Auto-generated if omitted. Must be unique across all active promotion codes."
    },
    "active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Active",
      "description": "Whether the promotion code is currently active. Defaults to true if not specified."
    },
    "coupon": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Coupon",
      "examples": [
        "qMlqwca9",
        "25OFF"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the coupon that this promotion code will apply. This is required."
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the customer that this promotion code can be used by. If not set, the promotion code can be used by all customers."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. Useful for storing additional information in a structured format.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "expires_at": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Expires At",
      "examples": [
        1735689600
      ],
      "description": "Unix timestamp specifying when the promotion code will expire. Cannot exceed the coupon's redeems_by timestamp if specified."
    },
    "restrictions": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Restrictions",
      "properties": {
        "minimum_amount": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Minimum Amount",
          "examples": [
            1000,
            2500
          ],
          "description": "Minimum purchase amount required to redeem the promotion code (in smallest currency unit)."
        },
        "currency_options": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Currency Options",
          "description": "Per-currency minimum purchase amounts (using ISO 4217 currency codes as keys).",
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "CurrencyOptions",
            "required": [
              "minimum_amount"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "minimum_amount": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Minimum Amount",
                "examples": [
                  1000,
                  5000
                ],
                "description": "Minimum purchase amount required in the specified currency (in smallest currency unit)."
              }
            },
            "description": "Per-currency minimum purchase amounts."
          }
        },
        "first_time_transaction": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "First Time Transaction",
          "description": "If true, the promotion code can only be redeemed by customers without any successful payments or invoices."
        },
        "minimum_amount_currency": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Minimum Amount Currency",
          "examples": [
            "usd",
            "eur",
            "gbp"
          ],
          "description": "Three-letter ISO currency code for the minimum_amount."
        }
      },
      "description": "Settings for restricting the promotion code's redemption.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "max_redemptions": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Max Redemptions",
      "examples": [
        100,
        1000
      ],
      "description": "A positive integer specifying the number of times the promotion code can be redeemed. Cannot exceed the coupon's max_redemptions if set."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for creating a promotion code."
}
```

## STRIPE_CREATE_QUOTE
Tool to create a Stripe quote modeling prices and services for a customer. Use when you need to generate a formal quote for a customer before finalizing payment.

## STRIPE_CREATE_REFUND
Creates a full or partial refund in Stripe, targeting either a specific charge ID or a payment intent ID.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateRefundRequest",
  "properties": {
    "amount": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Amount",
      "examples": [
        1000
      ],
      "description": "Amount in smallest currency unit (e.g., 1000 for $10.00 USD) to refund. If omitted, a full refund is issued. Cannot exceed the charge's remaining refundable amount."
    },
    "charge": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Charge",
      "examples": [
        "ch_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "Identifier of the charge to refund. Required if `payment_intent` is not provided."
    },
    "reason": {
      "enum": [
        "duplicate",
        "fraudulent",
        "requested_by_customer"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "RefundReason",
      "examples": [
        "duplicate",
        "fraudulent",
        "requested_by_customer"
      ],
      "description": "Reasons for issuing a refund in Stripe."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "description": "Key-value pairs to attach to the refund, for storing structured information like order numbers or internal IDs.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "payment_intent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Intent",
      "examples": [
        "pi_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "Identifier of the PaymentIntent to refund. Required if `charge` is not provided."
    },
    "reverse_transfer": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Reverse Transfer",
      "description": "Reverse an associated transfer? Reversal is proportional to refund amount. Applies if the original charge had a reversible transfer."
    },
    "refund_application_fee": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Refund Application Fee",
      "description": "Refund the application fee? If true, full refunds refund the entire fee; partials refund proportionally. Applies if the original charge had an application fee."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_CREATE_REPORT_RUN
Creates a new report run object and begins executing the report asynchronously. Use when you need to generate Stripe reports such as balance summaries or itemized transaction reports.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateReportRunRequest",
  "required": [
    "report_type"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "parameters": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "ReportParameters",
      "properties": {
        "payout": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Payout",
          "examples": [
            "po_1234567890"
          ],
          "description": "The ID of the payout to filter by."
        },
        "columns": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Columns",
          "examples": [
            [
              "balance_transaction_id",
              "created",
              "available_on"
            ]
          ],
          "description": "The set of report columns to include in the report. If omitted, the report uses default columns."
        },
        "currency": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Currency",
          "examples": [
            "usd",
            "eur",
            "gbp"
          ],
          "description": "The currency code (ISO 4217) to filter objects by."
        },
        "timezone": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Timezone",
          "examples": [
            "America/Los_Angeles",
            "Europe/London",
            "Etc/UTC"
          ],
          "description": "The timezone to use for the report output (defaults to 'Etc/UTC'). Must be a valid IANA timezone identifier."
        },
        "interval_end": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Interval End",
          "examples": [
            1735000000
          ],
          "description": "Ending timestamp of the report data (exclusive). Unix timestamp in seconds. Required for nearly all report types. Must be after interval_start."
        },
        "interval_start": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Interval Start",
          "examples": [
            1730000000
          ],
          "description": "Starting timestamp of the report data (inclusive). Unix timestamp in seconds. Required for nearly all report types. Must be before interval_end."
        },
        "connected_account": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Connected Account",
          "examples": [
            "acct_1234567890"
          ],
          "description": "The ID of the connected account to filter results by."
        },
        "reporting_category": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Reporting Category",
          "examples": [
            "advance",
            "charge",
            "fee"
          ],
          "description": "The category of balance transactions to include in the report."
        }
      },
      "description": "Parameters for the report run configuration.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "report_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Report Type",
      "examples": [
        "balance.summary.1",
        "balance_change_from_activity.itemized.3"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the desired report type to run (e.g., 'balance.summary.1'). This determines what data the report will contain."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**

## STRIPE_CREATE_REVERSAL_TAX_TRANSACTION
Creates a reversal of an existing tax transaction. Use when you need to fully or partially reverse tax calculations, either for full refunds or specific line items.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateReversalTaxTransactionRequest",
  "required": [
    "mode",
    "original_transaction",
    "reference"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "mode": {
      "enum": [
        "full",
        "partial"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mode",
      "examples": [
        "full",
        "partial"
      ],
      "description": "Reversal mode: 'full' to fully reverse the original transaction, or 'partial' to reverse specified line items, shipping cost, or a flat amount."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs for storing additional information about the reversal.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "reference": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reference",
      "examples": [
        "test_reversal_001",
        "reversal_order_12345"
      ],
      "description": "Custom unique identifier for this reversal (max 500 characters). Must be unique across all transactions."
    },
    "line_items": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "LineItemReversal",
        "required": [
          "amount",
          "amount_tax",
          "original_line_item",
          "reference"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "amount": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Amount",
            "examples": [
              -1000,
              -500
            ],
            "description": "Amount to reverse in smallest currency unit (must be negative value)."
          },
          "metadata": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Metadata",
            "description": "Set of key-value pairs for storing additional information about the line item reversal.",
            "additionalProperties": {
              "type": "string"
            }
          },
          "quantity": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Quantity",
            "examples": [
              1,
              2,
              5
            ],
            "description": "Quantity of items being reversed."
          },
          "reference": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Reference",
            "examples": [
              "reversal_line_1",
              "item_ref_001"
            ],
            "description": "Custom identifier for this line item reversal (max 500 characters)."
          },
          "amount_tax": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Amount Tax",
            "examples": [
              -100,
              -50
            ],
            "description": "Tax amount to reverse in smallest currency unit (must be negative value)."
          },
          "original_line_item": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Original Line Item",
            "examples": [
              "line_item_1234567890"
            ],
            "description": "ID of the line item in the original transaction to reverse."
          }
        },
        "description": "Line item reversal details for partial reversals."
      },
      "title": "Line Items",
      "description": "Array of line item reversals for partial mode. Required for partial mode if flat_amount and shipping_cost are not provided."
    },
    "flat_amount": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Flat Amount",
      "examples": [
        -1000,
        -2500
      ],
      "description": "Single amount to reverse across the entire transaction in smallest currency unit (must be negative). Required for partial mode if line_items and shipping_cost are not provided."
    },
    "shipping_cost": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "ShippingCostReversal",
      "required": [
        "amount",
        "amount_tax"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "amount": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Amount",
          "examples": [
            -500,
            -1000
          ],
          "description": "Shipping amount to reverse in smallest currency unit (must be negative value)."
        },
        "amount_tax": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Amount Tax",
          "examples": [
            -50,
            -100
          ],
          "description": "Shipping tax amount to reverse in smallest currency unit (must be negative value)."
        }
      },
      "description": "Shipping cost reversal details for partial reversals.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "original_transaction": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Original Transaction",
      "examples": [
        "tax_1T1KScP3BKO35fWyZYEoLhtr"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the Tax Transaction to reverse."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for creating a reversal of a tax transaction."
}
```

## STRIPE_CREATE_SETUP_INTENT
Creates a SetupIntent object to collect payment method permissions for future payments. Use when setting up payment methods for subscriptions or saving cards for later use.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateSetupIntentRequest",
  "properties": {
    "usage": {
      "enum": [
        "off_session",
        "on_session"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Usage",
      "examples": [
        "off_session",
        "on_session"
      ],
      "description": "Indicates future payment method use. Values: off_session (default), on_session."
    },
    "confirm": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Confirm",
      "description": "Set to true to immediately confirm this SetupIntent. Defaults to false. When confirming, you should provide return_url for card authentication."
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [

## STRIPE_CREATE_SHIPPING_RATE
Creates a new shipping rate object that appears on Checkout Sessions for customer display. Use when defining shipping costs for products.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateShippingRateRequest",
  "required": [
    "display_name",
    "fixed_amount"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "type": {
      "type": "string",
      "const": "fixed_amount",
      "title": "Type",
      "default": "fixed_amount",
      "examples": [
        "fixed_amount"
      ],
      "description": "The type of calculation to use on the shipping rate. Currently only supports fixed_amount."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "tax_code": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Tax Code",
      "examples": [
        "txcd_92010001"
      ],
      "description": "A tax code ID. The Shipping tax code is txcd_92010001."
    },
    "display_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Display Name",
      "examples": [
        "Ground Shipping",
        "Express Delivery",
        "Standard Shipping"
      ],
      "maxLength": 100,
      "description": "Customer-facing name of the shipping rate, meant to be displayable to the customer. Maximum 100 characters."
    },
    "fixed_amount": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Fixed Amount",
      "required": [
        "amount",
        "currency"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "amount": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Amount",
          "minimum": 0,
          "examples": [
            500,
            1000
          ],
          "description": "A non-negative integer in cents representing how much to charge."
        },
        "currency": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Currency",
          "examples": [
            "usd",
            "eur",
            "gbp"
          ],
          "description": "Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase. Must be a supported currency."
        },
        "currency_options": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Currency Options",
          "description": "Shipping rates defined in each available currency option. Each key must be a three-letter ISO currency code and a supported currency.",
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "CurrencyOptionRequest",
            "required": [
              "amount"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "amount": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Amount",
                "minimum": 0,
                "examples": [
                  500,
                  1000
                ],
                "description": "A non-negative integer in cents representing how much to charge."
              },
              "tax_behavior": {
                "anyOf": [
                  {
                    "enum": [
                      "inclusive",
                      "exclusive",
                      "unspecified"
                    ],
                    "type": "string"
                  },
                  {
                    "type": "null"
                  }
                ],
                "title": "Tax Behavior",
                "default": null,
                "examples": [
                  "inclusive",
                  "exclusive"
                ],
                "description": "Specifies whether the rate is considered inclusive of taxes or exclusive of taxes. One of: inclusive, exclusive, or unspecified."
              }
            },
            "description": "Model for currency-specific pricing option."
          }
        }
      },
      "description": "Describes a fixed amount to charge for shipping. Required when type is fixed_amount.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "tax_behavior": {
      "enum": [
        "inclusive",
        "exclusive",
        "unspecified"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Tax Behavior",
      "examples": [
        "inclusive",
        "exclusive",
        "unspecified"
      ],
      "description": "Specifies whether the rate is considered inclusive of taxes or exclusive of taxes. One of: inclusive, exclusive, or unspecified. Once specified, it cannot be changed."
    },
    "delivery_estimate": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "DeliveryEstimate",
      "properties": {
        "maximum": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "DeliveryEstimateBound",
          "required": [
            "unit",
            "value"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "unit": {
              "enum": [
                "business_day",
                "day",
                "hour",
                "month",
                "week"
              ],
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Unit",
              "examples": [
                "day",
                "week"
              ],
              "description": "A unit of time. One of: business_day, day, hour, month, or week."
            },
            "value": {
              "type": "integer",
              "title": "Value",
              "minimum": 1,
              "examples": [
                3,
                5
              ],
              "description": "Must be greater than 0."
            }
          },
          "description": "Model for minimum or maximum delivery estimate bound.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "minimum": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "DeliveryEstimateBound",
          "required": [
            "unit",
            "value"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "unit": {
              "enum": [
                "business_day",
                "day",
                "hour",
                "month",
                "week"
              ],
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Unit",
              "examples": [

              "description": "A unit of time. One of: business_day, day, hour, month, or week."
            },
            "value": {
              "type": "integer",
              "title": "Value",
              "minimum": 1,
              "examples": [
                3,
                5
              ],
              "description": "Must be greater than 0."
            }
          },
          "description": "Model for minimum or maximum delivery estimate bound.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      },
      "description": "Model for estimated delivery timeframe.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for creating a Stripe shipping rate."
}

## STRIPE_CREATE_SUBSCRIPTION
Creates a new, highly configurable subscription for an existing Stripe customer, supporting multiple items, trials, discounts, and various billing/payment options.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateDetailedSubscriptionRequest",
  "required": [
    "customer",
    "items"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "items": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "SubscriptionItem",
        "properties": {
          "price": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Price",
            "examples": [
              "price_xxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
            ],
            "description": "ID of the price object. One of `price` or `price_data` is required."
          },
          "metadata": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Metadata",
            "description": "Key-value pairs for additional information about this item.",
            "additionalProperties": {
              "type": "string"
            }
          },
          "quantity": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Quantity",
            "description": "Quantity of the subscription item."
          },
          "discounts": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "title": "Discount",
              "properties": {
                "coupon": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Coupon",
                  "examples": [
                    "coupon_xxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
                  ],
                  "description": "ID of the coupon to apply."
                },
                "discount": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Discount",
                  "description": "ID of an existing discount object to apply (typically for ad-hoc discounts)."
                },
                "promotion_code": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Promotion Code",
                  "examples": [
                    "promo_xxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
                  ],
                  "description": "ID of the promotion code to apply."
                }
              }
            },
            "title": "Discounts",
            "description": "List of discounts for this item, overriding subscription-level discounts."
          },
          "tax_rates": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "title": "Tax Rates",
            "examples": [
              [
                "txr_xxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
              ]
            ],
            "description": "List of tax rate IDs to apply to this item, overriding defaults."
          },
          "price_data": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "PriceData",
            "required": [
              "currency",
              "product",
              "unit_amount"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "product": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Product",
                "examples": [
                  "prod_xxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
                ],
                "description": "ID of the product associated with this price."
              },
              "currency": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Currency",
                "examples": [
                  "usd",
                  "eur",
                  "gbp"
                ],
                "description": "Three-letter ISO currency code (lowercase)."
              },
              "recurring": {
                "type": "object",
                "title": "Recurring",
                "examples": [
                  {
                    "interval": "month",
                    "interval_count": 1
                  }
                ],
                "description": "Recurring components of the price (e.g., interval, interval_count).",
                "additionalProperties": true
              },
              "unit_amount": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Unit Amount",
                "examples": [
                  "1000",
                  "2500"
                ],
                "description": "Unit amount in the currency's smallest unit (e.g., cents for USD)."
              }
            },
            "description": "Data to generate a new price object inline. One of `price` or `price_data` is required.",
            "additionalProperties": false
          },
          "billing_thresholds": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "BillingThresholds",
            "properties": {
              "amount_gte": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Amount Gte",
                "examples": [
                  "10000"
                ],
                "description": "Monetary threshold (in smallest currency unit) to trigger billing."
              },
              "reset_billing_cycle_anchor": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "title": "Reset Billing Cycle Anchor",
                "description": "Reset the billing cycle anchor to the threshold bill date."
              }
            },
            "description": "Usage-based billing thresholds for this item.",
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        }
      },
      "title": "Items",
      "description": "List of items (products/services and pricing) for the subscription."
    },
    "currency": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Currency",
      "examples": [
        "usd",
        "eur",
        "gbp"
      ],
      "description": "Three-letter ISO currency code (lowercase) for the subscription."
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_xxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the existing Stripe customer."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "description": "Key-value pairs for additional information about the subscription.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "cancel_at": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Cancel At",
      "description": "Unix timestamp to schedule subscription cancellation."
    },
    "discounts": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "Discount",
        "properties": {
          "coupon": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Coupon",
            "examples": [
              "coupon_xxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
            ],
            "description": "ID of the coupon to apply."
          },
          "discount": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Discount",
            "description": "ID of an existing discount object to apply (typically for ad-hoc discounts)."
          },
          "promotion_code": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Promotion Code",
            "examples": [
              "promo_xxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
            ],
            "description": "ID of the promotion code to apply."
          }
        }
      },
      "title": "Discounts",
      "description": "List of discounts for the entire subscription."
    },
    "trial_end": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Trial End",
      "description": "Unix timestamp for trial end. Overrides plan trial period. During the trial, no payment is required - this allows creating subscriptions without a payment method. Can be up to two years from billing cycle anchor."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "description": "Arbitrary string describing the subscription."
    },
    "off_session": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Off Session",
      "description": "Allow initial payment attempt off-session (without direct customer interaction)."
    },
    "on_behalf_of": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "On Behalf Of",
      "examples": [
        "acct_xxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
      ],
      "description": "Stripe Connect account ID for attributing payments (if charging on behalf of)."
    },
    "automatic_tax": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "AutomaticTax",
      "required": [
        "enabled"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "enabled": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Enabled",
          "description": "Enable automatic tax calculation by Stripe for this subscription."
        },
        "liability": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "AutomaticTaxLiability",
          "required": [
            "connected_account"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "connected_account": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Connected Account",
              "examples": [
                "acct_xxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
              ],
              "description": "Stripe Connect account ID liable for tax calculations and reporting."
            }
          },
          "description": "Account responsible for tax liabilities if automatic tax is enabled.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      },
      "description": "Settings for Stripe's automatic tax calculation.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "transfer_data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "TransferData",
      "required": [
        "destination"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "destination": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Destination",
          "examples": [
            "acct_xxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
          ],
          "description": "ID of the Stripe connected account receiving the transfer."
        },
        "amount_percent": {
          "type": "number",
          "title": "Amount Percent",
          "description": "Percentage (1-100, up to 4 decimal places) of subscription amount to transfer."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data to specify a funds transfer to a connected Stripe account as part of this subscription.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "days_until_due": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Days Until Due",
      "description": "Days until invoice is due (for `send_invoice` collection method)."
    },
    "default_source": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Default Source",
      "examples": [
        "card_xxxxxxxxxxxxxx",
        "src_xxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
      ],
      "description": "ID of default payment source (deprecated; use `default_payment_method`)."
    },
    "promotion_code": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Promotion Code",
      "examples": [
        "promo_xxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the promotion code to apply."
    },
    "trial_settings": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "TrialSettings",
      "required": [
        "end_behavior"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "end_behavior": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "End Behavior",
          "examples": [
            {
              "missing_payment_method": "cancel"
            }
          ],
          "description": "Behavior when trial period ends, including `missing_payment_method` handling.",
          "additionalProperties": true
        }
      },
      "description": "Settings related to the subscription's trial period, specifically how it should end.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "trial_from_plan": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Trial From Plan",
      "description": "Inherit trial period from the plan of the first item."
    },
    "invoice_settings": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "InvoiceSettings",
      "properties": {
        "issuer": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Issuer",
          "description": "Entity issuing the invoice (e.g., company or individual), with details.",
          "additionalProperties": true
        },
        "account_tax_ids": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Account Tax Ids",
          "examples": [
            [
              "txr_xxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
            ]
          ],
          "description": "List of tax ID objects (e.g., VAT numbers) for invoices. Must be Stripe-verified."
        }
      },
      "description": "Custom settings for invoices generated for this subscription.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "payment_behavior": {
      "enum": [
        "allow_incomplete",
        "default_incomplete",
        "error_if_incomplete",
        "pending_if_incomplete"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "PaymentBehavior",
      "description": "Behavior when initial payment fails or requires SCA (e.g., 3D Secure authentication). Options: 'allow_incomplete' (default) - creates subscription with status='incomplete' if the first invoice can't be paid; 'default_incomplete' - creates subscription with status='incomplete' when payment is required, otherwise starts as active; 'error_if_incomplete' - returns HTTP 402 error if payment fails; 'pending_if_incomplete' - only valid for updates. Note: This parameter controls payment failure handling, not whether a payment method is required. To create subscriptions without a payment method, use trial_period_days or collection_method='send_invoice'."
    },
    "payment_settings": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "PaymentSettings",
      "properties": {

          "type": "array",
          "items": {

## STRIPE_CREATE_SUBSCRIPTION_ITEM
Tool to add a new item to an existing subscription without changing existing items. Use when adding a product or service to a customer's subscription.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateSubscriptionItemRequest",
  "required": [
    "subscription"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "price": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Price",
      "examples": [
        "price_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the price object. Either price or price_data is required."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "order_id": "12345",
          "customer_ref": "abc"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs for storing structured data.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "quantity": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Quantity",
      "examples": [
        1,
        5,
        10
      ],
      "description": "The quantity you'd like to apply to the subscription item."
    },
    "discounts": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "DiscountInput",
        "properties": {
          "coupon": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Coupon",
            "examples": [
              "25OFF"
            ],
            "description": "ID of the coupon to create a new discount."
          },
          "discount": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Discount",
            "examples": [
              "di_1234567890"
            ],
            "description": "ID of an existing discount to reuse."
          },
          "promotion_code": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Promotion Code",
            "examples": [
              "promo_1234567890"
            ],
            "description": "ID of the promotion code to create a new discount."
          }
        },
        "description": "Discount configuration."
      },
      "title": "Discounts",
      "description": "The coupons or promotion codes to redeem."
    },
    "tax_rates": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Tax Rates",
      "examples": [
        [
          "txr_1234567890",
          "txr_0987654321"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of Tax Rate IDs to override subscription default."
    },
    "price_data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "PriceData",
      "required": [
        "currency",
        "product",
        "recurring"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "product": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Product",
          "examples": [
            "prod_12345"
          ],
          "description": "The ID of the product that this price will belong to."
        },
        "currency": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Currency",
          "examples": [
            "usd",
            "eur",
            "gbp"
          ],
          "description": "Three-letter ISO currency code in lowercase (e.g., 'usd', 'eur')."
        },
        "recurring": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Recurring",
          "required": [
            "interval"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "interval": {
              "enum": [
                "day",
                "week",
                "month",
                "year"
              ],
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Interval",
              "description": "Billing frequency. One of day, week, month, or year."
            },
            "interval_count": {
              "type": "integer",
              "title": "Interval Count",
              "examples": [
                1,
                2,
                3,
                12
              ],
              "description": "Number of intervals between billings. Must be a positive integer."
            }
          },
          "description": "The recurring components of the price.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "unit_amount": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Unit Amount",
          "examples": [
            1000,
            2500,
            5000
          ],
          "description": "Positive integer in cents (or 0 for free) representing unit amount."
        },
        "tax_behavior": {
          "enum": [
            "inclusive",
            "exclusive",
            "unspecified"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Tax Behavior",
          "description": "Specifies whether the price is considered inclusive or exclusive of taxes."
        },
        "unit_amount_decimal": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Unit Amount Decimal",
          "examples": [
            "10.50",
            "25.99"
          ],
          "description": "Decimal value representing the unit amount in cents (max 12 decimal places)."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data for generating a new Price object inline.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "subscription": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subscription",
      "examples": [
        "sub_1ShVc8QvM72TjFrbRD0soIlT"
      ],
      "description": "The identifier of the subscription to modify."
    },
    "proration_date": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Proration Date",
      "examples": [
        1640995200
      ],
      "description": "Unix timestamp used to calculate proration amounts."
    },
    "payment_behavior": {
      "enum": [
        "allow_incomplete",
        "default_incomplete",
        "pending_if_incomplete",
        "error_if_incomplete"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Behavior",
      "description": "Payment behavior options for handling incomplete payments."
    },
    "billing_thresholds": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "BillingThresholdsInput",
      "required": [
        "usage_gte"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "usage_gte": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Usage Gte",
          "examples": [
            100,
            1000,
            10000
          ],
          "description": "Number of units that meets the billing threshold to advance the subscription to a new billing period."
        }
      },
      "description": "Billing threshold configuration.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "proration_behavior": {
      "enum": [
        "always_invoice",
        "create_prorations",
        "none"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Proration Behavior",
      "description": "Determines how to handle prorations. Default is create_prorations."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for creating a subscription item."
}

## STRIPE_CREATE_SUBSCRIPTION_SCHEDULE
Tool to create a new subscription schedule for managing subscription changes over time. Use when you need to schedule future subscription modifications, phase transitions, or automate subscription lifecycle management.

**Input schema:**

  "type": "object",

## STRIPE_CREATE_TAX_CALCULATION
Creates a Tax Calculation to compute taxes for customer purchases. Use when you need to calculate taxes for a transaction before finalizing it, such as displaying tax amounts in a shopping cart.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateTaxCalculationRequest",
  "required": [
    "currency",
    "line_items"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "currency": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Currency",
      "examples": [
        "usd",
        "eur",
        "gbp",
        "cad"
      ],
      "description": "Three-letter ISO currency code in lowercase. Must be a supported currency. All amounts in the calculation must use this currency."
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_123456789"
      ],
      "description": "ID of an existing Stripe Customer. If provided, the customer's address and tax IDs will be used. Cannot be used together with 'customer_details'."
    },
    "tax_date": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Tax Date",
      "examples": [
        1672531200
      ],
      "description": "Unix timestamp specifying the date for which tax rules and rates should apply. Defaults to the current date if not provided."
    },
    "line_items": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "LineItem",
        "required": [
          "amount",
          "reference"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "amount": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Amount",
            "examples": [
              1000,
              5000
            ],
            "description": "Positive integer representing the line item's total price in the smallest currency unit (e.g., 100 cents for $1.00 USD, 100 for \u00a5100 JPY)."
          },
          "product": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Product",
            "examples": [
              "prod_123456789"
            ],
            "description": "Stripe Product ID. If provided, the product's associated tax code will be used instead of the 'tax_code' parameter."
          },
          "quantity": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Quantity",
            "examples": [
              1,
              5,
              10
            ],
            "description": "Number of units of this line item. Used for reporting purposes. Default is 1 if not provided."
          },
          "tax_code": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Tax Code",
            "examples": [
              "txcd_99999999",
              "txcd_10000000"
            ],
            "description": "Tax code ID used to classify the product for tax purposes. See https://stripe.com/docs/tax/tax-categories for available tax codes."
          },
          "reference": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Reference",
            "examples": [
              "L1",
              "item_123",
              "product_abc"
            ],
            "description": "Unique identifier for this line item. Must be unique across all line items in this calculation. Used to reference the line item in the response."
          },
          "tax_behavior": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Tax Behavior",
            "examples": [
              "exclusive",
              "inclusive"
            ],
            "description": "Specifies whether the 'amount' includes taxes or not. One of: 'exclusive' (amount does not include taxes; default) or 'inclusive' (amount already includes taxes)."
          }
        },
        "description": "Line item for tax calculation."
      },
      "title": "Line Items",
      "description": "List of line items the customer is purchasing. At least one line item is required. Each line item must have a unique 'reference'."
    },
    "shipping_cost": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "ShippingCost",
      "properties": {
        "amount": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Amount",
          "examples": [

## STRIPE_CREATE_TAX_ID
Creates a new tax ID for an account or customer. Use when you need to add tax identification for compliance and invoicing purposes.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateTaxIdRequest",
  "required": [
    "type",
    "value"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Type",
      "examples": [
        "eu_vat",
        "us_ein",
        "gb_vat",
        "ca_bn"
      ],
      "description": "Type of the tax ID.
