## STRIPE_CREATE_TAX_RATE
Tool to create a new tax rate in Stripe. Use when you need to define a tax rate for invoices, subscriptions, or checkout sessions.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateTaxRateRequest",
  "required": [
    "display_name",
    "inclusive",
    "percentage"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "state": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "State",
      "examples": [
        "NY",
        "CA",
        "TX"
      ],
      "description": "ISO 3166-2 subdivision code without country prefix (e.g., 'NY' for New York)."
    },
    "active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Active",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Whether the tax rate is active. Inactive rates cannot be used with new applications but continue to work for existing subscriptions. Defaults to true."
    },
    "country": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Country",
      "examples": [
        "US",
        "CA",
        "GB"
      ],
      "description": "Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., 'US', 'CA')."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "region": "west",
          "category": "sales"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs for storing additional structured information.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "tax_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Tax Type",
      "examples": [
        "sales_tax",
        "vat",
        "gst"
      ],
      "description": "The type of tax. One of: amusement_tax, communications_tax, gst, hst, igst, jct, lease_tax, pst, qst, retail_delivery_fee, rst, sales_tax, service_tax, or vat."
    },
    "inclusive": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Inclusive",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Whether the tax is included in the price (true) or added on top (false)."
    },
    "percentage": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Percentage",
      "examples": [
        8.5,
        10,
        20
      ],
      "description": "The tax percentage value (e.g., 8.5 for 8.5%). This value is out of 100."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "examples": [
        "Internal sales tax for California"
      ],
      "description": "An arbitrary string for internal use only. Not displayed to customers."
    },
    "display_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Display Name",
      "examples": [
        "Sales Tax",
        "VAT",
        "GST"
      ],
      "description": "The display name of the tax rate shown to users. Maximum 50 characters."
    },
    "jurisdiction": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Jurisdiction",
      "examples": [
        "California",
        "New York",
        "Ontario"
      ],
      "description": "The jurisdiction for the tax rate. Maximum 50 characters. Displayed on customer invoices for reporting purposes."
    }
  },
  "description": "Parameters for creating a new tax rate in Stripe."
}
```

## STRIPE_CREATE_TAX_REGISTRATION
Creates a new Tax Registration object to enable tax collection in specified jurisdictions. Use when setting up tax collection for a new country, state, or province.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateTaxRegistrationRequest",
  "required": [
    "country",
    "country_options",
    "active_from"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "country": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Country",
      "examples": [
        "US",
        "CA",
        "GB",
        "DE",
        "FR"
      ],
      "description": "Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code where tax collection will be enabled (e.g., 'US', 'CA', 'GB', 'DE')."
    },
    "expires_at": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Expires At",
      "examples": [
        1767225600
      ],
      "description": "Optional Unix timestamp in seconds when the registration becomes inactive. Omit for indefinite validity."
    },
    "active_from": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "now"
        },
        {
          "type": "integer"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Active From",
      "examples": [
        "now",
        1735689600
      ],
      "description": "Activation time for the registration. Use 'now' for immediate activation or provide a future Unix timestamp in seconds for scheduled activation."
    },
    "country_options": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Country Options",
      "examples": [
        {
          "us": {
            "type": "state_sales_tax",
            "state": "NY"
          }
        },
        {
          "de": {
            "type": "standard",
            "standard": {
              "place_of_supply_scheme": "standard"
            }
          }
        },
        {
          "ca": {
            "type": "province_standard",
            "province_standard": {
              "province": "ON"
            }
          }
        }
      ],
      "description": "Country-specific configuration object. The key must match the country code. Value contains type-specific configuration (e.g., for US: includes 'state' and 'type'; for EU: includes 'type' and 'standard' config when type='standard'; for CA: includes 'type' and optional nested configs).",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "anyOf": [
          {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "UsCountryOptions",
            "required": [
              "state",
              "type"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "type": {
                "enum": [
                  "state_sales_tax",
                  "state_communications_tax",
                  "local_amusement_tax",
                  "local_lease_tax",
                  "state_retail_delivery_fee"
                ],
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Type",
                "description": "Type of US tax registration. Common types include 'state_sales_tax', 'state_communications_tax', 'local_amusement_tax', 'local_lease_tax', or 'state_retail_delivery_fee'."
              },
              "state": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "State",
                "examples": [
                  "NY",
                  "CA",
                  "TX"
                ],
                "description": "Two-letter ISO 3166-2 state code (e.g., 'NY', 'CA', 'TX')."
              },
              "state_sales_tax": {
                "anyOf": [
                  {
                    "type": "object",
                    "title": "UsCountryOptionsStateSalesTax",
                    "properties": {
                      "elections": {
                        "anyOf": [
                          {
                            "type": "array",
                            "items": {
                              "type": "object",
                              "title": "UsCountryOptionsStateElection",
                              "required": [
                                "jurisdiction",
                                "type"
                              ],
                              "properties": {
                                "type": {
                                  "enum": [
                                    "local_use_tax",
                                    "simplified_sellers_use_tax"
                                  ],
                                  "type": "string",
                                  "title": "Type",
                                  "description": "Type of election. Must be 'local_use_tax' or 'simplified_sellers_use_tax'."
                                },
                                "jurisdiction": {
                                  "type": "string",
                                  "title": "Jurisdiction",
                                  "examples": [
                                    "12345"
                                  ],
                                  "description": "FIPS code for the jurisdiction (e.g., local county or city code)."
                                }
                              },
                              "description": "Election options for US state sales tax with multi-jurisdictional rules."
                            }
                          },
                          {
                            "type": "null"
                          }
                        ],
                        "title": "Elections",
                        "default": null,
                        "description": "Array of election objects for multi-jurisdictional sales tax rules within the state."
                      }
                    },
                    "description": "State sales tax specific configuration for US registrations."
                  },
                  {
                    "type": "null"
                  }
                ],
                "default": null,
                "description": "Configuration for state sales tax, including multi-jurisdictional elections if applicable."
              }
            },
            "description": "Country-specific options for United States tax registrations."
          },
          {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "EuCountryOptions",
            "required": [
              "type"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "type": {
                "enum": [
                  "standard",
                  "ioss",
                  "oss_union",
                  "oss_non_union"
                ],
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Type",
                "description": "Type of EU tax registration. Must be 'standard', 'ioss' (Import One-Stop Shop), 'oss_union' (One-Stop Shop for EU), or 'oss_non_union' (One-Stop Shop for non-EU)."
              },
              "standard": {
                "anyOf": [
                  {
                    "type": "object",
                    "title": "StandardOptions",
                    "properties": {
                      "place_of_supply_scheme": {
                        "enum": [
                          "standard",
                          "inbound_goods",
                          "small_seller"
                        ],
                        "type": "string",
                        "title": "Place Of Supply Scheme",
                        "default": "standard",
                        "description": "Tax collection scheme. 'standard' applies tax to domestic sales only, 'inbound_goods' collects tax at destination for imported goods, 'small_seller' allows seller's rate across EU."
                      }
                    },
                    "description": "Standard registration options applicable to most countries."
                  },
                  {
                    "type": "null"
                  }
                ],
                "default": null,
                "description": "Standard registration configuration. REQUIRED when type is 'standard'. If not provided when type='standard', defaults to StandardOptions(place_of_supply_scheme='standard')."
              }
            },
            "description": "Country-specific options for EU tax registrations."
          },
          {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "CaCountryOptions",
            "required": [
              "type"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "type": {
                "enum": [
                  "standard",
                  "simplified",
                  "province_standard"
                ],
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Type",
                "description": "Type of Canadian tax registration. Must be 'standard', 'simplified', or 'province_standard'."
              },
              "province_standard": {
                "anyOf": [
                  {
                    "type": "object",
                    "title": "CaProvinceStandardOptions",
                    "required": [
                      "province"
                    ],
                    "properties": {
                      "province": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "title": "Province",
                        "examples": [
                          "ON",
                          "QC",
                          "BC"
                        ],
                        "description": "Two-letter ISO 3166-2 province code (e.g., 'ON', 'QC', 'BC')."
                      }
                    },
                    "description": "Province standard configuration for Canadian tax registrations."
                  },
                  {
                    "type": "null"
                  }
                ],
                "default": null,
                "description": "Province-specific configuration required when type is 'province_standard'."
              }
            },
            "description": "Country-specific options for Canadian tax registrations."
          },
          {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": {
              "anyOf": [
                {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                {
                  "type": "integer"
                },
                {
                  "type": "boolean"
                },
                {
                  "type": "object",
                  "additionalProperties": true
                },
                {
                  "type": "array",
                  "items": {}
                },
                {
                  "type": "null"
                }
              ]
            }
          }
        ]
      }

  "description": "Request parameters for creating a new tax registration in Stripe."
```

## STRIPE_CREATE_TAX_TRANSACTION_FROM_CALCULATION
Tool to create a Tax Transaction from a calculation before 90-day expiration. Use when you need to finalize tax calculations and create a permanent transaction record.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateTaxTransactionFromCalculationRequest",
  "required": [
    "calculation",
    "reference"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "description": "Key-value pairs for storing additional information. Individual or all keys can be cleared by posting empty values.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "posted_at": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Posted At",
      "examples": [
        1672531200
      ],
      "description": "Unix timestamp when tax liability is assumed/reduced. Must be between tax_date and current time. Defaults to current time if not specified."
    },
    "reference": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reference",
      "examples": [
        "order_test_12345",
        "myOrder_123"
      ],
      "description": "Custom order/sale identifier (e.g., 'myOrder_123'). Must be unique across all transactions and reversals. Maximum length: 500 characters."
    },
    "calculation": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Calculation",
      "examples": [
        "taxcalc_1ShVsvQvM72TjFrbDxC058sb"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the Tax Calculation to use as input. Must be a valid, non-expired calculation (expires after 90 days)."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_CREATE_TERMINAL_CONFIGURATION
Creates a new Configuration object for Stripe payment terminals with customizable settings. Use when setting up terminal readers with specific device configurations, offline settings, tipping options, or WiFi credentials.

**Input schema:**
```json

  "title": "CreateTerminalConfigurationRequest",

    "name": {
      "type": "string",

        "Test Configuration",
        "Store Front Terminal Config"
      ],
      "description": "Configuration identifier name (max 100 characters)."
    },

              "type": "string",

            },

            },

        {
```

## STRIPE_CREATE_TERMINAL_CONNECTION_TOKEN
Creates a short-lived connection token for Stripe Terminal SDK to connect to readers. Use when initializing a Terminal connection with the Stripe Terminal SDK.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateTerminalConnectionTokenRequest",
  "properties": {
    "location": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Location",
      "examples": [
        "tml_1234567890",
        "tml_abcdefghij"
      ],
      "description": "The id of the location that this connection token is scoped to. If specified the connection token will only be usable with readers assigned to that location, otherwise the connection token will be usable with all readers. Note that location scoping only applies to internet-connected readers."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {

      "type": "object",

        "secret"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "object": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Object",
          "description": "String representing the object's type. Value is 'terminal.connection_token'."
        },
        "secret": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Secret",
          "description": "The connection token secret string that your application must provide to the Stripe Terminal SDK for authentication purposes."
        },
        "location": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Location",
          "description": "The identifier of the location scoping this connection token, applicable only to internet-enabled readers. Returns null if not specified in request."
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "title": "CreateTerminalConnectionTokenResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
```

## STRIPE_CREATE_TERMINAL_LOCATION
Creates a new Terminal Location for managing Stripe Terminal readers. Use when you need to register a physical location where Terminal readers will be deployed.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateTerminalLocationRequest",
  "required": [
    "address"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "phone": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Phone",
      "examples": [
        "+15551234567",
        "+442079460000"
      ],
      "description": "Phone number for the location."
    },
    "address": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Address",
      "required": [
        "country",
        "line1"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "city": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "City",
          "examples": [
            "San Francisco",
            "New York"
          ],
          "description": "City, district, suburb, town, or village. Required in certain countries."
        },
        "line1": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Line1",
          "examples": [
            "123 Main St",
            "PO Box 456"
          ],
          "description": "Street address, PO Box, or company name."
        },
        "line2": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Line2",
          "examples": [
            "Apt 4B",
            "Suite 100"
          ],
          "description": "Apartment, suite, unit, or building number."
        },
        "state": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "State",
          "examples": [
            "CA",
            "NY"
          ],
          "description": "State, county, province, or region. Use ISO 3166-2 subdivision code. Required in certain countries."
        },
        "country": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Country",
          "examples": [
            "US",
            "CA",
            "GB"
          ],
          "description": "Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code."
        },
        "postal_code": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Postal Code",
          "examples": [
            "94105",
            "10001"
          ],
          "description": "ZIP or postal code. Required in certain countries."
        }
      },
      "description": "The full address of the location. Country and line1 are required; city, state, and postal_code are conditionally required based on the country.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "region": "west",
          "store_id": "123"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object for storing additional structured information.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "display_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Display Name",
      "examples": [
        "Main Street Store",
        "Downtown Office"
      ],
      "description": "A name for the location. Maximum 1000 characters."
    },
    "configuration_overrides": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Configuration Overrides",
      "examples": [
        "tml_config_abc123"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of a configuration that will be used to customize all readers at this location. Maximum 500 characters."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for creating a terminal location."
}
```

## STRIPE_CREATE_TERMINAL_ONBOARDING_LINK
Creates an onboarding link for Tap to Pay on iPhone. Use when you need to generate a redirect URL for merchants to complete the Apple Terms and Conditions acceptance flow. The generated link directs merchants through the required onboarding process.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateTerminalOnboardingLinkRequest",
  "required": [
    "link_type",
    "link_options"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "link_options"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded. Each field must be a valid expandable field name."
    },
    "link_type": {
      "enum": [
        "apple_terms_and_conditions"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Link Type",
      "description": "The type of link being generated. Currently only 'apple_terms_and_conditions' is supported."
    },
    "link_options": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Link Options",
      "properties": {
        "apple_terms_and_conditions": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "AppleTermsAndConditionsOptions",
          "required": [
            "merchant_display_name"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "allow_relinking": {
              "type": "boolean",
              "title": "Allow Relinking",
              "description": "Whether to allow the merchant to relink their Apple account. If true, the merchant can change their Apple account even if already linked."
            },
            "merchant_display_name": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Merchant Display Name",
              "examples": [
                "Test Merchant",
                "My Coffee Shop"
              ],
              "description": "The merchant name to be displayed in the Apple Terms and Conditions flow. This is required for the apple_terms_and_conditions link type."

          },
          "description": "Options for Apple Terms and Conditions link type.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      },
      "description": "Specific fields needed to generate the desired link type. Must include the appropriate nested object based on link_type.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "on_behalf_of": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "On Behalf Of",
      "examples": [
        "acct_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "Stripe account ID to generate the link for. Use this when creating the link on behalf of a connected account."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to create a terminal onboarding link for Tap to Pay on iPhone."
}
```

## STRIPE_CREATE_TERMINAL_READER
Creates and registers a new Terminal Reader to a Stripe account at a specified location. Use this to add physical card reader devices (like Stripe S700, WisePOS E) for accepting in-person payments. The reader must first generate a registration code (enter 0-7-1-3-9 on the device) before registering via this API. For testing purposes, use simulated readers with codes 'simulated-wpe' or 'simulated-s700' in test mode only.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateTerminalReaderRequest",
  "required": [
    "registration_code",
    "location"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "label": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Label",
      "examples": [
        "Front Desk Reader",
        "Store A - Main Counter"
      ],
      "description": "Custom label given to the reader for easier identification. If no label is specified, the registration code will be used as the label."
    },
    "location": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Location",
      "examples": [
        "tml_GUdgMgquBqoRvh",
        "tml_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "The location ID to assign this reader to. Must be a valid Stripe Location ID."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "store_id": "12345",
          "department": "sales"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be cleared by setting them to empty values.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "registration_code": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Registration Code",
      "examples": [
        "simulated-wpe",
        "simulated-s700",
        "puppies-plug-could"
      ],
      "description": "A code generated by the reader used for registering to an account. For physical readers, enter the key sequence 0-7-1-3-9 on the reader to display the registration code. For testing in test mode, use 'simulated-wpe' or 'simulated-s700'. Note: Simulated readers can only be registered in test mode, not live mode."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_CREATE_TEST_CLOCK
Tool to create a test clock for testing time-based scenarios in Stripe. Use when you need to simulate the passage of time for testing subscriptions, trials, or other time-dependent features.

```json
    "frozen_time"
  ],

      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Test Clock for API Verification",
        "Subscription Testing Clock"
      ],
      "description": "The name for this test clock. Maximum length is 300 characters."
    },

      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Frozen Time",
      "examples": [

}
```

## STRIPE_CREATE_TEST_CONFIRMATION_TOKEN
Creates a test mode Confirmation Token for server-side payment integration testing. Confirmation Tokens securely transport payment method details collected client-side to your server for confirming PaymentIntents or SetupIntents. This test helper allows you to create these tokens server-side for testing without using Stripe.js. IMPORTANT: This endpoint requires TEST MODE API keys (sk_test_...). It will fail with live mode keys. Use this only for integration testing in test mode environments. Provide either 'payment_method' (existing PM ID) or 'payment_method_data' (to create new PM).

## STRIPE_CREATE_USAGE_RECORD
Creates a usage record for a specified subscription item and timestamp. Use when tracking customer usage for metered billing plans to accurately invoice usage-based subscriptions.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateUsageRecordRequest",
  "required": [
    "subscription_item",
    "quantity",
    "timestamp"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "action": {
      "enum": [
        "increment",
        "set"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Action",
      "default": "increment",
      "examples": [
        "increment",
        "set"
      ],
      "description": "How to handle the usage value. 'increment' (default) adds to the sum (assumes aggregate_usage=sum). 'set' overwrites the value for aggregation modes using last_during_period or last_ever."
    },
    "quantity": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Quantity",
      "examples": [
        100,
        500,
        1000
      ],
      "description": "The usage quantity for the specified timestamp. Must be a positive integer."
    },
    "timestamp": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Timestamp",
      "examples": [
        1640995200,
        1672531200
      ],
      "description": "Unix timestamp (in seconds) indicating when the usage occurred. Must fall within the current billing period, or the call will fail. A short grace period exists at billing period boundaries to account for clock drift."
    },
    "subscription_item": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subscription Item",
      "examples": [
        "si_TepDluBnWaV16o"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the subscription item for which to create the usage record."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_DELETE_APPS_SECRET
Tool to delete a secret from the Stripe Secret Store by name and scope. Use when you need to permanently remove a secret. Requests from UI extensions can only access account-scoped secrets or secrets scoped to their own user.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "DeleteAppsSecretRequest",
  "required": [
    "name",
    "scope_type"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "test_secret_for_deletion",
        "api_key",
        "database_password"
      ],
      "description": "A name for the secret that's unique within the scope. The identifier used when the secret was created."
    },
    "scope_type": {
      "enum": [
        "account",
        "user"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Scope Type",
      "examples": [
        "account",
        "user"
      ],
      "description": "The scope type - either 'account' (accessible to all UI contexts within the account) or 'user' (per-user secrets). Required parameter."
    },
    "scope_user": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Scope User",
      "examples": [
        "user_1234567890",
        "usr_abcdefghij"
      ],
      "description": "User ID - required when scope_type is 'user', omitted for 'account' type. The user whose secret to delete."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for deleting an apps secret."
}
```

## STRIPE_DELETE_CUSTOMER_SUBSCRIPTION_DISCOUNT
Removes currently applied discount from a customer's subscription. Use when you need to remove a discount code or promotion from a specific subscription belonging to a customer.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "DeleteCustomersCustomerSubscriptionsSubscriptionExposedIdDiscountRequest",
  "required": [
    "customer",
    "subscription_exposed_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "pattern": "^cus_[a-zA-Z0-9]+$",
      "examples": [
        "cus_TepCjmF1aMhxII",
        "cus_H9MvQyuT5Qj8KP"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the customer. Must start with 'cus_' followed by alphanumeric characters."
    },
    "subscription_exposed_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subscription Exposed Id",
      "pattern": "^sub_[a-zA-Z0-9]+$",
      "examples": [
        "sub_1ShVY3QvM72TjFrbXlp00Gpc",
        "sub_1NlcNX2eZvKYlo2CFqnrn9ow"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the subscription from which to remove the discount. This is the subscription ID starting with 'sub_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for deleting a customer subscription discount."
}
```

## STRIPE_DELETE_CUSTOMER_TAX_ID
Deletes a customer's tax ID object. Use when you need to remove a specific tax identification from a customer's account.

**Input schema:**
```json

  "type": "object",

    "customer",
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "pattern": "^txi_[a-zA-Z0-9]+$",
      "examples": [
        "txi_1ShVZ3QvM72TjFrbeppaQpMz",
        "txi_1NuMB12eZvKYlo2CMecoWkZd"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the tax ID object to delete. Must start with 'txi_' followed by alphanumeric characters."
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "pattern": "^cus_[a-zA-Z0-9]+$",
      "examples": [
        "cus_TepD4cRc73WGA8",
        "cus_H9MvQyuT5Qj8KP"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the customer whose tax ID will be deleted. Must start with 'cus_' followed by alphanumeric characters."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for deleting a customer's tax ID."
}
```

## STRIPE_DELETE_SUBSCRIPTION_ITEM

## STRIPE_DELETEV1_SUBSCRIPTIONS_LIST_SUBSCRIPTIONS
Tool to cancel a Stripe subscription immediately. Use when you need to permanently cancel a customer's subscription and prevent future charges.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "DELETEV1SubscriptionsListSubscriptionsRequest",
  "required": [
    "subscription_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "prorate": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Prorate",
      "description": "If true, generates a proration credit for remaining unused subscription time. Defaults to false."
    },
    "invoice_now": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Invoice Now",
      "description": "If true, creates a final invoice covering uninvoiced metered usage and pending proration items. Defaults to false."
    },
    "subscription_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subscription Id",
      "examples": [
        "sub_1ShRYcQvM72TjFrbXc451DRs"
      ],
      "description": "The identifier of the subscription to cancel."
    },
    "cancellation_details": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Cancellation Details",
      "description": "Details about the reason for cancellation. Can include 'comment' (string) for additional context and 'feedback' (enum) for customer-provided reason.",
      "additionalProperties": true
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for canceling a subscription."
}
```

## STRIPE_DETACH_PAYMENT_FROM_INVOICE
Tool to detach a payment from an invoice. Use when you need to remove a payment from an invoice's list of payments. Only works with paid or canceled PaymentIntents.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "DetachPaymentFromInvoiceRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "in_1T00bFP3BKO35fWyEzzFPhcy"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the invoice from which to detach the payment."
    },
    "payment_intent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Intent",
      "examples": [
        "pi_3T1KGxP3BKO35fWy16lilCkm"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the PaymentIntent to detach from the invoice. Either payment_intent or payment_record must be provided."
    },
    "payment_record": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Record",
      "examples": [
        "pr_1T00bFP3BKO35fWyEzzFPhcy"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the payment record to detach from the invoice. Either payment_intent or payment_record must be provided."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for detaching a payment from an invoice."
}
```

## STRIPE_DETACH_PAYMENT_METHOD
Detaches a PaymentMethod object from a Customer account. Use when you need to remove a payment method from a customer without deleting it entirely.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "DetachPaymentMethodRequest",
  "required": [
    "payment_method_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "payment_method_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Method Id",
      "examples": [
        "pm_1ShVaIQvM72TjFrbGhpixPWH",
        "pm_1MqLiJLkdIwHu7ixUEgbFdYF"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the payment method to detach from the customer. Must start with 'pm_' followed by alphanumeric characters."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for detaching a payment method from a customer."
}
```

## STRIPE_FINALIZE_INVOICE
Finalize a draft invoice so it becomes open/collectable (and immutable where required). Use when you need to transition an invoice from draft to open status for payment collection.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "FinalizeInvoiceRequest",
  "required": [
    "invoice_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "customer",
          "subscription"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded. Supports dot notation for nested expansions up to 4 levels deep."
    },
    "invoice_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Invoice Id",
      "examples": [
        "in_1ShVoyQvM72TjFrbhGiU9Ap3"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the draft invoice to finalize. Once finalized, the invoice transitions from draft to open status, becomes immutable, and is ready for payment collection."
    },
    "auto_advance": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Auto Advance",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Controls whether Stripe performs automatic collection of the invoice. If false, the invoice's state doesn't automatically advance without an explicit action. Defaults to the invoice's current auto_advance value."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for finalizing a draft Stripe invoice."
}
```

## STRIPE_FINALIZE_QUOTE
Tool to finalize a quote in Stripe. Use when you need to transition a quote from draft status to open status, making it ready to be sent to the customer for acceptance. The quote must have a customer attached before it can be finalized.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "FinalizeQuoteRequest",
  "required": [
    "quote"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "quote": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Quote",
      "examples": [
        "qt_1ShVsZQvM72TjFrblaAdWSKO"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the quote to finalize. Must start with 'qt_'."
    },
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "line_items"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded. For example, ['line_items', 'customer'] to expand those nested objects."
    },
    "expires_at": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Expires At",
      "examples": [
        1735689600
      ],
      "description": "A future timestamp (in seconds since Unix epoch) on which the quote will be canceled if in open or draft status. If provided, this sets when the finalized quote will automatically expire."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for finalizing a quote."
}
```

## STRIPE_FIND_APPS_SECRET
Tool to find a secret by name and scope in the Stripe Apps secret store. Use when you need to retrieve a specific secret's details based on its name and scope.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "FindAppsSecretRequest",
  "required": [
    "name",
    "scope"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "test-secret-find",
        "api-key-prod"
      ],
      "description": "A name for the secret that's unique within the scope."
    },
    "scope": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Scope",
      "required": [
        "type"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "enum": [
            "account",
            "user"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Type",
          "examples": [
            "account",
            "user"
          ],
          "description": "The type of scoping. Valid values are 'account' (secret is accessible to all users and UI extensions in the scope) or 'user' (secret is scoped to a specific user)."
        },
        "user": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "User",
          "examples": [
            "user_123"
          ],
          "description": "The secret's user ID. Required when scope.type is 'user'. The user must be a member of the app's account."
        }
      },
      "description": "Specifies the scoping of the secret.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for finding a secret by name and scope."
}
```

## STRIPE_FUND_TEST_CASH_BALANCE

```json
        "eur",

      "title": "Customer Id",
```

## STRIPE_GET_ACCOUNT_CAPABILITIES
Retrieves a list of all capabilities for a connected Stripe account. Use when you need to check all available capabilities, their statuses, and requirements for an account.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetAccountCapabilitiesRequest",
  "required": [
    "account"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "account": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Account",
      "examples": [
        "acct_1Q11MrQvM72TjFrb",
        "self"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the Stripe account for which to retrieve capabilities. Typically starts with 'acct_'. Use 'self' to retrieve capabilities for the authenticated account."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing account capabilities."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_ACCOUNT_CAPABILITY
Retrieves information about a specific capability for a Stripe account. Use when you need to check the status, requirements, or configuration of a capability such as card payments, transfers, or ACH payments.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetAccountCapabilityRequest",
  "required": [
    "account_id",
    "capability_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "account"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded. Supports dot notation for nested expansions up to 4 levels deep."
    },
    "account_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Account Id",
      "examples": [
        "acct_1Q11MrQvM72TjFrb"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the Stripe account for which to retrieve the capability. Typically starts with 'acct_'."
    },
    "capability_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Capability Id",
      "examples": [
        "card_payments",
        "transfers",
        "us_bank_account_ach_payments"
      ],
      "description": "The specific capability identifier to retrieve (e.g., card_payments, transfers, us_bank_account_ach_payments)."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving an account capability."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_ACCOUNT_PERSON
Retrieves an existing person associated with a Stripe account. Use when you need to check the details, verification status, or requirements of a specific person on an account.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetAccountPersonRequest",
  "required": [
    "account",
    "person"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "person": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Person",
      "examples": [
        "person_1Q11NAQvM72TjFrbp3U2AScI"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the person to retrieve. Typically starts with 'person_'."
    },
    "account": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Account",
      "examples": [
        "acct_1Q11MrQvM72TjFrb"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the Stripe account. Typically starts with 'acct_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving a person from a Stripe account."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_ACCOUNT_PERSONS
Retrieves a list of people associated with the account's legal entity. Use when you need to list all persons for an account, with optional filtering by relationship type.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetAccountPersonsRequest",
  "required": [
    "account"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10."
    },
    "account": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Account",
      "examples": [
        "acct_1Q11MrQvM72TjFrb",
        "acct_1032D82eZvKYlo2C"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the account whose persons will be retrieved."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "person_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. An object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_foo in order to fetch the previous page of the list."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "person_0987654321"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. An object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include starting_after=obj_bar in order to fetch the next page of the list."
    },
    "relationship_owner": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Relationship Owner",
      "description": "A filter on the list of people returned based on whether these people are owners on the account."
    },
    "relationship_director": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Relationship Director",
      "description": "A filter on the list of people returned based on whether these people are directors on the account."
    },
    "relationship_executive": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Relationship Executive",
      "description": "A filter on the list of people returned based on whether these people are executives on the account."
    },
    "relationship_authorizer": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Relationship Authorizer",
      "description": "A filter on the list of people returned based on whether these people are authorizers on the account."
    },
    "relationship_legal_guardian": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Relationship Legal Guardian",
      "description": "A filter on the list of people returned based on whether these people are legal guardians on the account."
    },
    "relationship_representative": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Relationship Representative",
      "description": "A filter on the list of people returned based on whether these people are the representative of the account."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing persons associated with an account."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_ACCOUNTS_ACCOUNT
Retrieves the details of a Stripe account. Use when you need to check account properties like current requirements, live charge capability, payout eligibility, business details, or verification status.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetAccountsAccountRequest",
  "required": [
    "account"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "capabilities",
          "external_accounts"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specifies which fields to expand in the response. Can expand related objects and nested fields up to 4 levels deep using dot notation (e.g., 'capabilities', 'external_accounts', 'business_profile'). Maximum depth of 4 levels."
    },
    "account": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Account",
      "examples": [
        "acct_1Q11MrQvM72TjFrb",
        "self"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the Stripe account to retrieve. Typically starts with 'acct_'. Use 'self' to retrieve the authenticated account."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving a Stripe account."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "DOB": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "DOB",
```

## STRIPE_GET_ACTIVE_ENTITLEMENT
Tool to retrieve an active entitlement describing customer access to a feature. Use when you need to check specific entitlement details for a customer.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetV1EntitlementsActiveEntitlementsActiveEntitlementRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "ent_test_61Tqtf6c6c35r0n3641QvM72TjFrb1QW"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the active entitlement to retrieve."
    },
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "feature"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded. The 'feature' field can be expanded to retrieve the full Feature object instead of just the ID."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving an active entitlement."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_BALANCE_HISTORY
DEPRECATED: Use STRIPE_LIST_BALANCE_TRANSACTIONS instead. Tool to retrieve a list of balance transactions for your Stripe account. Use when you need to view transaction history affecting your balance. Returns all fund movements including charges, refunds, payouts, and fees with filtering options by date, currency, type, or source.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetBalanceHistoryRequest",
  "properties": {
    "type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Type",
      "examples": [
        "charge",
        "refund",
        "payout",
        "transfer",
        "adjustment",
        "application_fee"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by transaction type. Common types include: charge, refund, payout, transfer, application_fee, stripe_fee, adjustment."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of balance transactions to return (1-100). Stripe defaults to 10 if not specified."
    },
    "payout": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payout",
      "examples": [
        "po_12345"
      ],
      "description": "Filter to only include transactions from a specific automatic payout. Provide the payout ID."
    },
    "source": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Source",
      "examples": [
        "ch_12345",
        "re_12345"
      ],
      "description": "Filter to only include transactions associated with a specific source object ID (e.g., charge, refund, payout)."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        "{'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}",
        "{'lt': 1640995200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by creation date using Unix timestamps. Accepted keys: 'gt', 'gte', 'lt', 'lte'.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "currency": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Currency",
      "examples": [
        "usd",
        "eur",
        "gbp"
      ],
      "description": "Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in lowercase (e.g., 'usd', 'eur'). Filters results to transactions in the specified currency only."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "txn_12345"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for pagination. A balance transaction ID that defines your place in the list; returns transactions listed before this one. Cannot be used with starting_after."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "txn_67890"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for pagination. A balance transaction ID that defines your place in the list; returns transactions listed after this one. Cannot be used with ending_before."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_BALANCE_SETTINGS
Tool to retrieve balance settings for a Stripe account. Use when you need to fetch configuration options for customizing account balances and payout settings for a connected account or the authenticated account.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetBalanceSettingsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "stripe_account": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Stripe Account",
      "examples": [
        "acct_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "The connected account ID for which to retrieve balance settings. If not provided, retrieves settings for the authenticated account."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_BALANCE_TRANSACTION
Retrieves the balance transaction with the given ID. Use when you need detailed information about a specific balance transaction including amounts, fees, availability dates, and transaction sources.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetBalanceTransactionRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "txn_3ShVc9QvM72TjFrb1cJmu9zh",
        "txn_1MiN3gLkdIwHu7ixxapQrznl"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier for the balance transaction to retrieve. Balance transaction IDs typically start with 'txn_'."
    },
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "source"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded. For example, use ['source'] to expand the source field to retrieve full details of the Stripe object that triggered the balance transaction."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving a balance transaction."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_BILLING_CREDIT_BALANCE_SUMMARY
Retrieves the credit balance summary for a customer in Stripe Billing. This action returns the available and ledger balances for billing credits granted to a customer. You can filter by a specific credit grant, price type (metered), specific prices, or billable items. The balance summary includes one entry per currency used in the credit grants. Use Cases: - Check remaining billing credits for a customer - View credit balances for specific metered prices or products - Monitor available vs. ledger balance for billing credits - Track credit usage across different currencies

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetBillingCreditBalanceSummaryRequest",
  "required": [
    "filter"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "filter": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Filter",
      "required": [
        "type"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "enum": [
            "applicability_scope",
            "credit_grant"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Type",
          "examples": [
            "applicability_scope",
            "credit_grant"
          ],
          "description": "The type of filter to apply. Must be either 'applicability_scope' or 'credit_grant'."
        },
        "credit_grant": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Credit Grant",
          "examples": [
            "credgr_61U4IOeqqvhUbql8A41P3BKO35fWyH0a"
          ],
          "description": "The Stripe credit grant ID for which to fetch the balance summary. Required when filter type is 'credit_grant'. Starts with 'credgr_'."
        },
        "applicability_scope": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "ApplicabilityScope",
          "properties": {
            "prices": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "object",
                "title": "ApplicabilityScopePrice",
                "required": [
                  "id"
                ],
                "properties": {
                  "id": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Id",
                    "examples": [
                      "price_1SuuY8P3BKO35fWywnIAK8zm"
                    ],
                    "description": "The Stripe price ID. Must be a metered price with an attached billing meter."
                  }
                }
              },
              "title": "Prices",
              "description": "List of specific metered price IDs to filter the balance summary. Cannot be combined with 'price_type' or 'billable_items'."
            },
            "price_type": {
              "type": "string",
              "const": "metered",
              "title": "Price Type",
              "description": "Filter by price type. Use 'metered' to get balance summary for all metered prices. Cannot be combined with 'prices' or 'billable_items'."
            },
            "billable_items": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "object",
                "title": "ApplicabilityScopeBillableItem",
                "required": [
                  "id"
                ],
                "properties": {
                  "id": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Id",
                    "examples": [
                      "billitem_123abc"
                    ],
                    "description": "The Stripe billable item ID. Must be a metered billable item."
                  }
                }
              },
              "title": "Billable Items",
              "description": "List of specific billable item IDs to filter the balance summary. Cannot be combined with 'price_type' or 'prices'."
            }
          },
          "description": "Billing credit scope for fetching balance summary. Required when filter type is 'applicability_scope'.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      },
      "description": "Filtering criteria for the credit balance summary. Specify either 'credit_grant' to get balance for a specific grant, or 'applicability_scope' to filter by price type, specific prices, or billable items.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_Tsff73vDvrw2Rc"
      ],
      "description": "The Stripe customer ID whose credit balance summary is being retrieved. Either 'customer' or 'customer_account' must be specified. Starts with 'cus_'."
    },
    "customer_account": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer Account",
      "examples": [
        "acct_123abc456def"
      ],
      "description": "The Stripe account ID representing the customer. Either 'customer' or 'customer_account' must be specified. Use this for multi-entity accounts."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_BILLING_CREDIT_BALANCE_TRANSACTIONS_ID
Retrieves a credit balance transaction by its unique identifier. Use when you need to get details about a specific credit or debit transaction against a credit grant.

## STRIPE_GET_BILLING_CREDIT_GRANTS
Tool to retrieve a paginated list of billing credit grants. Use when you need to view credit allocations for customers, track promotional credits, or manage billing credits.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetBillingCreditGrantsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Number of objects to return per page (range: 1-100, default: 10)."
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_12345",
        "cus_AbCdEf123456"
      ],
      "description": "Filter results to only include credit grants for a specific customer ID."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "credgr_61U4IQKgLd9zwymHs41P3BKO35fWyCF6",
        "credgr_XyZ789"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for backward pagination - credit grant ID to end before. Use for fetching the previous page."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "credgr_61U4IQM19dEPPwoTi41P3BKO35fWyIme",
        "credgr_AbCdEf123456"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for forward pagination - credit grant ID to start after. Use for fetching the next page."
    },
    "customer_account": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer Account",
      "examples": [
        "acc_12345",
        "acc_AbCdEf123456"
      ],
      "description": "Filter results to only include credit grants for a specific customer account ID."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing billing credit grants."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_BILLING_CREDIT_GRANTS_ID
Retrieves a billing credit grant by its unique identifier. Use when you need to get details about a specific credit grant allocation for a customer.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetBillingCreditGrantsIdRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",

      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier for the credit grant object. Typically starts with 'credgr_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving a billing credit grant."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_BILLING_METERS
Tool to retrieve a list of billing meters from Stripe. Use when you need to list meters with optional filtering by status and pagination support.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetBillingMetersRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of billing meter objects to be returned. The value must be an integer between 1 and 100, inclusive. If not specified, the default is 10."
    },
    "status": {
      "enum": [
        "active",
        "inactive"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Status",
      "examples": [
        "active",
        "inactive"
      ],
      "description": "Filter results by meter status. Valid values are 'active' to return only active meters or 'inactive' to return only inactive meters. If not specified, returns meters of all statuses."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "meter_XYZ123",
        "meter_ABC456"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination to fetch the previous page of results. This is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if a list request returns objects starting with 'meter_XYZ', your subsequent call can include ending_before='meter_XYZ' to fetch the previous page."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "meter_ABC123",
        "meter_XYZ456"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination to fetch the next page of results. This is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if a list request returns objects and the last object's ID is 'meter_ABC', your subsequent call can include starting_after='meter_ABC' to fetch the next page."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing billing meters."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_BILLING_PORTAL_CONFIGURATIONS
Tool to list billing portal configurations. Use when you need to retrieve portal configurations that describe the functionality and settings of the customer portal.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetBillingPortalConfigurationsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of configuration objects to return. Value must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 10 if not specified."
    },
    "active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Active",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Filter configurations by active status. Set to True to return only active configurations, or False for inactive ones."
    },
    "is_default": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Default",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Filter by default configuration. Set to True to return only the default configuration, or False for non-default configurations."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "bpc_1234567890abcdef"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for pagination to fetch the previous page. Provide the ID of the configuration that should end the list."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "bpc_0987654321fedcba"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for pagination to fetch the next page. Provide the ID of the configuration that should start the list."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing billing portal configurations."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_BILLING_PORTAL_CONFIGURATIONS_CONFIGURATION
Tool to retrieve a billing portal configuration from Stripe. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific portal configuration including branding, features, and settings.

**Input schema:**
```json

      "title": "Configuration",
      "examples": [
        "bpc_1ShRSIQvM72TjFrbdMXIKD0E"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier for the billing portal configuration, typically starting with 'bpc_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Specifies the configuration ID to retrieve."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_CHARGES_CHARGE_DISPUTE
Tool to retrieve a dispute for a specified charge. Use when you need to get dispute details associated with a specific charge ID.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetChargesChargeDisputeRequest",
  "required": [
    "charge"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "charge": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Charge",
      "examples": [
        "ch_3ShRXAQvM72TjFrb0GekfkTi"
      ],
      "description": "Identifier for the charge, typically starting with 'ch_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Specifies the charge ID to retrieve dispute for."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_CHARGES_CHARGE_REFUNDS_REFUND
Tool to retrieve the details of an existing refund within a specific charge. Use when you need to get refund information using both the charge ID and refund ID.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetChargesChargeRefundsRefundRequest",
  "required": [
    "charge",
    "refund"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "charge": {
      "type": "string",
```

```json
            {
              "type": "string"
            },
            {
              "type": "object",
              "additionalProperties": true

          ],

        },
        "object": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Object",
          "description": "String representing the object's type. For refund objects, the value is always 'refund'."
        },
        "reason": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Reason",
          "description": "Reason for the refund, which is either user-provided or generated by Stripe internally. Possible values: duplicate, fraudulent, requested_by_customer, expired_uncaptured_charge."
        },
        "status": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Status",
          "description": "The current status of the refund. Possible values are: pending, requires_action, succeeded, failed, canceled."
        },

          "title": "Created",
          "description": "Timestamp (Unix epoch seconds) at which the refund object was created."
        },
```

## STRIPE_GET_CHECKOUT_SESSIONS_SESSION_LINE_ITEMS
Tool to retrieve line items for a Checkout Session. Use when you need to view the items, pricing, quantities, and totals for a specific checkout session.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetCheckoutSessionsSessionLineItemsRequest",
  "required": [
    "session"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10."
    },
    "session": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Session",
      "examples": [
        "cs_test_a15ARrdWNVq2voBjS5hsdMMJuUUbIOUfhok7IXU8gj7xQnGe7dz84YS4h7"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the Checkout Session."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. ending_before is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_bar in order to fetch the previous page of the list."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. starting_after is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include starting_after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_CLIMATE_PRODUCTS_PRODUCT
Tool to retrieve details of a specific Stripe Climate product. Use when you need to get information about a particular carbon removal product including pricing and supplier details.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetClimateProductsProductRequest",
  "required": [
    "product"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "product": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Product",
      "examples": [
        "climsku_planetary_2027",
        "climsku_frontier_offtake_portfolio_2027"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the Climate product to retrieve (e.g., 'climsku_planetary_2027')."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving a climate product."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_CLIMATE_SUPPLIERS_SUPPLIER
Retrieves detailed information about a specific Stripe Climate carbon removal supplier. Returns supplier details including name, carbon removal pathway (biomass, direct air capture, or enhanced weathering), operational locations with geographic coordinates, and additional information URL. Use this to get comprehensive details about a specific supplier after obtaining supplier IDs from the list suppliers endpoint. Note: Requires Stripe Climate access. If you receive an error about submitting an account application, the Stripe account needs to apply for Climate feature access.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetClimateSuppliersSupplierRequest",
  "required": [
    "supplier"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "supplier": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Supplier",
      "examples": [
        "climsup_planetary",
        "climsup_charm_industrial"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the climate supplier to retrieve. Format: 'climsup_' followed by supplier name. Obtain supplier IDs using the list climate suppliers endpoint."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving a climate supplier."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_CONFIRMATION_TOKENS_CONFIRMATION_TOKEN
Tool to retrieve an existing ConfirmationToken object by its ID. Use when you need to access payment method details and customer information that were securely passed during the payment confirmation flow.

**Input schema:**

```json
  ],

      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "payment_method_preview.card"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded. Supports dot notation for nested expansions (e.g., 'payment_intent.customer'). Maximum of four nesting levels allowed."
    },
    "confirmation_token": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Confirmation Token",
      "examples": [
        "ctoken_1ShVa4QvM72TjFrbvXydrIcb"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the ConfirmationToken to retrieve. This ID typically starts with 'ctoken_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving a ConfirmationToken."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_COUPON
Retrieves full details for an existing Stripe coupon using its unique ID. Use when you need to check coupon validity, discount details, or redemption limits.

```json
{

  "required": [
    "coupon_id"
  ],
  "properties": {

      "examples": [
        "SQdMBeqb",
        "25OFF",
        "SUMMER2024"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier for the coupon to retrieve."
    }
  },
  "description": "Specifies the coupon ID to retrieve."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_CREDIT_NOTES_CREDIT_NOTE_LINES
Retrieves the paginated list of line items for a specific credit note. Use when you need complete details of all line items associated with a credit note.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetCreditNotesCreditNoteLinesRequest",
  "required": [
    "credit_note"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        25
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of line items to return (1-100). Defaults to 10 if not specified."
    },
    "credit_note": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Credit Note",
      "examples": [
        "cn_1ShRUMQvM72TjFrbKmZcWXGx"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the credit note whose line items to retrieve."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "cnli_1ABC2DEF3GHI4JKL"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for backward pagination; an object ID that defines your place in the list. Returns the page of results before this object ID."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "cnli_9XYZ8WVU7TSR6QPO"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for forward pagination; an object ID that defines your place in the list. Returns the page of results after this object ID."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving credit note line items."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_CREDIT_NOTES_ID
Retrieves a credit note by its unique identifier. Use when you need to get detailed information about a specific credit note.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetCreditNotesIdRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "cn_1ShRUMQvM72TjFrbKmZcWXGx"
      ],
      "description": "The identifier of the credit note to be retrieved. Typically starts with 'cn_'."
    },
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "customer",
          "invoice"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded. Supports nested expansion up to 4 levels deep (e.g., ['customer', 'invoice.subscription']). Expandable fields include: customer, invoice, refunds, lines.data.invoice_line_item, customer_balance_transaction."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving a credit note."
}
```
