## STRIPE_GET_CREDIT_NOTES_PREVIEW
Tool to preview a credit note without creating it in Stripe. Use when you need to see what a credit note will contain before issuing it.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetCreditNotesPreviewRequest",
  "required": [
    "invoice"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "memo": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Memo",
      "examples": [
        "Credit for returned product"
      ],
      "description": "The credit note's memo appears on the credit note PDF. This can be useful for providing additional information to the customer."
    },
    "lines": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "type": "string"
            },
            {
              "type": "integer"
            },
            {
              "type": "number"
            },
            {
              "type": "boolean"
            },
            {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {}
            },
            {
              "type": "object",
              "additionalProperties": true
            }
          ]
        }
      },
      "title": "Lines",
      "examples": [
        [
          {
            "type": "invoice_line_item",
            "amount": 500,
            "quantity": 1,
            "invoice_line_item": "il_1234"
          }
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Line items that make up the credit note. Each line item object can contain: type (required, one of 'invoice_line_item' or 'custom_line_item'), amount, description, invoice_line_item, quantity, tax_amounts, tax_rates, unit_amount, unit_amount_decimal. At least one of amount, lines, or shipping_cost must be provided."
    },
    "amount": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Amount",
      "examples": [
        1000
      ],
      "description": "The integer amount in cents representing the total amount of the credit note. At least one of amount, lines, or shipping_cost must be provided."
    },
    "reason": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reason",
      "examples": [
        "order_change",
        "product_unsatisfactory"
      ],
      "description": "Reason for issuing this credit note. Possible values: 'duplicate', 'fraudulent', 'order_change', 'product_unsatisfactory'."
    },
    "invoice": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Invoice",
      "examples": [
        "in_1ShVc8QvM72TjFrbA2RbNjst"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the invoice for which the credit note is being previewed. This is required to preview a credit note."
    },
    "refunds": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Refunds",
      "examples": [
        [
          "re_1234567890"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "IDs of existing refunds to link to this credit note."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "order_id": "order_12345",
          "customer_note": "VIP customer"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "email_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Email Type",
      "examples": [
        "credit_note",
        "none"
      ],
      "description": "The type of email that should be sent for this credit note. Possible values: 'credit_note', 'none'. Default is 'credit_note'."
    },
    "effective_at": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Effective At",
      "examples": [
        1640995200
      ],
      "description": "The date when this credit note is in effect. Specified as a Unix timestamp."
    },
    "credit_amount": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Credit Amount",
      "examples": [
        100
      ],
      "description": "The integer amount in cents representing the amount to credit the customer's balance, which will be automatically applied to their next invoice."
    },
    "refund_amount": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Refund Amount",
      "examples": [
        500
      ],
      "description": "The integer amount in cents representing the amount to refund. If set, a refund will be created for the charge associated with the invoice."
    },
    "shipping_cost": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Shipping Cost",
      "examples": [
        {
          "shipping_rate": "shr_1234567890"
        }
      ],
      "description": "The shipping cost to credit. Contains shipping_rate (required if shipping_cost is provided): the ID of the shipping rate to use for this order. At least one of amount, lines, or shipping_cost must be provided.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "out_of_band_amount": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Out Of Band Amount",
      "examples": [
        250
      ],
      "description": "The integer amount in cents representing the amount that is credited outside of Stripe. This is used when a credit is issued via a means other than Stripe."
    }
  }
}

## STRIPE_GET_CREDIT_NOTES_PREVIEW_LINES
Tool to retrieve a credit note preview's line items from Stripe. Use when you need to see what line items would be included in a credit note before creating it.

**Input schema:**
```json

  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetCreditNotesPreviewLinesRequest",

    "invoice"
  ],

    },

For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_bar in order to fetch the previous page of the list."

## STRIPE_GET_CUSTOMERS_CASH_BALANCE_TRANSACTIONS
Tool to retrieve a specific cash balance transaction that updated a customer's cash balance. Use when you need to get details about a particular cash balance transaction for a customer.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetCustomersCashBalanceTransactionsRequest",
  "required": [
    "customer",
    "transaction"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "description": "Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded. Can expand related objects."
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_TepGZkRSejByhc",
        "cus_9s6XKzkNRiz8i3"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier for the customer. Typically starts with 'cus_'."
    },
    "transaction": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Transaction",
      "examples": [
        "ccsbtxn_1ShVduQvM72TjFrbrjW66RBK",
        "ccsbtxn_1Na16B2eZvKYlo2CUhyw3dsF"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier for the cash balance transaction. Typically starts with 'ccsbtxn_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to retrieve a specific cash balance transaction."
}

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",

For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_bar in order to fetch the previous page of the list."
    },

      "title": "Starting After",

For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include starting_after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list."

## STRIPE_GET_CUSTOMERS_CUSTOMER_CARDS_ID
Retrieves details about a specific card for a customer. Use when you need to view card information stored on a customer account.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetCustomersCustomerCardsIdRequest",
  "required": [
    "customer",
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "pattern": "^card_[a-zA-Z0-9]+$",
      "examples": [
        "card_1ShVZEQvM72TjFrboydJc0kf",
        "card_1MvoiELkdIwHu7ix"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the card to retrieve. Must start with 'card_' followed by alphanumeric characters."
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "pattern": "^cus_[a-zA-Z0-9]+$",
      "examples": [
        "cus_TepDKLl2V4Cnb7",
        "cus_NhD8HD2bY8dP3V"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the customer who owns the card. Must start with 'cus_' followed by alphanumeric characters."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving a customer card."
}

      ],

      "examples": [
        "cbt_1234567890",
        "cbt_abcdefghij"
      ],

    }
  }
}

Tool to retrieve the discount currently active on a customer. Use when you need to check a customer's active discount details.

```json

  "type": "object",

  "required": [
    "customer"
  ],
  "properties": {

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",

        "cus_TepEyENDdaRzQh",
        "cus_9s6XKzkNRiz8i3"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the customer whose discount should be retrieved. Must start with 'cus_' followed by alphanumeric characters."

## STRIPE_GET_CUSTOMERS_CUSTOMER_PAYMENT_METHODS
Retrieves a list of payment methods for a given customer, supporting type filtering and pagination.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetCustomersCustomerPaymentMethodsRequest",
  "required": [
    "customer_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Type",
      "examples": [
        "card",
        "sepa_debit",
        "us_bank_account"
      ],
      "description": "Filters the list by payment method type (e.g., 'card', 'sepa_debit')."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Limit on the number of payment methods returned. If not specified, Stripe's default limit (typically 10) applies."
    },
    "customer_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer Id",
      "examples": [
        "cus_123456789"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the customer whose payment methods are to be retrieved."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "description": "Pagination cursor; ID of the first object from a previous request to fetch the preceding page."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "description": "Pagination cursor; ID of the last object from a previous request to fetch the next page."
    },
    "allow_redisplay": {
      "enum": [
        "always",
        "limited",
        "unspecified"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Allow Redisplay",
      "examples": [
        "always",
        "limited",
        "unspecified"
      ],
      "description": "Filter results by the value of allow_redisplay on the payment methods."
    }
  }
}

## STRIPE_GET_CUSTOMERS_CUSTOMER_PAYMENT_METHODS_PAYMENT_METHOD

## STRIPE_GET_CUSTOMERS_CUSTOMER_SOURCES
Tool to list sources for a specified customer. Use when you need to retrieve payment sources (cards) stored on a customer account.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetCustomersCustomerSourcesRequest",
  "required": [
    "customer"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10."
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_TepEFWlTGw5ves",
        "cus_NhD8HD2bY8dP3V"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the customer whose sources will be retrieved."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. This is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_bar in order to fetch the previous page of the list."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. This is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include starting_after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list."
    }
  }
}

## STRIPE_GET_CUSTOMERS_CUSTOMER_SOURCES_ID
Tool to retrieve a specified payment source for a given customer. Use when you need to get details about a specific card, bank account, or payment source attached to a customer. Note: The Sources API is deprecated; consider using PaymentMethods API for new integrations.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetCustomersCustomerSourcesIdRequest",
  "required": [
    "customer",
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "card_1ShVcRQvM72TjFrbRszLPjWv",
        "src_1Nlghd2eZvKYlo2C6RFLJcv4"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the source to retrieve. Can be a Card ID (starts with 'card_'), Bank Account ID (starts with 'ba_'), or Source ID (starts with 'src_')."
    },
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "customer"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded. For example, to expand the customer field, use ['customer']."
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_TepGZkRSejByhc"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the customer who owns the source. Must start with 'cus_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving a customer's payment source."
}

## STRIPE_GET_CUSTOMERS_CUSTOMER_SUBSCRIPTIONS
DEPRECATED: Use STRIPE_LIST_SUBSCRIPTIONS instead. List subscriptions for a specific Stripe customer. By default returns subscriptions that have not been canceled. Use the 'status' parameter to filter by subscription status (e.g., 'active', 'all', 'canceled', 'trialing'). Returns paginated results with subscription details including items, pricing, billing cycles, and payment settings.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetCustomersCustomerSubscriptionsRequest",
  "required": [
    "customer"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        25,
        50
      ],
      "description": "Limit on the number of subscription objects to return (1-100). Default is 10."
    },
    "status": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Status",
      "examples": [
        "active",
        "canceled",
        "all"
      ],
      "description": "Filter subscriptions by status (e.g., 'active', 'all', 'canceled', 'incomplete', 'incomplete_expired', 'trialing', 'past_due', 'unpaid', 'paused', 'ended'). By default, returns active subscriptions and excludes canceled ones."
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_TepGSYCUhQhGEd",
        "cus_12345"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the customer whose subscriptions will be retrieved. Required."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "sub_12345"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for paginating backwards; provide the ID of the subscription that should end the list."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "sub_67890"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for paginating forwards; provide the ID of the subscription that should start the list."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_CUSTOMERS_CUSTOMER_SUBS_SUB_EXPOSED_ID
Tool to retrieve a specific subscription for a customer. Use when you need to get detailed information about a customer's subscription using both customer ID and subscription ID.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetCustomersCustomerSubscriptionsSubscriptionExposedIdRequest",
  "required": [
    "customer",
    "subscription_exposed_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "pattern": "^cus_[a-zA-Z0-9]+$",
      "examples": [
        "cus_TepCVo2WdRL5d5",
        "cus_H9MvQyuT5Qj8KP"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the customer. Must start with 'cus_' followed by alphanumeric characters."
    },
    "subscription_exposed_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subscription Exposed Id",
      "pattern": "^sub_[a-zA-Z0-9]+$",
      "examples": [
        "sub_1ShVYcQvM72TjFrbk8FuYeIw",
        "sub_1NlcNX2eZvKYlo2CFqnrn9ow"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the subscription to retrieve. This is the subscription ID starting with 'sub_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving a customer's subscription."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_CUSTOMERS_CUSTOMER_SUBS_SUB_EXPOSED_ID_DISCOUNT
Tool to retrieve the discount currently applied to a customer's subscription. Use when you need to check if a subscription has an active discount and get details about the coupon or promotion code.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetCustomersCustomerSubscriptionsSubscriptionExposedIdDiscountRequest",
  "required": [
    "customer",
    "subscription_exposed_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "coupon"
        ],
        [
          "customer"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded. For example, use 'coupon' to expand the coupon details within the discount object."
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "pattern": "^cus_[a-zA-Z0-9]+$",
      "examples": [
        "cus_TepCVo2WdRL5d5",
        "cus_H9MvQyuT5Qj8KP"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the customer. Must start with 'cus_' followed by alphanumeric characters."
    },
    "subscription_exposed_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subscription Exposed Id",
      "pattern": "^sub_[a-zA-Z0-9]+$",
      "examples": [
        "sub_1ShVYcQvM72TjFrbk8FuYeIw",
        "sub_1NlcNX2eZvKYlo2CFqnrn9ow"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the subscription. This is the subscription ID starting with 'sub_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving a customer subscription discount."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_EVENTS
Retrieves a list of Stripe events from the past 30 days with filtering and pagination. Use to track API activity and monitor webhook deliveries.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetEventsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Type",
      "examples": [
        "invoice.created",
        "charge.*",
        "customer.subscription.updated"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by specific event name or wildcard pattern (e.g., 'charge.*'). Mutually exclusive with 'types' parameter."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of events to return (1-100). Defaults to 10 if not specified."
    },
    "types": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Types",
      "examples": [
        [
          "invoice.created",
          "charge.succeeded"
        ],
        [
          "customer.*"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Array of up to 20 event names for filtering. Mutually exclusive with 'type' parameter."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        "{'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}",
        "{'gt': 1609459200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by creation date range. Use a dictionary with keys 'gt' (exclusive minimum), 'gte' (inclusive minimum), 'lt' (exclusive maximum), 'lte' (inclusive maximum) and Unix timestamp values.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "evt_12345ABCDEF"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor; retrieves events created before the specified event ID to fetch the previous page."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "evt_67890GHIJKL"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor; retrieves events created after the specified event ID to fetch the next page."
    },
    "delivery_success": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Delivery Success",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Filter by webhook delivery status. True returns successful deliveries, false returns pending or failed."
    }
  }
}

## STRIPE_GET_FX_QUOTE
Retrieve a specific FX (foreign exchange) Quote by its ID. FX Quotes provide exchange rates between currencies that can be locked for a period (5 minutes to 24 hours) to protect against rate fluctuations. Use this to view exchange rate details, lock status, and rate breakdowns including base rates, FX fees, and duration premiums.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetFxQuoteRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "fxq_1ShVgpQvM72TjFrbJE8QPmhn",
        "fxq_1R6BWhL05bA97JHQELB5EROs"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the FX Quote to retrieve. Typically starts with 'fxq_'."
    },
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [],
      "description": "Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded. Expandable fields are returned as IDs by default, but can be expanded into full objects."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving an FX Quote."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_INVOICE_PAYMENTS_ID
Tool to retrieve details of a specific Stripe invoice payment by ID. Use when you need to get information about an existing invoice payment.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetInvoicePaymentsIdRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "inpay_1T1KGkP3BKO35fWy15y4ZqUM",
        "inpay_1MoC3ULkdIwHu7ixZjtGpVl2"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier for the invoice payment to retrieve. This ID typically starts with 'inpay_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for retrieving an invoice payment."
}

## STRIPE_GET_INVOICES_INVOICE
Tool to retrieve a specific invoice by ID. Use when you need to get detailed information about an existing invoice.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetInvoicesInvoiceRequest",
  "required": [
    "invoice"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "customer",
          "subscription"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded. Supports dot notation for nested expansion up to 4 levels deep (e.g., 'customer', 'subscription.default_payment_method')."
    },
    "invoice": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Invoice",
      "examples": [
        "in_1ShVaXQvM72TjFrbu9MgZSua"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the invoice to retrieve. Typically starts with 'in_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving a specific invoice."
}

          "title": "Payments",
          "required": [
            "object",
            "data",
            "has_more",
            "url"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "url": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Url",
              "description": "URL to access this list."
            },
            "data": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "object",
                "title": "InvoicePayment",
                "required": [
                  "id",
                  "object",
                  "amount_paid",
                  "amount_requested",
                  "created",
                  "currency",
                  "invoice",
                  "is_default",
                  "livemode",
                  "status"
                ],
                "properties": {
                  "id": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Id",
                    "description": "Unique identifier for the payment."
                  },
                  "object": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Object",
                    "description": "String representing the object's type."
                  },
                  "status": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Status",
                    "description": "Payment status."
                  },
                  "created": {
                    "type": "integer",
                    "title": "Created",
                    "description": "Creation timestamp."
                  },
                  "invoice": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Invoice",
                    "description": "The invoice this payment is for."
                  },
                  "payment": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "title": "Payment",
                    "description": "Payment details.",
                    "additionalProperties": {
                      "anyOf": [
                        {
                          "type": "string"
                        },
                        {
                          "type": "integer"
                        }
                      ]
                    }
                  },
                  "currency": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Currency",
                    "description": "Three-letter ISO currency code."
                  },
                  "livemode": {
                    "type": "boolean",
                    "title": "Livemode",
                    "description": "Live mode indicator."
                  },
                  "is_default": {
                    "type": "boolean",
                    "title": "Is Default",
                    "description": "Whether this is the default payment."
                  },
                  "amount_paid": {
                    "type": "integer",
                    "title": "Amount Paid",
                    "description": "Amount paid in cents."
                  },
                  "amount_requested": {
                    "type": "integer",
                    "title": "Amount Requested",
                    "description": "Amount requested in cents."
                  }
                },
                "description": "Payment information for the invoice."
              },
              "title": "Data",
              "description": "Array of payment objects."
            },
            "object": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Object",
              "description": "String representing the object's type. Always 'list'."
            },
            "has_more": {
              "type": "boolean",
              "title": "Has More",
              "description": "Whether there are more payments available."
            }
          },
          "description": "List of payments associated with this invoice."
        },
        "subtotal": {
          "type": "integer",

          "description": "Total of all subscriptions, invoice items, and prorations on the invoice."

## STRIPE_GET_INVOICES_INVOICE_LINES
Tool to retrieve a paginated list of line items for a specific invoice. Use when you need to see the individual charges, products, or services included in an invoice.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetInvoicesInvoiceLinesRequest",
  "required": [
    "invoice"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of line items to return (1-100). Defaults to 10 if not specified."
    },
    "invoice": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Invoice",
      "examples": [
        "in_1ShVaXQvM72TjFrbu9MgZSua"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the invoice whose line items to retrieve (e.g., in_1NpHok2eZvKYlo2CyeiBref0)."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "il_9876543210"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for backward pagination; a line item ID from a previous response that defines the end of the current page, used to fetch the preceding page."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "il_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for forward pagination; a line item ID from a previous response that defines the end of the current page, used to fetch the subsequent page."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_MANDATE
Tool to retrieve a Stripe mandate by ID. Use when you need to get authorization details for recurring or single-use payments.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetMandateRequest",
  "required": [
    "mandate_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "payment_method"
        ],
        [
          "on_behalf_of"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded. Options include 'payment_method' and 'on_behalf_of'."
    },
    "mandate_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mandate Id",
      "examples": [
        "mandate_1MvojA2eZvKYlo2CvqTABjZs"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier for the mandate, typically starting with 'mandate_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Specifies the mandate ID to retrieve."
}

## STRIPE_GET_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_RECORDS_ID
Tool to retrieve a specific Payment Attempt Record by ID. Use when you need to get detailed information about a particular payment attempt.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetPaymentAttemptRecordsIdRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "par_65UAi3D52FqXavjaKhp41P3BKO35fWy9D6",
        "par_1234567890abcdef"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the Payment Attempt Record to retrieve. Typically starts with 'par_'."
    },
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "payment_method_details",
          "customer_details"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded. Multiple fields can be specified."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for retrieving a payment attempt record by ID."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_PAYMENT_INTENT_AMOUNT_DETAILS_LINE_ITEMS
Tool to retrieve paginated line items for a PaymentIntent. Use when you need to get detailed product and service information including quantities, prices, discounts, and taxes for a specific payment intent.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetPaymentIntentAmountDetailsLineItemsRequest",
  "required": [
    "payment_intent_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, defaults to 10."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "piadli_9876543210"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for backward pagination. A line item ID that defines your place in the list; returns results before this line item."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "piadli_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for forward pagination. A line item ID that defines your place in the list; returns results after this line item."
    },

## STRIPE_GET_PAYMENT_LINK
Tool to retrieve details of an existing Stripe payment link by ID. Use when you need to get information about a specific payment link.

**Input schema:**
```json

    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {

      },

    "payment_link_id": {
      "type": "string",

      "examples": [
        "plink_1ShVhYQvM72TjFrbleaMQpBG",
        "plink_1MoC3ULkdIwHu7ixZjtGpVl2"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the payment link to retrieve. Typically starts with 'plink_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Specifies the payment link ID to retrieve."
}

## STRIPE_GET_PAYMENT_LINKS_PAYMENT_LINK_LINE_ITEMS
Tool to retrieve paginated line items for a payment link. Use when you need to get detailed product and service information including quantities, prices, discounts, and taxes for a specific payment link.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetPaymentLinksPaymentLinkLineItemsRequest",
  "required": [
    "payment_link"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of line items to return. Must be between 1 and 100. If not specified, the Stripe API defaults to 10."
    },
    "payment_link": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Link",
      "examples": [
        "plink_1ShRWTQvM72TjFrbsSpal3mM"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the payment link to retrieve line items for."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "li_9876543210"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for backward pagination. A line item ID that defines your place in the list; returns results before this line item."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "li_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for forward pagination. A line item ID that defines your place in the list; returns results after this line item."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving payment link line items."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_PAYMENT_METHOD
Retrieves the details of a PaymentMethod object by its unique identifier. Returns information including the payment method type (card, us_bank_account, sepa_debit, etc.), billing details, and type-specific payment information. Use this when you need to view the configuration and details of an existing payment method.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetPaymentMethodRequest",
  "required": [
    "payment_method_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "customer"
        ],
        [
          "customer",
          "billing_details"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Optional list of fields to expand in the response. For example, pass ['customer'] to expand the customer field into a full Customer object instead of just an ID. Supports nested expansion using dot notation (e.g., ['customer.default_source'])."
    },
    "payment_method_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Method Id",
      "examples": [
        "pm_1Q0PsIJvEtkwdCNYMSaVuRz6"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the PaymentMethod to retrieve. Must start with 'pm_' followed by alphanumeric characters."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving a PaymentMethod."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_PAYMENT_METHOD_CONFIGURATION
Tool to retrieve a specific payment method configuration by its unique identifier. Use when you need to inspect the settings and availability of payment methods for a given configuration.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetV1PaymentMethodConfigurationsListPaymentMethodRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "pmc_1S0Fm0QvM72TjFrbeAvcU0LE"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the payment method configuration to retrieve. This ID typically starts with 'pmc_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving a payment method configuration."
}

## STRIPE_GET_PAYMENT_RECORD

      "examples": [
        "pr_65UAi2iYkxze6lfHCL141P3BKO35fWyLtQ"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the Payment Record to retrieve."
    },

      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"

  },

}

## STRIPE_GET_PRICES_PRICE
Retrieves detailed information for a specific Stripe price using its unique ID. Use when you need to fetch price details.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetPricesPriceRequest",
  "required": [
    "price"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "price": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Price",
      "examples": [
        "price_1ShVbZQvM72TjFrboAjecrOj",
        "price_1MoBy5LkdIwHu7ixZhnattbh"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the price to retrieve. This ID typically starts with 'price_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Specifies the price ID to retrieve."
}

## STRIPE_GET_PRODUCTS_ID
Retrieves detailed information for an existing Stripe product using its unique product ID. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific product.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetProductsIdRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "prod_TepFbB27x4Q39a",
        "prod_NWjs8kKbJWmuuc"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the product to retrieve. This ID typically starts with 'prod_'."
    },
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "default_price"
        ],
        [
          "default_price",
          "tax_code"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded. Supports nested expansions using dot notation (e.g., 'default_price'). Maximum depth of four levels."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for retrieving a specific product by ID."
}

## STRIPE_GET_PROMOTION_CODES
Retrieves a list of promotion codes from a Stripe account with optional filters for active status, code value, coupon association, and customer restrictions. Supports cursor-based pagination.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetPromotionCodesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "code": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Code",
      "examples": [
        "SUMMER2023",
        "WELCOME10"
      ],
      "description": "Only return promotion codes that have this case-insensitive code."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of promotion code objects to return (1-100). Default is 10."
    },
    "active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Active",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Filter promotion codes by active status. If true, returns only active codes; if false, returns only inactive codes."
    },
    "coupon": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Coupon",
      "examples": [
        "coupon_123xyz"
      ],
      "description": "Only return promotion codes for this coupon ID."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        {
          "gte": 1609459200,
          "lte": 1640995200
        },
        {
          "gt": 1609459200
        }
      ],
      "description": "Filter based on creation timestamp. Supports sub-parameters: 'gt' (greater than), 'gte' (greater than or equal), 'lt' (less than), 'lte' (less than or equal) with Unix timestamp values.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_123xyz"
      ],
      "description": "Only return promotion codes that are restricted to this customer ID."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "promo_123xyz"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for pagination - returns objects before this object ID."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "promo_456abc"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for pagination - returns objects after this object ID."
    },
    "customer_account": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer Account",
      "examples": [
        "acct_123xyz"
      ],
      "description": "Only return promotion codes that are restricted to this account representing the customer."
    }
  },
  "description": "Parameters for listing promotion codes, with filtering and pagination options."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_QUOTES_QUOTE
Tool to retrieve a quote by ID. Use when you need to get detailed information about a specific Stripe quote, including line items, pricing, and status.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetQuotesQuoteRequest",
  "required": [
    "quote"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "quote": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Quote",
      "examples": [
        "qt_1ShRXLQvM72TjFrb5qBWihJc",
        "qt_1Mr7wVLkdIwHu7ixJYSiPTGq"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the quote to retrieve (e.g., qt_1ShRXLQvM72TjFrb5qBWihJc)."
    },
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "customer"
        ],
        [
          "line_items.data.price",
          "customer"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded as full objects. Supports nested expansion using dot notation (e.g., 'customer', 'line_items.data.price'). Maximum expansion depth is 4 levels."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving a quote."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_QUOTES_QUOTE_COMPUTED_UPFRONT_LINE_ITEMS
Tool to retrieve computed upfront line items for a quote. Use when you need the full paginated list of upfront line items with detailed pricing information including amounts, taxes, and discounts.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetQuotesQuoteComputedUpfrontLineItemsRequest",
  "required": [
    "quote"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of line items to return (range 1-100). Defaults to 10 if not specified."
    },
    "quote": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Quote",
      "examples": [
        "qt_1ShRXLQvM72TjFrb5qBWihJc"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the quote to retrieve computed upfront line items for."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "li_0987654321"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for pagination. A line item ID that defines your place in the list. Returns line items listed before this item."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "li_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for pagination. A line item ID that defines your place in the list. Returns line items listed after this item."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_QUOTES_QUOTE_LINE_ITEMS
Tool to retrieve a paginated list of line items for a quote. Use when you need to get details about the items included in a specific Stripe quote.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetQuotesQuoteLineItemsRequest",
  "required": [
    "quote"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10."
    },
    "quote": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Quote",
      "examples": [
        "qt_1ShRXLQvM72TjFrb5qBWihJc",
        "qt_1Mr7wVLkdIwHu7ixJYSiPTGq"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the quote (e.g., qt_1Mr7wVLkdIwHu7ixJYSiPTGq)"
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "li_1Mr7wVLkdIwHu7ixBJJ8ww4j"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. ending_before is an object ID that defines your place in the list."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "li_1Mr7wVLkdIwHu7ixBJJ8ww4j"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. starting_after is an object ID that defines your place in the list."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for retrieving a quote's line items."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_RADAR_VALUE_LIST_ITEMS
Tool to list all value list items from a Stripe Radar value list. Use when you need to retrieve items from a specific value list for fraud detection rules. Returns items sorted by creation date in descending order with pagination support.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetRadarValueListItemsRequest",
  "required": [
    "value_list"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Number of results to return per request. Range: 1-100. Defaults to 10 if not specified."
    },
    "value": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Value",
      "examples": [
        "192.168.1.1",
        "example.com",
        "US"
      ],
      "description": "Filter to match items with values 'like' this string. Maximum length: 800 characters."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        "{'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}",
        "{'gt': 1609459200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filters value list items by creation date using a dictionary with keys like 'gt' (greater than), 'gte' (greater than or equal to), 'lt' (less than), or 'lte' (less than or equal to) and Unix timestamp values (seconds since epoch).",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "value_list": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Value List",
      "examples": [
        "rsl_1Q11MrQvM72TjFrbYxQPYIkh",
        "rsl_1MxxosLkdIwHu7ixNiiD01Kj"
      ],
      "description": "The identifier of the parent value list to retrieve items from. Required."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "rsli_1234567890abcdef",
        "rsli_abcdefghij123456"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor for backward navigation. Object ID to end before, used for fetching the previous page of results."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "rsli_1234567890abcdef",
        "rsli_abcdefghij123456"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor for forward navigation. Object ID to start after, used for fetching the next page of results."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing Stripe Radar value list items."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json

## STRIPE_GET_REFUNDS_REFUND
Tool to retrieve details of a specific Stripe refund by ID. Use when you need to get information about an existing refund.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetRefundsRefundRequest",
  "required": [
    "refund"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "refund": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Refund",
      "examples": [
        "re_3ShVc9QvM72TjFrb1K7arMeK",
        "re_1Nispe2eZvKYlo2Cd31jOCgZ"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier for the refund to retrieve. This ID typically starts with 're_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for retrieving a refund."
}

## STRIPE_GET_SETUP_ATTEMPTS
Tool to list SetupAttempts associated with a SetupIntent. Use when you need to retrieve all setup attempts for a specific SetupIntent to understand the payment method setup process and any errors that occurred.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetSetupAttemptsRequest",
  "required": [
    "setup_intent"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        {
          "gte": 1609459200,
          "lte": 1640995200
        },
        {
          "gt": 1609459200
        }
      ],
      "description": "Filter by creation date using Unix timestamps. Supported keys: 'gt' (greater than), 'gte' (greater than or equal), 'lt' (less than), 'lte' (less than or equal).",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "setup_intent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Setup Intent",
      "examples": [
        "seti_1ShVdFQvM72TjFrbDeR7i7T0"
      ],
      "description": "Filter results to only SetupAttempts created by the specified SetupIntent ID. This parameter is required."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "setatt_12345"

## STRIPE_GET_SETUP_INTENT
Retrieves details of a SetupIntent by its ID; `client_secret` is required if a publishable API key is used.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetSetupIntentRequest",
  "required": [
    "setup_intent_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "client_secret": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Client Secret",
      "examples": [
        "seti_1ShW1TQvM72TjFrbM619nvfU_secret_abc123"
      ],
      "description": "Client secret for the SetupIntent. Required if using a publishable key for authentication."
    },
    "setup_intent_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Setup Intent Id",
      "examples": [
        "seti_1ShW1TQvM72TjFrbM619nvfU"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the SetupIntent to retrieve."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving a SetupIntent."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_SOURCES_SOURCE
Retrieves an existing source object. DEPRECATED: The Stripe Sources API has been deprecated. This action can only retrieve existing sources created before the API deprecation. For new integrations, use the Payment Methods API instead. Use this action when you need to fetch up-to-date information about a specific source that was previously created (e.g., to check its status, view owner information, or access transaction details).

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetSourcesSourceRequest",
  "required": [
    "source_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "source_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Source Id",
      "examples": [
        "src_1ShVdNQvM72TjFrbDVdaE5ix"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the source to retrieve. Typically starts with 'src_'."
    },
    "client_secret": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Client Secret",
      "description": "The client secret of the source. Required if a publishable key is used to retrieve the source."

  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving a source."
}

## STRIPE_GET_SUBSCRIPTION
Retrieves detailed information for an existing Stripe subscription using its unique ID.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetSubscriptionRequest",
  "required": [
    "subscription_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "subscription_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subscription Id",
      "examples": [
        "sub_1MowQVLkdIwHu7ixeRlqHVzs",
        "sub_AYZk9Tm3W2xY6Z"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the Stripe subscription to retrieve, typically starting with 'sub_'."
    }
  }
}

## STRIPE_GET_SUBSCRIPTION_ITEM
Retrieves detailed information for a specific subscription item using its unique ID. Use when you need to fetch subscription item details, pricing, or billing information.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetSubscriptionItemRequest",
  "required": [
    "subscription_item_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "subscription_item_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subscription Item Id",
      "examples": [
        "si_NcLYdDxLHxlFo7",
        "si_Tephjk9QH4RLUF"
      ],
      "description": "The identifier of the subscription item to retrieve, typically starting with 'si_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Specifies the subscription item ID to retrieve."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_SUBSCRIPTION_SCHEDULES_SCHEDULE
Retrieve a subscription schedule using its unique identifier. Use when you need to view details of an existing schedule including phases, settings, and status.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetSubscriptionSchedulesScheduleRequest",
  "required": [
    "schedule"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "customer"
        ],
        [
          "customer",
          "subscription"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specifies which fields to expand into full objects. Supports up to 4 levels of nesting. Expandable fields include: application, customer, subscription, test_clock."
    },
    "schedule": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Schedule",
      "examples": [
        "sub_sched_1Mr3YdLkdIwHu7ixjop3qtff",
        "sub_sched_1ShRYjQvM72TjFrbIeqKLj55"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier for the subscription schedule (e.g., sub_sched_1ShRYjQvM72TjFrbIeqKLj55)"
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving a subscription schedule."
}

## STRIPE_GET_TAX_CALCULATION
Retrieves a Tax Calculation object by its unique ID. Use when you need to access tax calculation details.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetTaxCalculationRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "taxcalc_1ShVilQvM72TjFrbFNrZ4APP"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier for the Tax Calculation object to retrieve (e.g., taxcalc_1OduxkBUZ691iUZ4iWvpMApI)."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving a tax calculation."
}

## STRIPE_GET_TAX_CALCULATIONS_CALCULATION_LINE_ITEMS
Retrieves line items of a tax calculation as a paginated collection. Use this to see detailed tax information for each item in the calculation, including amounts, tax breakdowns, and tax rates.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetTaxCalculationsCalculationLineItemsRequest",
  "required": [
    "calculation"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10."
    },
    "calculation": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Calculation",
      "examples": [
        "taxcalc_1ShVdrQvM72TjFrbv0ckTcMh",
        "taxcalc_1NpJD42eZvKYlo2CUti522cz"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the tax calculation whose line items you want to retrieve. Typically starts with 'taxcalc_'."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "txlitm_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. An object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_foo in order to fetch the previous page of the list. Maximum 500 characters."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "txlitm_0987654321"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. An object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include starting_after=obj_bar in order to fetch the next page of the list. Maximum 500 characters."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to retrieve tax calculation line items."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_TAX_TRANSACTIONS_TRANSACTION_LINE_ITEMS
Retrieves the line items of a committed standalone tax transaction. Use when you need to view detailed line-by-line breakdown of a tax transaction.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetTaxTransactionsTransactionLineItemsRequest",
  "required": [
    "transaction"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of line items to return (1-100, default is 10 if not specified)."
    },
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "data.product"
        ],
        [
          "data.reversal"
        ],
        [
          "data.product",
          "data.reversal"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded to show full objects instead of IDs. Examples: 'data.product' to expand product details, 'data.reversal' to expand reversal information."
    },
    "transaction": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Transaction",
      "examples": [
        "tax_1ShVeIQvM72TjFrbwhxJerZS"
      ],
      "description": "The tax transaction ID to retrieve line items for."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "txli_12345"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for pagination. A line item ID that defines your place in the list; returns items listed before this item. Use to fetch the previous page."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "txli_67890"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for pagination. A line item ID that defines your place in the list; returns items listed after this item. Use to fetch the next page."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_TERMINAL_CONFIGURATION

        "tmc_FQqbaQCiy0m1xc"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier for the terminal configuration to retrieve (e.g., 'tmc_test_61TqpHTmP4zMHAj9T41QvM72TjFrb6To')."

}

## STRIPE_GET_TERMINAL_LOCATION
Tool to retrieve a Terminal Location object by ID. Use when you need to get details about a specific terminal location for managing card readers.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetTerminalLocationRequest",
  "required": [
    "location"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "location": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Location",
      "examples": [
        "tml_GUce3woMEW9K8a",
        "tml_FBakXQG8bQk4Mm"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the Terminal Location to retrieve. Typically starts with 'tml_' followed by alphanumeric characters."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving a terminal location."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_TERMINAL_READER
Tool to retrieve a Terminal Reader object by ID. Use when you need to get details about a specific reader device for accepting payment details in Stripe Terminal.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetTerminalReaderRequest",
  "required": [
    "reader"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "location"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded. Supports expandable fields like 'location'. Maximum expansion depth is 4 levels."
    },
    "reader": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reader",
      "pattern": "^tmr_[a-zA-Z0-9]+$",
      "examples": [
        "tmr_GUdcwgDR2JSTJB",
        "tmr_FDOt2wlRZEdpd7"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the Terminal Reader to retrieve. Must start with 'tmr_' followed by alphanumeric characters."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving a terminal reader."
}
```

  "required": [
    "test_clock"
  ],

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Test Clock",
      "examples": [

        "clock_1Mr3I22eZvKYlo2Ck0rgMqd7"

## STRIPE_GET_TOKEN
Retrieves the token with the given ID. Use when you need to verify token details or check if a token has been used.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetTokenRequest",
  "required": [
    "token"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "token": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Token",
      "examples": [
        "tok_1N3T00LkdIwHu7ixt44h1F8k",
        "btok_1ShVeHQvM72TjFrbrVZvNVOK",
        "cvctok_1SuuwfP3BKO35fWydGxVanFv"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the desired token. Card tokens start with 'tok_', bank tokens with 'btok_', and CVC update tokens with 'cvctok_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Specifies the token ID to retrieve."
}

## STRIPE_GET_UPCOMING_INVOICE_LINE_ITEMS
Tool to retrieve a paginated list of line items for an upcoming invoice preview. Use when you need to see detailed line items before an invoice is finalized.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetUpcomingInvoiceLineItemsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of line items to return (range: 1-100, default: 10)."
    },
    "coupon": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Coupon",
      "examples": [
        "SUMMER2023"
      ],
      "description": "Coupon ID to apply (deprecated - use discounts instead)."
    },
    "currency": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Currency",
      "examples": [
        "usd",
        "eur",
        "gbp"
      ],
      "description": "Three-letter ISO currency code for preview (defaults to customer's currency)."
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_TepioVnDiYEEbz"
      ],
      "description": "Customer ID whose upcoming invoice line items to retrieve. Either customer, subscription, or schedule is required."
    },
    "schedule": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Schedule",
      "examples": [
        "schedule_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "Schedule ID for upcoming invoice line items. Cannot be used with subscription."
    },
    "discounts": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": {
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "title": "Discounts",
      "examples": [
        [
          {
            "coupon": "SUMMER2023"
          }
        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of discount objects to apply. Each object must contain one of: coupon, discount, or promotion_code."
    },
    "preview_mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Preview Mode",
      "examples": [
        "next",
        "recurring"
      ],
      "description": "Preview calculation type: 'next' for next invoice or 'recurring' for recurring totals."
    },
    "subscription": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subscription",
      "examples": [
        "sub_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "Subscription ID for upcoming invoice line items. Cannot be used with schedule."
    },
    "automatic_tax": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Automatic Tax",
      "examples": [
        {
          "enabled": true
        }
      ],
      "description": "Settings for automatic tax lookup. Must include 'enabled' boolean.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "anyOf": [
          {
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          {
            "type": "string"
          },
          {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": {
              "type": "string"
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "il_0987654321"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for backward pagination; returns line items before this ID. Mutually exclusive with starting_after."
    },
    "invoice_items": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "type": "integer"
            },
            {
              "type": "string"
            },
            {
              "type": "boolean"
            },
            {
              "type": "object",
              "additionalProperties": {
                "anyOf": [
                  {
                    "type": "string"
                  },
                  {
                    "type": "integer"
                  }
                ]
              }
            }
          ]
        }
      },
      "title": "Invoice Items",
      "description": "Invoice items to add or update (max 250 items)."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "il_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for forward pagination; returns line items after this ID."
    }
  }
}

## STRIPE_GET_V1_CUSTOMERS_SEARCH_CUSTOMERS
Tool to search for Stripe customers using Stripe's Search Query Language. Use when you need to find customers by email, metadata, creation date, or other customer attributes.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetV1CustomersSearchCustomersRequest",
  "required": [
    "query"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "page": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Page",
      "examples": [
        "cus_1N2M3O4P5Q6R7S8T_page_2"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor for retrieving a specific page. Omit for the first page. Use the next_page value from a previous response for subsequent pages."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of results per page. Range: 1-100. Defaults to 10 if not specified."
    },
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "examples": [
        "email:'[email protected]'",
        "name~'John'",
        "phone:'+19999999999'",
        "metadata['foo']:'bar'",
        "created>1609459200",
        "email~'test' AND created>1609459200"
      ],
      "description": "Search query using Stripe's Search Query Language. REQUIRED FORMAT: queries MUST use field:value or field~value syntax with a supported field prefix. Bare strings without field prefixes are invalid. Searchable fields: 'name' (customer name), 'email' (email address), 'phone' (phone number), 'metadata[\"key\"]' (metadata values), 'created' (Unix timestamp). Operators: ':' (exact match, case insensitive), '~' (substring match, min 3 chars), '>', '<', '>=', '<=' (numeric comparison for created field). Combine clauses with 'AND' or 'OR' (max 10 clauses, cannot mix AND/OR). Use '-' to negate. Quote string values."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for searching customers in Stripe."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_V1_DISPUTES_DISPUTES
Retrieves detailed information for an existing Stripe dispute by ID. Use when you need to get complete dispute details including evidence, status, and payment information.

**Input schema:**
```json

  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetV1DisputesDisputesRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],

    "id": {
      "type": "string",

      "examples": [
        "du_1ShRXCQvM72TjFrbDgp87FQx"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier for the dispute object, typically starting with 'du_'."
    },
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "charge"
        ],
        [
          "payment_intent.customer"
        ]

## STRIPE_GET_V1_INVOICE_PAYMENTS_OVERVIEW2
Tool to list invoice payments in Stripe with pagination and filtering options. Use when you need to retrieve payment records associated with invoices.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetV1InvoicePaymentsOverview2Request",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        "10",
        "25",
        "100"
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of objects to return (1-100). Defaults to 10 if not specified."
    },
    "status": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Status",
      "examples": [
        "paid",
        "open",
        "canceled"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by payment status. Possible values: 'paid', 'open', or 'canceled'."
    },
    "invoice": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Invoice",
      "examples": [
        "in_1ABC2DEF3GHI4JK"
      ],
      "description": "The identifier of the specific invoice whose payments to retrieve."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "invpay_1ABC2DEF3GHI4JK"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for backward pagination using an object ID from a previous response."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "invpay_1ABC2DEF3GHI4JK"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for forward pagination using an object ID from a previous response."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_V1_PAYMENT_METHOD_CONFIGS_LIST_PAYMENT_METHOD2
Tool to list all payment method configurations in a Stripe account. Use when you need to retrieve available payment method settings with optional pagination and filtering.

**Input schema:**
```json

      "examples": [

        "ca_456def"
      ],
      "description": "Filter results by Connect application identifier. Maximum 100 characters."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",

    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "pmc_123abc",
        "pmc_456def"

    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing payment method configurations."
}

## STRIPE_GET_V1_PAYMENT_METHOD_DOMAINS
Tool to retrieve list of payment method domains registered with Stripe account. Use when you need to list all payment method domain objects with optional filtering by domain name and enabled status.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetV1PaymentMethodDomainsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        3,
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Limit on number of objects to return. Range: 1-100. Defaults to 10 if unspecified."
    },
    "enabled": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Enabled",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Filter by domain activation status. Disabled domains won't display payment methods in Elements or Embedded Checkout."
    },
    "domain_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Domain Name",
      "examples": [
        "example.com",
        "shop.mystore.com"
      ],
      "description": "The domain name that this payment method domain object represents. Used to filter results by specific domain."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "pmd_1234567890abcdef",
        "pmd_abcdefghij123456"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for pagination. Object ID that defines your place in the list to fetch previous pages."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "pmd_1234567890abcdef",
        "pmd_abcdefghij123456"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for pagination. Object ID that defines your place in the list to fetch subsequent pages."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing payment method domains."
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_V1_PAYMENT_METHODS_PAYMENT_METHODS2
Tool to retrieve a list of PaymentMethods with filtering and pagination support. Use when you need to list payment methods, optionally filtering by customer, type, or redisplay settings.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetV1PaymentMethodsPaymentMethods2Request",
  "properties": {
    "type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Type",
      "examples": [
        "card",
        "us_bank_account",
        "sepa_debit"
      ],
      "description": "Filters results by payment method type (e.g., card, us_bank_account, sepa_debit). Excludes 'custom' type when unfiltered."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100. Default is 10."
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_123456789"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the customer whose PaymentMethods will be retrieved."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "description": "A cursor for reverse pagination, following similar mechanics to starting_after."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "description": "A cursor for pagination. If you receive 100 objects ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include starting_after=obj_foo to fetch the next page."
    },
    "allow_redisplay": {
      "enum": [
        "always",
        "limited",
        "unspecified"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Allow Redisplay",
      "description": "Filters by whether payment method can display in checkout flows. Values: 'always', 'limited', 'unspecified'."
    },
    "customer_account": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer Account",
      "examples": [
        "acct_123456789"
      ],
      "description": "ID for retrieving Account-specific PaymentMethods."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_V1_RADAR_EARLY_FRAUD_WARNINGS_OVERVIEW
Returns a list of early fraud warnings. An early fraud warning indicates that the card issuer has notified Stripe that a charge may be fraudulent. Use when you need to review potentially fraudulent charges to decide whether to refund them proactively.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetV1RadarEarlyFraudWarningsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        10,

## STRIPE_GET_V1_RADAR_VALUE_LISTS_OVERVIEW_RADAR_VALUE_LISTS
Tool to retrieve an overview of Radar value lists. Use when you need to get a list of value lists used in Stripe Radar for fraud prevention.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetV1RadarValueListsOverviewRequest",
  "properties": {
    "alias": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Alias",
      "examples": [
        "email_list",
        "card_bin_list"
      ],
      "description": "The alias used to reference the value list in rules. Maximum 100 characters."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        "10",
        "25",
        "100"
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        "{'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}",
        "{'gt': 1609459200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filters by creation date. Use a dictionary with keys like 'gte', 'lte', 'gt', 'lt' and Unix timestamp values (e.g., {'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}).",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "contains": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Contains",
      "examples": [
        "user@example.com",
        "411111"
      ],
      "description": "A value contained within a value list - returns all value lists containing this value. Maximum 800 characters."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "rsl_1234567890",
        "rsl_abcdefghij"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. ending_before is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_bar in order to fetch the previous page of the list."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "rsl_9876543210",
        "rsl_zyxwvutsrq"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. starting_after is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include starting_after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing Radar value lists."
}
