## STRIPE_GET_V1_SHIPPING_RATES_OVERVIEW2
Tool to retrieve an overview of shipping rates from Stripe. Use when you need a quick summary of recent shipping rates with default limit of 3.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetV1ShippingRatesOverview2Request",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "default": 3,
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        3,
        5,
        10
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 3 for overview."
    },
    "active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Active",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Only return shipping rates that are active or inactive."
    },
    "currency": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Currency",
      "examples": [
        "usd",
        "eur",
        "gbp"
      ],
      "description": "Only return shipping rates for the given three-letter ISO currency code (e.g., usd), in lowercase."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "shr_1FexQo2eZvKYlo2CTPZ2f5sF"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. Returns objects listed before this object ID."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "shr_1FexQo2eZvKYlo2CTPZ2f5sF"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. Returns objects listed after this object ID."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for getting shipping rates overview."
}

## STRIPE_GET_V1_SUBSCRIPTION_SCHEDULES_OVERVIEW2
Retrieves a list of subscription schedules with optional filtering and pagination capabilities. Use to view scheduled subscription changes for customers.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetV1SubscriptionSchedulesOverview2Request",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Number of objects to return (1-100, default: 10)."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        "{'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by creation date interval using operators: gt, gte, lt, lte. Use a dictionary with keys like 'gt', 'gte', 'lt', 'lte' and Unix timestamp values.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_12345"
      ],
      "description": "Filter results to a specific customer ID."
    },
    "scheduled": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Scheduled",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Returns only schedules that have not yet started."
    },
    "canceled_at": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Canceled At",
      "examples": [
        "{'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by cancellation date interval using operators: gt, gte, lt, lte. Use a dictionary with keys like 'gt', 'gte', 'lt', 'lte' and Unix timestamp values.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "released_at": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Released At",
      "examples": [
        "{'gt': 1609459200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by release date interval using operators: gt, gte, lt, lte. Use a dictionary with keys like 'gt', 'gte', 'lt', 'lte' and Unix timestamp values.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "completed_at": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Completed At",
      "examples": [
        "{'gte': 1609459200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by completion date interval using operators: gt, gte, lt, lte. Use a dictionary with keys like 'gt', 'gte', 'lt', 'lte' and Unix timestamp values.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "sub_sched_12345"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor for fetching previous pages. Provide the ID of the subscription schedule that should end the list."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "sub_sched_67890"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor for fetching subsequent pages. Provide the ID of the subscription schedule that should start the list."
    },
    "customer_account": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer Account",
      "examples": [
        "acct_12345"
      ],
      "description": "Filter results to a specific account."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_GET_V1_TAX_CODES_TAX_CODE2
Tool to retrieve all tax codes available to add to Products for specific tax calculations. Use when you need to list available Stripe tax codes for product classification.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetV1TaxCodesTaxCode2Request",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        5,
        10,
        25
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "txcd_99999999"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. ending_before is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_bar in order to fetch the previous page of the list."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "txcd_99999999"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. starting_after is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include starting_after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing Stripe tax codes."
}

**Input schema:**

{

    "limit": {

      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],

    },
    "owner_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Owner Type",
      "examples": [
        "customer",
        "account",
        "self"
      ],
      "description": "Type of owner. One of: account, application, customer, or self. Required if filtering by owner."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "txid_0987654321"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. ending_before is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_bar in order to fetch the previous page of the list."
    },
    "owner_account": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Owner Account",
      "examples": [
        "acct_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the connected account (required if owner_type=account)."
    },
    "owner_customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Owner Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the customer (required if owner_type=customer)."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "txid_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. starting_after is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include starting_after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list."
    },
    "owner_customer_account": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Owner Customer Account",
      "examples": [
        "acct_0987654321"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the account representing the customer (alternative to owner_customer)."
    }
  }
}

## STRIPE_GET_V1_TAX_RATES_TAX_RATE2
Tool to retrieve all tax rates with pagination support. Use when you need to list Stripe tax rates with optional filters for active status, inclusive/exclusive type, and creation date.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetV1TaxRatesTaxRate2Request",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        5,
        10,
        25
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10."
    },
    "active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Active",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Filters results to only active or inactive (archived) tax rates. When true, returns only active tax rates. When false, returns only inactive tax rates."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        {
          "gt": 1678886400
        },
        {
          "gte": 1678886400,
          "lte": 1678972800
        }
      ],
      "description": "A filter on the list based on the object created field. The value can be a dictionary with keys like 'gt', 'gte', 'lt', 'lte' with Unix timestamp values.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "inclusive": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Inclusive",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Filters results for tax rates that are inclusive (tax included in price) or non-inclusive (tax added to price). When true, returns only inclusive tax rates. When false, returns only non-inclusive tax rates."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "txr_1MoR1ZAJ9E0EN1s9xQxZY7S3"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. ending_before is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_bar in order to fetch the previous page of the list."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "txr_1MoQxRAJ9E0EN1s9sDLSUgup"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. starting_after is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include starting_after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing Stripe tax rates."
}
```

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "TaxRateObject": {
      "type": "object",

      "required": [
        "id",
        "object",
        "active",

        "display_name",
        "inclusive",
        "livemode",
        "percentage"
      ],

          "type": "string",

        },
        "active": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Active",
          "description": "Defaults to true. When set to false, this tax rate cannot be used with new applications or Checkout Sessions, but will still work for subscriptions and invoices that already have it set."
        },
        "object": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Object",
          "description": "String representing the object's type. Always 'tax_rate'."
        },
        "country": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Country",
          "description": "Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)."
        },
        "created": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Created",
          "description": "Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch."
        },
        "livemode": {

        },

            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "tax_type": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Tax Type",
          "description": "The high-level tax type. Possible values include: vat, sales_tax, gst, jct, pst, qst, rst, hst, and others depending on jurisdiction."
        },
        "inclusive": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Inclusive",

        },

## STRIPE_LIST_ALL_SUBSCRIPTION_ITEM_PERIOD_SUMMARIES
Tool to list all subscription item period summaries. Use when you need to retrieve usage information for a specific subscription item over billing periods. Returns summaries sorted in reverse-chronological order (newest first), with the first item representing the most current usage period.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListAllSubscriptionItemPeriodSummariesRequest",
  "required": [
    "subscription_item"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "sis_xyz789"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. ending_before is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_bar in order to fetch the previous page of the list."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "sis_abc123"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. starting_after is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include starting_after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list."
    },
    "subscription_item": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subscription Item",
      "examples": [
        "si_TepDluBnWaV16o"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the subscription item whose usage record summaries to retrieve."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**

## STRIPE_LIST_APPLE_PAY_DOMAINS
Retrieves a list of Apple Pay domains registered with Stripe. Use when you need to fetch all registered Apple Pay domains with pagination support.

**Input schema:**

For instance, if you make a list request and receive 10 objects, starting with apd_bar, your subsequent call can include ending_before=apd_bar in order to fetch the previous page of the list."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "apd_1A2B3C4D5E6F7G8H",
        "apd_9Z8Y7X6W5V4U3T2S"

For instance, if you make a list request and receive 10 objects, ending with apd_foo, your subsequent call can include starting_after=apd_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list."

}

## STRIPE_LIST_APPLICATION_FEES
Returns a list of application fees you've previously collected, sorted by creation date descending (newest first). Use when you need to retrieve application fees with optional filtering by charge and pagination support.

    },

      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",

For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_bar in order to fetch the previous page of the list."

    "starting_after": {

For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include starting_after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list."

  },

}

## STRIPE_LIST_APPS_SECRETS
Tool to list all secrets stored on the given scope. Use when you need to retrieve secrets from the Secret Store API for Stripe Apps.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListAppsSecretsRequest",
  "required": [
    "scope_type"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        50,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Number of objects to return (1-100). Defaults to 10 if not specified."
    },
    "scope_type": {
      "enum": [
        "account",
        "user"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Scope Type",
      "examples": [
        "account",
        "user"
      ],
      "description": "The scope type - either 'account' (accessible to all UI contexts within the account) or 'user' (per-user secrets). Required parameter."
    },
    "scope_user": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Scope User",
      "examples": [
        "user_1234567890",
        "usr_abcdefghij"
      ],
      "description": "User ID - required when scope_type is 'user', omitted for 'account' type. The user whose secrets to retrieve."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "appsecret_1234567890",
        "appsecret_abcdefghij"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for pagination - an object ID that defines your place in the list for backward navigation. Used to fetch the previous page of results."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "appsecret_1234567890",
        "appsecret_abcdefghij"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for pagination - an object ID that defines your place in the list for forward navigation. Used to fetch the next page of results."
    }
  }
}

## STRIPE_LIST_BALANCE_TRANSACTIONS
Lists Stripe balance transactions sorted by creation date descending (newest first), with optional filtering by currency, type, source, or payout and pagination support. Use to retrieve transactions that have contributed to your Stripe account balance.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListBalanceTransactionsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Type",
      "examples": [
        "charge",
        "payment",
        "refund",
        "payout"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by transaction type. Options include: adjustment, advance, advance_funding, anticipation_repayment, application_fee, application_fee_refund, charge, climate_order_purchase, climate_order_refund, connect_collection_transfer, contribution, issuing_authorization_hold, issuing_authorization_release, issuing_dispute, issuing_transaction, obligation_outbound, obligation_reversal_inbound, payment, payment_failure_refund, payment_network_reserve_hold, payment_network_reserve_release, payment_refund, payment_reversal, payment_unreconciled, payout, payout_cancel, payout_failure, refund, refund_failure, reserve_transaction, reserved_funds, stripe_fee, stripe_fx_fee, tax_fee, topup, topup_reversal, transfer, transfer_cancel, transfer_failure, transfer_refund."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Number of objects to return (1-100). Default is 10."
    },
    "payout": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payout",
      "examples": [
        "po_1FexRa2eZvKYlo2CSzC2V7n9"
      ],
      "description": "For automatic Stripe payouts only, returns transactions paid out on the specified payout ID."
    },
    "source": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Source",
      "examples": [
        "ch_1FexPY2eZvKYlo2CHNYh111N"
      ],
      "description": "Returns only transactions related to a specific source object ID."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        "{'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}",
        "{'lt': 1640995200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by creation date using a dictionary with keys like 'gt', 'gte', 'lt', 'lte' and Unix timestamp values.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "currency": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Currency",
      "examples": [
        "usd",
        "eur",
        "gbp"
      ],
      "description": "Three-letter ISO currency code in lowercase for filtering (e.g., 'usd', 'eur')."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "txn_1FexPY2eZvKYlo2CHNYh111N"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for pagination; object ID that defines your place in the list for fetching previous page."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "txn_1FexPY2eZvKYlo2CHNYh111N"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for pagination; object ID that defines your place in the list for fetching next page."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing balance transactions, allowing filtering and pagination."
}

## STRIPE_LIST_BILLING_ALERTS
Tool to retrieve a paginated list of billing alerts. Use when you need to view billing alerts that notify when usage thresholds on meters are crossed.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListBillingAlertsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Controls result count; ranges from 1-100 with a default of 10."
    },
    "meter": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Meter",
      "examples": [
        "meter_12345",
        "meter_AbCdEf123456"
      ],
      "description": "Filters alerts associated with a particular meter identifier."
    },
    "alert_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "const": "usage_threshold",
      "title": "Alert Type",
      "examples": [
        "usage_threshold"
      ],
      "description": "Restricts results to a specific alert category. Currently supports 'usage_threshold' for alerts that trigger when usage on a meter exceeds a threshold."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "alert_67890",
        "alert_XyZ789"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor for retrieving prior pages using an object ID from the current response."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "alert_12345",
        "alert_AbCdEf123456"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor for fetching subsequent pages using an object ID from the previous response."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing billing alerts."
}

## STRIPE_LIST_BILLING_CREDIT_BALANCE_TRANSACTIONS
Tool to retrieve a paginated list of credit balance transactions with optional filtering. Use when you need to view credit and debit transactions for customer credit grants or track billing credit activity.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetV1BillingCreditBalanceTransactionsOverviewBillingCreditBalanceTransactionsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Number of objects to return per page (range: 1-100, default: 10)."
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_12345",
        "cus_TepD5P6X8fBgRB"
      ],
      "description": "Filter transactions to only include those belonging to a particular customer ID."
    },
    "credit_grant": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Credit Grant",
      "examples": [
        "cg_12345",
        "cg_AbCdEf123456"
      ],
      "description": "Filter transactions to only include those for a specific credit grant ID."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "cbtxn_67890",
        "cbtxn_XyZ789"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for backward pagination - object ID to end before. Use for fetching the previous page."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "cbtxn_12345",
        "cbtxn_AbCdEf123456"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for forward pagination - object ID to start after. Use for fetching the next page."
    },
    "customer_account": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer Account",
      "examples": [
        "acc_12345",
        "acc_AbCdEf123456"
      ],
      "description": "Filter transactions to only include those for a specific customer account ID."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing billing credit balance transactions."
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_CHARGES
Retrieves a list of Stripe charges with filtering and pagination; use valid cursor IDs from previous responses for pagination, and note that charges are typically returned in reverse chronological order.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListChargesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        "25",
        "100"
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of charges to return (default: 10)."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        "{'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}",
        "{'lt': 1640995200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filters charges by creation date using a dictionary with keys like 'gt', 'gte', 'lt', 'lte' and Unix timestamp values.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_12345"
      ],
      "description": "Filters charges by the specified customer ID."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "ch_12345"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for pagination. A charge ID that defines your place in the list; returns charges listed before this charge. Use a charge ID from a previous response to fetch the previous page."
    },
    "payment_intent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Intent",
      "examples": [
        "pi_67890"
      ],
      "description": "Filters charges by the specified PaymentIntent ID."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "ch_67890"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for pagination. A charge ID that defines your place in the list; returns charges listed after this charge. Use a charge ID from a previous response to fetch the next page."
    },
    "transfer_group": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Transfer Group",
      "examples": [
        "group_12345"
      ],
      "description": "Filters charges by the specified transfer group ID."
    }
  }
}
```

      "type": "object",
      "title": "Refund",
      "required": [
        "id",
        "object",
        "amount",
        "created",
        "currency"

      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",

          "description": "ID of the charge that was refunded."
        },

          "type": "string",
          "title": "Object",
          "description": "String representing the object's type. Value is 'refund'."
        },
        "reason": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Reason",
          "description": "Reason for the refund. Possible values: duplicate, fraudulent, requested_by_customer, or expired_uncaptured_charge."
        },
        "status": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Status",
          "description": "Status of the refund. Possible values: pending, requires_action, succeeded, failed, or canceled."
        },
        "created": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Created",
          "description": "Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch."

    "RefundsList": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "RefundsList",
      "required": [

        },

          "type": "array",

            "type": "object",

            "required": [

              },
              "reason": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Reason",
                "description": "Reason for the refund. Possible values: duplicate, fraudulent, requested_by_customer, or expired_uncaptured_charge."
              },

    "ListChargesResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "ListChargesResponse",
      "required": [
        "object",
        "url",
        "has_more",
        "data"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "url": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Url",
          "description": "The URL path for the list charges endpoint."
        },
        "data": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Charge",
            "required": [
              "id",
              "object",
              "amount",
              "amount_captured",
              "amount_refunded",
              "billing_details",
              "captured",
              "created",
              "currency",
              "disputed",
              "livemode",
              "metadata",
              "paid",
              "refunded",
              "status"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "id": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Id",
                "description": "Unique identifier for the charge."
              },
              "paid": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "title": "Paid",
                "description": "true if the charge succeeded, or was successfully authorized for later capture."
              },
              "amount": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Amount",
                "description": "Amount intended to be collected by this charge. A positive integer representing how much to charge in the smallest currency unit (e.g., 100 cents to charge $1.00 USD)."
              },
              "object": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Object",
                "description": "String representing the object's type. Value is 'charge'."
              },
              "review": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Review",
                "description": "ID of the review associated with this charge if one exists."
              },
              "status": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Status",
                "description": "The status of the payment is either succeeded, pending, or failed."
              },
              "created": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Created",
                "description": "Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch."
              },
              "invoice": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Invoice",
                "description": "ID of the invoice this charge is for if one exists."
              },
              "outcome": {
                "type": "object",
                "title": "Outcome",
                "properties": {
                  "type": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Type",
                    "description": "Possible values are authorized, manual_review, issuer_declined, blocked, and invalid."
                  },
                  "reason": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Reason",
                    "description": "An enumerated value providing a more detailed explanation of the outcome's type."
                  },

                    "type": "string",

                    "description": "Stripe Radar's evaluation of the riskiness of the payment. Possible values for evaluated payments are normal, elevated, highest. For non-card payments, and card-based payments predating the public assignment of risk levels, this field will have the value not_assessed."
                  },

                    "type": "integer",

                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Network Status",

                  },

                },
                "description": "Details about whether the payment was accepted, and why."

For non-card payments, and card-based payments predating the public assignment of risk levels, this field will have the value not_assessed."

## STRIPE_LIST_CHECKOUT_SESSIONS
Tool to retrieve a list of Stripe Checkout Sessions with pagination support. Use when you need to list checkout sessions, optionally filtering by customer, status, payment intent, or other criteria.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListCheckoutSessionsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Number of results to return per page (range 1-100). Defaults to 10 if not specified."
    },
    "status": {
      "enum": [
        "open",
        "complete",
        "expired"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Status",
      "examples": [
        "complete"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by session status."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        "{'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by creation date range using gt (greater than), gte (greater than or equal), lt (less than), lte (less than or equal) for timestamp bounds.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_123ABC456def"
      ],
      "description": "Restrict results to a specific Customer ID."
    },
    "payment_link": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Link",
      "examples": [
        "plink_123ABC456def"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by Payment Link ID that created the session."
    },
    "subscription": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subscription",
      "examples": [
        "sub_123ABC456def"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by associated subscription ID."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "cs_test_123ABC"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor for retrieving the previous page of results."
    },
    "payment_intent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Intent",
      "examples": [
        "pi_123ABC456def"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by associated PaymentIntent ID."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "cs_test_456DEF"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor for retrieving the next page of results."
    },
    "customer_account": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer Account",
      "examples": [
        "acct_123ABC456def"
      ],
      "description": "Restrict results to a specific Account ID."
    },
    "customer_details_email": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer Details Email",
      "examples": [
        "customer@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by customer email address (maximum 800 characters)."
    }
  }
}

## STRIPE_LIST_CLIMATE_ORDERS
Tool to list all Climate order objects. Use when you need to retrieve carbon removal orders sorted by creation date with most recent first.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListClimateOrdersRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        50
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "climorder_5E4D3C2B1A"
      ],
      "description": "An object ID that defines your place in the list for backward pagination. Use the ID of the first order from a previous request to fetch the previous page."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "climorder_1A2B3C4D5E"
      ],
      "description": "An object ID that defines your place in the list for forward pagination. Use the ID of the last order from a previous request to fetch the next page."
    }
  }
}

## STRIPE_LIST_CLIMATE_PRODUCTS
Tool to retrieve a list of available Stripe Climate products. Use when you need to see carbon removal offerings with pricing and supplier information.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListClimateProductsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        50
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "clprd_abc123",
        "clprd_xyz789"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. This is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects starting with clprd_abc, your subsequent call can include ending_before=clprd_abc in order to fetch the previous page of the list."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "clprd_abc123",
        "clprd_xyz789"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. This is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects ending with clprd_xyz, your subsequent call can include starting_after=clprd_xyz in order to fetch the next page of the list."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing climate products."
}

For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects ending with clsp_xyz, your subsequent call can include starting_after=clsp_xyz in order to fetch the next page of the list."

## STRIPE_LIST_COUPONS
Retrieves a list of discount coupons from a Stripe account, supporting pagination via `limit`, `starting_after`, and `ending_before`.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListCouponsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        "10",
        "50",
        "100"
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of coupon objects to return. Stripe's default (usually 10) applies if omitted."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "co_yyyyyyyyyyyyy"
      ],
      "description": "A coupon ID for pagination. Returns items created before this object."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "co_xxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
      ],
      "description": "A coupon ID for pagination. Returns items created after this object."
    }
  },
  "description": "Parameters for listing coupons, with pagination options."
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_CREDIT_NOTES
Lists Stripe credit notes with optional filtering by customer, invoice, or customer account, and pagination support.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListCreditNotesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        25
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of credit note objects to return (1-100). Defaults to 10 if not specified."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        {
          "gte": 1609459200,
          "lte": 1640995200
        }
      ],
      "description": "Filter credit notes by their creation date. Use keys like 'gt' (greater than), 'gte' (greater than or equal to), 'lt' (less than), 'lte' (less than or equal to) with Unix timestamp values to specify a range.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "invoice": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Invoice",
      "examples": [
        "in_1J2x3Y4z5A6b7C"
      ],
      "description": "Filters credit notes to those for the specified invoice ID."
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_123ABC456def"
      ],
      "description": "Filters credit notes to those for the specified customer ID."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "cn_9Xyz8Wvu7Tsr6Qpo"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for backward pagination; returns only credit notes created before this object ID."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "cn_1Abc2Def3Ghi4Jkl"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for forward pagination; returns only credit notes created after this object ID."
    },
    "customer_account": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer Account",
      "examples": [
        "cus_acc_123XYZ"
      ],
      "description": "Filters credit notes to those for the specified customer account ID."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing credit notes, allowing filtering and pagination."
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_CUSTOMERS
Retrieves a list of Stripe customers, with options to filter by email, creation date, or test clock, and support for pagination.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListCustomersRequest",
  "properties": {
    "email": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Email",
      "examples": [
        "customer@example.com",
        "another.user@test.com"
      ],
      "description": "Filters customers by a case-sensitive email address."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        "10",
        "25",
        "100"
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of customer objects to return (range 1-100). Defaults to 10 if unspecified."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        "{'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}",
        "{'gt': 1609459200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filters by creation date. Use a dictionary with keys like 'gte', 'lte', 'gt', 'lt' and Unix timestamp values (e.g., {'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}).",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "test_clock": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Test Clock",
      "examples": [
        "test_clock_12345",
        "tc_09876ZYXWVU"
      ],
      "description": "Filters customers by the specified test clock ID. If omitted, returns only live mode customers."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "cus_12345ABCDEF",
        "cus_PREVIOUSPAGEID"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor; retrieves objects created before the specified object ID to fetch the previous page."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "cus_67890GHIJKL",
        "cus_NEXTPAGEID"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor; retrieves objects created after the specified object ID to fetch the next page."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_CUSTOMER_SUBSCRIPTIONS
Tool to list all active subscriptions for a customer in Stripe. Use when you need to retrieve all subscriptions associated with a specific customer ID. Supports pagination via starting_after and ending_before cursors.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListCustomerSubscriptionsRequest",
  "required": [
    "customer"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10."
    },
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "latest_invoice"
        ],
        [
          "customer",
          "default_payment_method"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded. For example, expand=['latest_invoice'] will include the full invoice object in the response."
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "pattern": "^cus_[a-zA-Z0-9]+$",
      "examples": [
        "cus_TzIdl6D6E2G4Pl",
        "cus_H9MvQyuT5Qj8KP"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the customer whose subscriptions will be retrieved. Must start with 'cus_' followed by alphanumeric characters."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "sub_1ShVYcQvM72TjFrbk8FuYeIw"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. ending_before is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_bar in order to fetch the previous page of the list."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "sub_1NlcNX2eZvKYlo2CFqnrn9ow"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. starting_after is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include starting_after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing customer subscriptions."
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_DISPUTES
Tool to list all disputes from a Stripe account. Use when you need to retrieve disputes with optional filtering by charge or payment intent.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListDisputesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        "10",
        "25",
        "100"
      ],
      "description": "Number of objects to return (range: 1-100, default: 10)."
    },
    "charge": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Charge",
      "examples": [
        "ch_1FexPY2eZvKYlo2CHNYh111N"
      ],
      "description": "Filter results to disputes linked to a specific charge ID."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        "{'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}",
        "{'gt': 1640995200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filter disputes by creation date range using timestamps with keys 'gt', 'gte', 'lt', 'lte'.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "dp_1FexQo2eZvKYlo2CTPZ2f5sF"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for pagination; returns only disputes created before this object ID."
    },
    "payment_intent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Intent",
      "examples": [
        "pi_1FexRa2eZvKYlo2CSzC2V7n9"
      ],
      "description": "Filter results to disputes associated with a specific PaymentIntent ID."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "dp_1FexQo2eZvKYlo2CTPZ2f5sF"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for pagination; returns only disputes created after this object ID."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing disputes, allowing filtering and pagination."
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_ENTITLEMENTS_FEATURES
Retrieves a paginated list of entitlements features from Stripe. Use when you need to list monetizable abilities or functionalities in your system that can be assigned to products.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListEntitlementsFeaturesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of feature objects to be returned. The value must be an integer between 1 and 100. If not specified, the default is 10."
    },
    "archived": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Archived",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Narrows results to features matching the specified archive status. Set to True to return only archived features, or False for non-archived ones."
    },
    "lookup_key": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Lookup Key",
      "examples": [
        "premium_access",
        "video_streaming"
      ],
      "description": "Filters results to features with the matching lookup_key value. Maximum 80 characters."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "feat_67890",
        "feat_xyz789"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. Defines your place in the list. Use the ID of the first feature from the previous page to fetch the previous page."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "feat_12345",
        "feat_abc123"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. Defines your place in the list. Use the ID of the last feature from the previous page to fetch the next page."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing entitlements features."
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_FILE_LINKS
Tool to retrieve a list of Stripe file links. Use when you need to list file links with optional filters for creation date, expiration status, and associated file.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListFileLinksRequest",
  "properties": {
    "file": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File",
      "examples": [
        "file_12345"
      ],
      "description": "Restrict results to links for a specific file ID."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        "10",
        "25",
        "100"
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of file link objects to return (range 1-100). Defaults to 10 if unspecified."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        "{'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}",
        "{'gt': 1609459200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filters file links by creation date using a dictionary with keys like 'gt', 'gte', 'lt', 'lte' and Unix timestamp values (e.g., {'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}).",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "expired": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Expired",
      "examples": [
        "true",
        "false"
      ],
      "description": "Filter links by expiration status. If true, returns only expired links; if false, returns only non-expired links. By default, returns all links."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "link_67890",
        "link_PREVIOUSPAGEID"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for pagination; retrieves objects created before the specified object ID to fetch the previous page."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "link_12345",
        "link_NEXTPAGEID"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for pagination; retrieves objects created after the specified object ID to fetch the next page."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for listing file links."
}

## STRIPE_LIST_FILES
Tool to retrieve a list of files that your account has access to. Use when you need to list files uploaded to Stripe, with optional filtering by purpose or creation date.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListFilesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        {
          "gte": 1609459200,
          "lte": 1640995200
        },
        {
          "gt": 1609459200
        }
      ],
      "description": "A filter on the list based on the object created field. The value can be a dictionary with keys like 'gt', 'gte', 'lt', 'lte' and Unix timestamp values. Use 'gte' for greater than or equal, 'lte' for less than or equal, 'gt' for greater than, and 'lt' for less than.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "purpose": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Purpose",
      "examples": [
        "business_icon",
        "dispute_evidence",
        "identity_document"
      ],
      "description": "Filter queries to only return files with the given purpose. Possible values include: account_requirement, additional_verification, business_icon, business_logo, customer_signature, dispute_evidence, finance_report_run, financial_account_statement, identity_document, identity_document_downloadable, issuing_regulatory_reporting, pci_document, platform_terms_of_service, selfie, sigma_scheduled_query, tax_document_user_upload, terminal_android_apk, terminal_reader_splashscreen. If no purpose is provided, returns unfiltered files."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "file_67890",
        "file_PREVIOUSPAGEID"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. This is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_bar in order to fetch the previous page of the list."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "file_12345",
        "file_NEXTPAGEID"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. This is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include starting_after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_FINANCIAL_CONNECTIONS_ACCOUNTS
Tool to list Financial Connections Account objects representing external financial accounts. Use when you need to retrieve accounts linked through Financial Connections.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListFinancialConnectionsAccountsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        50
      ],
      "description": "Number of results to return. Range: 1-100, default: 10."
    },
    "session": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Session",
      "examples": [
        "fcsess_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "Filter to accounts collected in a specific Financial Connections session. Mutually exclusive with account_holder parameters."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "fca_0987654321"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for reverse pagination; object ID marking the list position."
    },
    "account_holder": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "AccountHolderFilter",
      "properties": {
        "account": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Account",
          "examples": [
            "acct_1234567890"
          ],
          "description": "Stripe account ID to retrieve associated financial connections accounts."
        },
        "customer": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Customer",
          "examples": [
            "cus_1234567890"
          ],
          "description": "Stripe customer ID to retrieve their financial connections accounts."
        },
        "customer_account": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Customer Account",
          "examples": [
            "cust_acct_1234567890"
          ],
          "description": "Account ID representing a customer whose financial connections accounts to retrieve."
        }
      },
      "description": "Filter to specify which account holder's accounts to retrieve.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "fca_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for forward pagination; object ID marking the list position."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing Financial Connections accounts with filtering and pagination."
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_FORWARDING_REQUESTS
Lists ForwardingRequest objects from Stripe's Vault and Forward API. ForwardingRequests are records of requests Stripe made to third-party endpoints on your behalf, with payment card details securely inserted. Use this to retrieve and audit forwarding requests, with optional filtering by creation timestamp and pagination support. Note: This API requires special account authorization. Contact Stripe support if you need access.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListForwardingRequestsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Range: 1-100. Default: 10."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        {
          "gte": 1609459200,
          "lte": 1640995200
        },
        {
          "gt": 1609459200
        }
      ],
      "description": "Filters results by creation timestamp using comparison operators. Supported keys: 'gt' (greater than), 'gte' (greater than or equal), 'lt' (less than), 'lte' (less than or equal). Values are Unix timestamps.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "fwdreq_12345"
      ],
      "description": "A pagination cursor to fetch the previous page of the list. Value must be a ForwardingRequest ID."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "fwdreq_67890"
      ],
      "description": "A pagination cursor to fetch the next page of the list. Value must be a ForwardingRequest ID."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing forwarding requests."
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_FX_QUOTES
Retrieves a list of FX quotes that have been issued, with the most recent appearing first. Use for locking exchange rates for payments or transfers.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListFxQuotesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        50
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "fxq_67890GHIJKL",
        "fxq_PREVIOUSPAGEID"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination that defines your place in the list for fetching prior pages. Use an FX quote ID from a previous response."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "fxq_12345ABCDEF",
        "fxq_NEXTPAGEID"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination that defines your place in the list for fetching subsequent pages. Use an FX quote ID from a previous response."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing FX quotes."
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_INVOICEITEMS
Retrieves a paginated list of Stripe invoice items. Use to filter by customer, invoice, creation date, or attachment status with cursor-based pagination.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListInvoiceitemsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of invoice items to return (1-100). Defaults to 10 if not specified."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        {
          "gte": 1609459200,
          "lte": 1640995200
        }
      ],
      "description": "Filter invoice items by creation date. Use keys like 'gt' (greater than), 'gte' (greater than or equal to), 'lt' (less than), 'lte' (less than or equal to) with Unix timestamp values to specify a range.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "invoice": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Invoice",
      "examples": [
        "in_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by invoice ID. Only return invoice items belonging to the specified invoice."
    },
    "pending": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Pending",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Filter by attachment status. Set to true to return only unattached invoice items, false to return only attached items, or omit to return all items."
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_123ABC456def"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by customer ID. Only return invoice items for the specified customer."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "ii_0987654321"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for backward pagination. An invoice item ID that defines where to end fetching the previous page."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "ii_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for forward pagination. An invoice item ID that defines where to start fetching the next page."
    },
    "customer_account": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer Account",
      "examples": [
        "ca_123ABC456def"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by customer account ID. Only return invoice items for the specified customer account."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_INVOICE_PAYMENTS
Tool to list all payments for invoices in Stripe. Use when you need to retrieve payment information associated with invoices, including pagination and filtering by invoice ID, status, or creation date.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListInvoicePaymentsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        "10",
        "25",
        "100"
      ],
      "description": "Number of objects to return (1-100). Defaults to 10 if not specified."
    },
    "status": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Status",
      "examples": [
        "paid",
        "open",
        "canceled"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by payment status. Possible values: 'paid', 'open', or 'canceled'."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        "{'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}",
        "{'gt': 1609459200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by creation timestamp. Use keys 'gt' (greater than), 'gte' (greater than or equal), 'lt' (less than), 'lte' (less than or equal) with Unix timestamp values.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "invoice": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Invoice",
      "examples": [
        "in_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "The invoice identifier whose payments should be returned. If omitted, returns all invoice payments."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "invpay_0987654321"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for pagination; fetch results before this invoice payment ID. Use an invoice payment ID from a previous response to fetch the previous page."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "invpay_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for pagination; fetch results after this invoice payment ID. Use an invoice payment ID from a previous response to fetch the next page."
    }
  }
}

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "irt_0987654321fedcba"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. ending_before is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_bar in order to fetch the previous page of the list."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "irt_1234567890abcdef"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. starting_after is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include starting_after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list."

  }
}

## STRIPE_LIST_INVOICES
Retrieves a list of Stripe invoices, filterable by various criteria and paginatable using invoice ID cursors obtained from previous responses.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListInvoicesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        "25"
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of invoice objects to return (1-100). Defaults to 10 if not specified."
    },
    "status": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Status",
      "examples": [
        "open",
        "paid"
      ],
      "description": "Filter invoices by status: 'draft', 'open', 'paid', 'uncollectible', or 'void'; if omitted, returns invoices with any status."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        "{'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filter invoices by their creation date. Use keys like 'gt' (greater than), 'gte' (greater than or equal to), 'lt' (less than), 'lte' (less than or equal to) with Unix timestamp values to specify a range.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_123ABC456def"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the customer whose invoices to retrieve; if omitted, invoices for all customers may be returned."
    },
    "subscription": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subscription",
      "examples": [
        "sub_123XYZ789ghi"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the subscription whose invoices to retrieve; if omitted, invoices for all subscriptions may be returned."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "in_1J2x3Y4z5A6b7C"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for backward pagination; an invoice ID from a previous response that defines the end of the current page, used to fetch the preceding page."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "in_9H8g7F6e5D4c3B"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for forward pagination; an invoice ID from a previous response that defines the end of the current page, used to fetch the subsequent page."
    },
    "collection_method": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Collection Method",
      "examples": [
        "charge_automatically",
        "send_invoice"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by collection method: 'charge_automatically' (Stripe attempts auto-charge) or 'send_invoice' (Stripe emails invoice); if omitted, returns invoices with any collection method."
    }
  }
}
```
