```json
  "title": "ListInvoicesResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "object",
        "url",
        "hasMore",
        "data"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "url": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Url",
          "description": "The URL for accessing this list."
        },
        "data": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Invoice",
            "required": [
              "id",
              "object",
              "amountDue",
              "amountPaid",
              "amountRemaining",
              "amountShipping",
              "amountOverpaid",
              "attemptCount",
              "attempted",
              "automaticTax",
              "collectionMethod",
              "created",
              "currency",
              "defaultTaxRates",
              "lines",
              "livemode",
              "paymentSettings",
              "periodEnd",
              "periodStart",
              "postPaymentCreditNotesAmount",
              "prePaymentCreditNotesAmount",
              "startingBalance",
              "statusTransitions",
              "subtotal",
              "total"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "id": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Id",
                "description": "Unique identifier for the invoice. Preview invoices are prefixed with 'upcoming_in'."
              },
              "tax": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Tax",
                "description": "The amount of tax on this invoice."
              },
              "paid": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "title": "Paid",
                "description": "Whether payment was successfully collected for this invoice."
              },
              "lines": {
                "type": "object",
                "title": "Lines",
                "required": [
                  "object",
                  "data",
                  "hasMore",
                  "url"
                ],
                "properties": {
                  "url": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Url",
                    "description": "URL to access this list."
                  },
                  "data": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "title": "InvoiceLineItem",
                      "required": [
                        "id",
                        "object",
                        "amount",
                        "currency",
                        "discountable",
                        "livemode",
                        "period",
                        "subtotal"
                      ],
                      "properties": {
                        "id": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "title": "Id",
                          "description": "Unique identifier for the line item."
                        },
                        "plan": {
                          "type": "object",
                          "title": "Plan",
                          "description": "The plan details.",
                          "additionalProperties": true
                        },
                        "type": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "title": "Type",
                          "description": "Type of line item."
                        },
                        "price": {
                          "type": "object",
                          "title": "Price",
                          "required": [
                            "id",
                            "object",
                            "active",
                            "billingScheme",
                            "created",
                            "currency",
                            "livemode",
                            "product",
                            "type"
                          ],
                          "properties": {
                            "id": {
                              "type": "string",
                              "title": "Id",
                              "description": "Unique identifier for the price."
                            },
                            "type": {
                              "type": "string",
                              "title": "Type",
                              "description": "Price type. One of 'one_time' or 'recurring'."
                            },
                            "active": {
                              "type": "boolean",
                              "title": "Active",
                              "description": "Whether the price can be used for new purchases."
                            },
                            "object": {
                              "type": "string",
                              "title": "Object",
                              "description": "String representing the object's type. Always 'price'."
                            },
                            "created": {
                              "type": "integer",
                              "title": "Created",
                              "description": "Creation timestamp."
                            },
                            "product": {
                              "type": "string",
                              "title": "Product",
                              "description": "Associated product ID."
                            },
                            "currency": {
                              "type": "string",
                              "title": "Currency",
                              "description": "Three-letter ISO currency code."
                            },
                            "livemode": {
                              "type": "boolean",
                              "title": "Livemode",
                              "description": "Live mode indicator."
                            },
                            "metadata": {
                              "type": "object",
                              "title": "Metadata",
                              "description": "Set of key-value pairs.",
                              "additionalProperties": {
                                "type": "string"
                              }
                            },
                            "nickname": {
                              "type": "string",
                              "title": "Nickname",
                              "description": "Internal price description."
                            },
                            "lookupKey": {
                              "type": "string",
                              "title": "Lookup Key",
                              "description": "Static retrieval string."
                            },
                            "recurring": {
                              "type": "object",
                              "title": "Recurring",
                              "required": [
                                "interval",
                                "intervalCount"
                              ],
                              "properties": {
                                "meter": {
                                  "type": "string",
                                  "title": "Meter",
                                  "description": "Meter identifier for tracking metered price usage."
                                },
                                "interval": {
                                  "type": "string",
                                  "title": "Interval",
                                  "description": "Billing frequency. One of 'day', 'week', 'month', or 'year'."
                                },
                                "usageType": {
                                  "type": "string",
                                  "title": "Usage Type",
                                  "description": "Quantity calculation method. One of 'metered' or 'licensed'."
                                },
                                "intervalCount": {
                                  "type": "integer",
                                  "title": "Interval Count",
                                  "description": "Number of interval periods between billings."
                                },
                                "aggregateUsage": {
                                  "type": "string",
                                  "title": "Aggregate Usage",
                                  "description": "Specifies a usage aggregation strategy for prices of usage_type=metered."
                                },
                                "trialPeriodDays": {
                                  "type": "integer",
                                  "title": "Trial Period Days",
                                  "description": "Default number of trial days when subscribing a customer to this price using trial_from_plan=true."
                                }
                              },
                              "description": "Subscription billing components."
                            },
                            "tiersMode": {
                              "type": "string",
                              "title": "Tiers Mode",
                              "description": "Tiering mode. One of 'graduated' or 'volume'."
                            },
                            "unitAmount": {
                              "type": "integer",
                              "title": "Unit Amount",
                              "description": "Charge amount in cents."
                            },
                            "taxBehavior": {
                              "type": "string",
                              "title": "Tax Behavior",
                              "description": "Tax behavior. One of 'inclusive', 'exclusive', or 'unspecified'."
                            },
                            "billingScheme": {
                              "type": "string",
                              "title": "Billing Scheme",
                              "description": "Pricing model. One of 'per_unit' or 'tiered'."
                            },
                            "customUnitAmount": {
                              "type": "object",
                              "title": "Custom Unit Amount",
                              "properties": {
                                "preset": {
```

## STRIPE_LIST_METER_EVENT_SUMMARIES
Tool to retrieve billing meter event summaries for a customer within a time range. Use when you need aggregated meter event data for billing analysis.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListMeterEventSummariesRequest",
  "required": [
    "id",
    "customer",
    "start_time",
    "end_time"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "mtr_61UAiIglhwzmrRQWa41P3BKO35fWyEEq"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier for the billing meter object."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        10,
        50,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Number of objects returned (1-100, default: 10)."
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_TzIs91iVCDbuad"
      ],
      "description": "The customer for which to fetch event summaries."
    },
    "end_time": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "End Time",
      "examples": [
        1707350400
      ],
      "description": "The timestamp from when to stop aggregating meter events (exclusive). Must align with minute boundaries. Unix timestamp in seconds."
    },
    "start_time": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Start Time",
      "examples": [
        1707264000
      ],
      "description": "The timestamp from when to start aggregating meter events (inclusive). Must align with minute boundaries. Unix timestamp in seconds."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "description": "Cursor for backward pagination using object ID."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "description": "Cursor for forward pagination using object ID."
    },
    "value_grouping_window": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Value Grouping Window",
      "examples": [
        "hour",
        "day"
      ],
      "description": "Specifies aggregation granularity: 'hour' (aligned to hour boundaries) or 'day' (aligned to UTC boundaries). If omitted, returns single summary for entire range."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_RECORDS
Tool to list payment attempt records for a specified payment record. Use when you need to retrieve all attempts made to process a specific payment.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListPaymentAttemptRecordsRequest",
  "required": [
    "payment_record"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        10
      ],
      "description": "Limit on the number of payment attempt records to be returned. Stripe API defaults to 10 if unspecified."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "par_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for pagination; returns only payment attempt records created before this object ID."
    },
    "payment_record": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Record",
      "examples": [
        "pr_test_65TqtbTPPQBmhL112rg41QvM72TjFrb7e4"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the Payment Record to retrieve payment attempt records for."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "par_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for pagination; returns only payment attempt records created after this object ID."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing payment attempt records, allowing filtering and pagination."
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_PAYMENT_INTENTS
Tool to list PaymentIntents from Stripe. Use when you need to retrieve a list of payment intents with optional filtering by customer, creation date, or pagination parameters.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListPaymentIntentsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        {
          "gte": 1609459200,
          "lte": 1640995200
        },
        {
          "gt": 1609459200
        }
      ],
      "description": "Filter by creation date using Unix timestamps. Supported keys: 'gt' (greater than), 'gte' (greater than or equal), 'lt' (less than), 'lte' (less than or equal).",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_12345"
      ],
      "description": "Only return PaymentIntents for the customer specified by this customer ID."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "pi_12345"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. Object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_foo in order to fetch the previous page of the list."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "pi_67890"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. Object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include starting_after=obj_bar in order to fetch the next page of the list."
    },
    "customer_account": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer Account",
      "examples": [
        "cus_account_67890"
      ],
      "description": "Only return PaymentIntents for the account representing the customer specified by this account ID."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing payment intents."
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_PAYMENT_LINKS
Retrieves a list of payment links from Stripe, sorted by creation date in descending order by default.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListPaymentLinksRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        "10",
        "25",
        "100"
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of items to return (1-100, inclusive). Stripe API defaults to 10 if omitted."
    },
    "active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Active",
      "examples": [
        "true",
        "false"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by active status. `true` for active, `false` for inactive."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "plink_1O9g9gZ2eZvKYlo2C0gZ2eZv"
      ],
      "description": "Object ID for backward pagination; retrieves items created before this ID."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "plink_1O9g9gZ2eZvKYlo2C0gZ2eZv"
      ],
      "description": "Object ID for forward pagination; retrieves items created after this ID."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_PAYOUTS
Lists Stripe payouts sent to external accounts or received from Stripe, sorted by creation date descending (newest first), with optional filtering by arrival date, creation date, destination, and status.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListPayoutsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        "10",
        "25",
        "100"
      ],
      "description": "Limit on the number of payouts to be returned. Stripe API defaults to 10 if unspecified. Range: 1-100."
    },
    "status": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Status",
      "examples": [
        "paid",
        "pending",
        "failed",
        "canceled"
      ],
      "description": "Filters payouts by status. Possible values: 'pending', 'paid', 'failed', or 'canceled'."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        "{'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}",
        "{'lt': 1640995200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filters payouts by creation date range. Use a dictionary with keys like 'gt', 'gte', 'lt', 'lte' and Unix timestamp values.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "destination": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Destination",
      "examples": [
        "ba_1FexPY2eZvKYlo2CHNYh111N"
      ],
      "description": "Filters payouts by the external account ID (bank account or debit card) to which funds are being transferred."
    },
    "arrival_date": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Arrival Date",
      "examples": [
        "{'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}",
        "{'gt': 1609459200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filters payouts by expected arrival date range. Use a dictionary with keys like 'gt', 'gte', 'lt', 'lte' and Unix timestamp values.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "po_1FexQo2eZvKYlo2CTPZ2f5sF"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for pagination; returns only payouts created before this object ID."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "po_1FexQo2eZvKYlo2CTPZ2f5sF"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for pagination; returns only payouts created after this object ID."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing payouts, allowing filtering and pagination."
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_PLANS
Tool to list all billing plans from Stripe account. Use when you need to retrieve plans for subscription management or display available pricing options.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListPlansRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of plan objects to return (range 1-100). Defaults to 10 if not specified."
    },
    "active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Active",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Filter plans by their active status. Set to True for active plans, False for inactive plans."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        "{'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}",
        "{'gt': 1609459200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filter plans by creation timestamp. Accepts sub-parameters: created.gt (exclusive minimum), created.gte (inclusive minimum), created.lt (exclusive maximum), created.lte (inclusive maximum). Provide Unix timestamp values (e.g., {'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}).",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "product": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Product",
      "examples": [
        "prod_ABC123",
        "prod_XYZ789"
      ],
      "description": "Restrict results to plans associated with a specific product ID."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "plan_ABC123",
        "plan_XYZ789"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor for fetching the previous page. Returns objects listed before this plan ID."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "plan_DEF456",
        "plan_GHI012"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor for fetching the next page. Returns objects listed after this plan ID."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_PRICES
Tool to list Stripe prices. Use when you need to retrieve and filter price objects before processing write operations.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListPricesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "type": {
      "enum": [
        "one_time",
        "recurring"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Type",
      "examples": [
        "one_time",
        "recurring"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by price type: one_time or recurring."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Limit number of prices returned (1-100)."
    },
    "active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Active",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Filter prices based on their active status. True returns active prices only."
    },
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        "['data.product']"
      ],
      "description": "Fields to expand in each price object."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        "{'gte':1609459200, 'lte':1640995200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by creation timestamp using gt, gte, lt, or lte.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "product": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Product",
      "examples": [
        "prod_123"
      ],
      "description": "Filter prices for a specific product ID (e.g., 'prod_123')."
    },
    "currency": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Currency",
      "examples": [
        "usd",
        "eur"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by three-letter ISO currency code (e.g., 'usd')."
    },
    "recurring": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Recurring",
      "examples": [
        "{'interval':'month'}"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by recurring fields: interval, meter, or usage_type.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "lookup_keys": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Lookup Keys",
      "examples": [
        "['key1', 'key2']"
      ],
      "description": "List of lookup keys to filter prices (max 10)."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "price_123"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for pagination to fetch previous page by price ID."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "price_456"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for pagination to fetch next page by price ID."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_PRODUCTS
Retrieves a list of Stripe products, with optional filtering and pagination; `starting_after`/`ending_before` cursors must be valid product IDs from a previous response.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListProductsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Ids",
      "examples": [
        "['prod_123', 'prod_456']",
        "['prod_789']"
      ],
      "description": "A list of product IDs to retrieve. If provided, only products with these specific IDs will be returned."
    },
    "url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Url",
      "examples": [
        "https://example.com/my-product",
        "https://store.example.org/item/shoe"
      ],
      "description": "Filter products by a specific URL. Only products with this exact URL will be returned."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        "10",
        "25",
        "100"
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of product objects to be returned. The value must be an integer between 1 and 100, inclusive. If not specified, the default is 10."
    },
    "active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Active",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Filter products based on their active status. Set to `True` to return only active products, or `False` for inactive ones."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        "{'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}",
        "{'gt': 1609459200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filters products by their creation date range. Provide a dictionary with keys like 'gt' (greater than), 'gte' (greater than or equal to), 'lt' (less than), or 'lte' (less than or equal to) and Unix timestamp values (seconds since epoch). For instance, `{'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}` filters for products created from January 1, 2021, to January 1, 2022.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "shippable": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Shippable",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Filter products based on whether they are shippable. Set to `True` to return only shippable products, or `False` for non-shippable ones."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "prod_XyZ123",
        "prod_AbC456"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination to fetch the previous page of results. `ending_before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if a list request returns objects ending with `prod_XYZ`, your subsequent call can include `ending_before='prod_XYZ'` to fetch the previous page."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "prod_AbC456",
        "prod_XyZ789"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination to fetch the next page of results. `starting_after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if a list request returns objects and the last object's ID is `prod_ABC`, your subsequent call can include `starting_after='prod_ABC'` to fetch the next page."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_PRODUCTS_PRODUCT_FEATURES
Retrieves a list of features attached to a product. Returns a paginated list of product_feature objects representing attachments between features and products.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListProductsProductFeaturesRequest",
  "required": [
    "product"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, defaults to 10 if not specified."
    },
    "product": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Product",
      "examples": [
        "prod_NWjs8kKbJWmuuc",
        "prod_TepFbB27x4Q39a"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the product whose features you want to retrieve."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "obj_bar",
        "pf_67890"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. An object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_bar in order to fetch the previous page of the list."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "obj_foo",
        "pf_12345"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. An object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include starting_after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_PROMOTION_CODES
Tool to retrieve a list of promotion codes from Stripe. Use when you need to view, filter, or paginate through promotion codes with optional filters for active status, code, coupon, customer, or creation date.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListPromotionCodesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "code": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Code",
      "examples": [
        "SUMMER2024",
        "WELCOME10"
      ],
      "description": "Only return promotion codes that have this case-insensitive code."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        10,
        50,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Number of results to return (1-100, default: 10)."
    },
    "active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Active",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Filter by active/inactive status. A promotion code is only active if the coupon is also valid."
    },
    "coupon": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Coupon",
      "examples": [
        "co_xxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by associated coupon ID."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        {
          "gte": 1609459200,
          "lte": 1640995200
        }
      ],
      "description": "Filter by creation timestamp. Supports sub-parameters: gt, gte, lt, lte (integer Unix timestamps).",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_xxxxxxxxxxxxx"
      ],
      "description": "Restrict results to specific customer ID."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "promo_yyyyyyyyyyyyyy"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor - ID of object to end before for backward navigation."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "promo_xxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor - ID of object to start after for forward navigation."
    },
    "customer_account": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer Account",
      "examples": [
        "ca_xxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
      ],
      "description": "Restrict results to customer account."
    }
  },
  "description": "Parameters for listing promotion codes with optional filters and pagination."
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_QUOTES
Retrieves a list of Stripe quotes with pagination support. Use to fetch quotes by customer, status, or creation date.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListQuotesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        "25"
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of quote objects to return (1-100). Defaults to 10 if not specified."
    },
    "status": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Status",
      "examples": [
        "open",
        "accepted"
      ],
      "description": "Filter quotes by status: 'draft', 'open', 'accepted', or 'canceled'; if omitted, returns quotes with any status."
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_123ABC456def"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the customer whose quotes to retrieve; if omitted, quotes for all customers may be returned."
    },
    "test_clock": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Test Clock",
      "examples": [
        "clock_123ABC"
      ],
      "description": "Provides a list of quotes associated with the specified test clock."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "qt_1J2x3Y4z5A6b7C"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for backward pagination; a quote ID from a previous response that defines the end of the current page, used to fetch the preceding page."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "qt_9H8g7F6e5D4c3B"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for forward pagination; a quote ID from a previous response that defines the end of the current page, used to fetch the subsequent page."
    },
    "customer_account": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer Account",
      "examples": [
        "acct_123XYZ789ghi"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the account representing the customer whose quotes to retrieve."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_RADAR_EARLY_FRAUD_WARNINGS
Tool to list all early fraud warnings from Stripe Radar. Use when you need to retrieve fraud warnings for charges, optionally filtered by charge ID or payment intent ID.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListRadarEarlyFraudWarningsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10."
    },
    "charge": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Charge",
      "examples": [
        "ch_1FexPY2eZvKYlo2CHNYh111N"
      ],
      "description": "Only return early fraud warnings for the charge specified by this charge ID."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        {
          "gte": 1609459200,
          "lte": 1640995200
        },
        {
          "lt": 1640995200
        }
      ],
      "description": "A filter on the list based on the object created field. The value can be a dictionary with keys 'gt', 'gte', 'lt', 'lte' and Unix timestamp values.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "issfr_1FexPY2eZvKYlo2CHNYh111N"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. This is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_bar in order to fetch the previous page of the list."
    },
    "payment_intent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Intent",
      "examples": [
        "pi_1FexRa2eZvKYlo2CSzC2V7n9"
      ],
      "description": "Only return early fraud warnings for charges that were created by the PaymentIntent specified by this PaymentIntent ID."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "issfr_1FexQo2eZvKYlo2CTPZ2f5sF"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. This is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include starting_after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing early fraud warnings with optional filtering and pagination."
}
```

```json
    },
```

```json
        "{'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}",
        "{'lt': 1640995200}"

For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_bar in order to fetch the previous page of the list."

For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include starting_after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list."

  },

}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_REFUNDS
Lists Stripe refunds, sorted by creation date descending (newest first), with optional filtering by charge or payment_intent and pagination support.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListRefundsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        "10"
      ],
      "description": "Limit on the number of refunds to be returned. Stripe API defaults to 10 if unspecified."
    },
    "charge": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Charge",
      "examples": [
        "ch_1FexPY2eZvKYlo2CHNYh111N"
      ],
      "description": "Filters refunds to those for the specified Charge ID."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "re_1FexQo2eZvKYlo2CTPZ2f5sF"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for pagination; returns only refunds created before this object ID."
    },
    "payment_intent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Intent",
      "examples": [
        "pi_1FexRa2eZvKYlo2CSzC2V7n9"
      ],
      "description": "Filters refunds to those for the specified PaymentIntent ID."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "re_1FexQo2eZvKYlo2CTPZ2f5sF"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for pagination; returns only refunds created after this object ID."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing refunds, allowing filtering and pagination."
}
```

```json
    "ListRefundsResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "ListRefundsResponse",
      "required": [
        "object",
        "url",
        "has_more",
        "data"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "url": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Url",
          "description": "The API URL endpoint from which this list of refunds was fetched."
        },
        "data": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "RefundData",
            "required": [
              "id",
              "object",
              "amount",
              "created",
              "currency"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "id": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Id",
                "description": "Unique identifier for the refund object. (e.g., 're_1KvLBN2eZvKYlo2Cl2u0nZLJ')"
              },
              "amount": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Amount",
                "description": "Amount refunded, in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for USD, yen for JPY)."
              },
              "charge": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Charge",
                "description": "ID of the charge that was refunded."
              },
              "object": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Object",
                "description": "String representing the object's type. For refund objects, the value is 'refund'."
              },
              "reason": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Reason",
                "description": "Reason for the refund (e.g., 'duplicate', 'fraudulent', 'requested_by_customer', 'expired_uncaptured_charge')."
              },
              "status": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Status",
                "description": "The current status of the refund. Possible values: 'pending', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'canceled', 'requires_action'."
              },
              "created": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Created",
                "description": "Timestamp (in seconds since the Unix epoch) indicating when the refund object was created."
              },
              "currency": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Currency",
                "description": "Three-letter ISO currency code (e.g., 'usd', 'eur') representing the currency of the refund."
              },
              "metadata": {
                "type": "object",
                "title": "Metadata",
                "description": "A set of key-value pairs that you can attach to a refund object. Useful for storing additional, structured information about the refund.",
                "additionalProperties": true
              },
              "description": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Description",
                "description": "An arbitrary string attached to the object. Available on non-card refunds only."
              },
              "next_action": {
                "type": "object",
                "title": "Next Action",
                "properties": {
                  "type": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Type",
                    "description": "Type of action required."
                  },
                  "display_details": {
                    "type": "object",

                      "email_sent": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "title": "Email Sent",

                            "type": "integer",

                          },
                          "email_sent_to": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "title": "Email Sent To",
                            "description": "Email address where the notification was sent."
                          }
                        },
                        "description": "Information about the email sent to the customer."
                      },
                      "expires_at": {
                        "type": "integer",
                        "title": "Expires At",
                        "description": "Timestamp when the required action expires."
                      }
                    },
                    "description": "Details to display about the required action."
                  }
                },
                "description": "Contains information about what actions are required when the refund status is 'requires_action'."
              },
              "failure_reason": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Failure Reason",
```

## STRIPE_LIST_REPORTING_REPORT_RUNS
Lists Stripe Report Runs, sorted by creation date descending (newest first). Use when you need to retrieve reporting data or check the status of report generation tasks.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListReportingReportRunsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Limit on the number of report runs to be returned. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 10 if not specified."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        "{'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}",
        "{'lt': 1640995200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filters Report Runs by creation date using a dictionary with keys like 'gt', 'gte', 'lt', 'lte' and Unix timestamp values.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "frr_1A2B3C4D5E6F7G8H"
      ],
```

## STRIPE_LIST_REVIEWS
Retrieves a list of open Stripe reviews with pagination support. Use when you need to access reviews that require action, sorted by creation date with most recent first.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListReviewsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        "10",
        "25",
        "100"
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of review objects to return (range 1-100). Defaults to 10 if unspecified."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        "{'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}",
        "{'gt': 1609459200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filters by creation date. Use a dictionary with keys like 'gt', 'gte', 'lt', 'lte' and Unix timestamp values (e.g., {'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}).",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "prv_12345ABCDEF",
        "prv_PREVIOUSPAGEID"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor; retrieves objects created before the specified review ID to fetch the previous page."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "prv_67890GHIJKL",
        "prv_NEXTPAGEID"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor; retrieves objects created after the specified review ID to fetch the next page."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_SETUP_ATTEMPTS
Tool to list SetupAttempts associated with a SetupIntent. Use when you need to retrieve attempts to confirm a SetupIntent and attach a payment method to a customer.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListSetupAttemptsRequest",
  "required": [
    "setup_intent"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        3,
        10,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Controls the number of results returned. Range: 1-100. Default: 10."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        {
          "gte": 1609459200,
          "lte": 1640995200
        },
        {
          "gt": 1609459200
        }
      ],
      "description": "Filters results based on creation timestamp. Supports sub-parameters: 'gt' (greater than), 'gte' (greater than or equal), 'lt' (less than), 'lte' (less than or equal) for Unix timestamp comparisons.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "setup_intent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Setup Intent",
      "examples": [
        "seti_1ShVi6QvM72TjFrbM1NDNm6c"
      ],
      "description": "Filters results to only include SetupAttempts created by the specified SetupIntent ID. This parameter is required."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "setatt_67890"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor for backward pagination. Object ID defining the position for fetching previous pages."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "setatt_12345"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor for forward pagination. Object ID defining the starting position for fetching subsequent pages."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing SetupAttempts."
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_SETUP_INTENTS
Tool to list SetupIntents from Stripe. Use when you need to retrieve a list of setup intents with optional filtering by customer, payment method, or pagination parameters.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListSetupIntentsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        {
          "gte": 1609459200,
          "lte": 1640995200
        },
        {
          "gt": 1609459200
        }
      ],
      "description": "Filter by creation date using Unix timestamps. Supported keys: 'gt' (greater than), 'gte' (greater than or equal), 'lt' (less than), 'lte' (less than or equal).",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_12345"
      ],
      "description": "Only return SetupIntents for the customer specified by this customer ID."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "seti_0987654321"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. This is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_bar in order to fetch the previous page of the list."
    },
    "attach_to_self": {
      "type": "boolean",
```

## STRIPE_LIST_SUBSCRIPTION_ITEMS
List all subscription items for a given subscription. Subscription items represent the individual products/prices that make up a subscription. Use this to retrieve items associated with a specific Stripe subscription, including pricing, quantities, and billing details for each item.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListSubscriptionItemsRequest",
  "required": [
    "subscription"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10."
    },
    "subscription": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subscription",
      "examples": [
        "sub_1ShVc8QvM72TjFrbRD0soIlT"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the subscription whose items will be retrieved."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "si_0987654321"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. ending_before is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_bar in order to fetch the previous page of the list."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "si_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. starting_after is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include starting_after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_SUBSCRIPTIONS
Retrieves a list of Stripe subscriptions, optionally filtered by various criteria such as customer, price, status, collection method, and date ranges, with support for pagination.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListSubscriptionsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        25
      ],
      "description": "Limit on the number of subscription objects to return (1-100). Default is 10."
    },
    "price": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Price",
      "examples": [
        "price_67890"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the recurring price to filter subscriptions by."
    },
    "status": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Status",
      "examples": [
        "canceled",
        "ended",
        "all"
      ],
      "description": "Filter subscriptions by status (e.g., 'active', 'all', 'canceled'). Defaults to non-canceled statuses if unspecified."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        "{'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filter subscriptions by creation date using comparison keys (e.g., 'gte', 'lt') and Unix timestamp values.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_12345"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the customer whose subscriptions will be retrieved."
    },
    "test_clock": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Test Clock",
      "examples": [
        "test_clock_12345"
      ],
      "description": "Filter subscriptions by a specific test clock ID (only applicable in test mode)."
    },
    "automatic_tax": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Automatic Tax",
      "examples": [
        "{'enabled': True}"
      ],
      "description": "Filter subscriptions by automatic tax settings, e.g., {'enabled': True}.",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "sub_12345"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for paginating backwards; provide the ID of the subscription that should end the list."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "sub_67890"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for paginating forwards; provide the ID of the subscription that should start the list."
    },
    "collection_method": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Collection Method",
      "examples": [
        "charge_automatically",
        "send_invoice"
      ],
      "description": "Filter subscriptions by collection method: 'charge_automatically' or 'send_invoice'."
    },
    "current_period_end": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Current Period End",
      "examples": [
        "{'gt': 1609459200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filter subscriptions by the end date of the current billing period, using comparison keys (e.g., 'gt', 'gte') and Unix timestamp values.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "current_period_start": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Current Period Start",
      "examples": [
        "{'lt': 1640995200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filter subscriptions by the start date of the current billing period, using comparison keys (e.g., 'lt', 'lte') and Unix timestamp values.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_TAX_CODES
Retrieves a paginated list of globally available, predefined Stripe tax codes used for classifying products and services in Stripe Tax.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListTaxCodesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        "10"
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of objects to return. API defaults to 10 if this parameter is omitted."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "txcd_99999999"
      ],
      "description": "Object ID cursor to fetch the previous page of results."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "txcd_99999999"
      ],
      "description": "Object ID cursor to fetch the next page of results."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing Stripe tax codes."
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_TAX_RATES
Retrieves a list of tax rates, which are returned sorted by creation date in descending order.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListTaxRatesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        "10",
        "25",
        "100"
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of tax rates to be returned. The value must be between 1 and 100, inclusive. The default is 10."
    },
    "active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Active",
      "examples": [
        "true",
        "false"
      ],
      "description": "Filter tax rates by their active status. Set to `true` for active tax rates and `false` for inactive (archived) tax rates."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        "{\"gt\": 1678886400}",
        "{\"lt\": 1678972800, \"gte\": 1678886400}"
      ],
      "description": "Filter tax rates by their creation date. Accepts a dictionary with keys like `gt` (greater than), `gte` (greater than or equal to), `lt` (less than), or `lte` (less than or equal to), and Unix timestamp values.",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "inclusive": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Inclusive",
      "examples": [
        "true",
        "false"
      ],
      "description": "Filter tax rates by whether they are inclusive. Set to `true` for inclusive tax rates and `false` for exclusive tax rates."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "txr_1MoR1ZAJ9E0EN1s9xQxZY7S3"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. `ending_before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with `obj_foo`, your subsequent call can include `ending_before=obj_foo` in order to fetch the previous page of objects."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "txr_1MoQxRAJ9E0EN1s9sDLSUgup"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. `starting_after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with `obj_bar`, your subsequent call can include `starting_after=obj_bar` in order to fetch the next page of objects."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**

## STRIPE_LIST_TAX_REGISTRATIONS
Retrieves a paginated list of tax registrations. Use when you need to view where a business is registered to collect tax on payments within various regions.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListTaxRegistrationsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        "10",
        "25",
        "50"
      ],
      "description": "Number of objects to return per request. Range: 1-100. Defaults to 10 if not specified."
    },
    "status": {
      "enum": [
        "active",
        "expired",
        "scheduled",
        "all"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Status",
      "examples": [
        "active",
        "all"
      ],
      "description": "Filter registrations by their current status. Defaults to 'all' if not specified."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "taxreg_456def"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for backward pagination. Object ID to fetch results before this object, used to retrieve previous pages."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "taxreg_123abc"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for forward pagination. Object ID to fetch results after this object, used to retrieve subsequent pages."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing Stripe tax registrations."
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_TERMINAL_CONFIGURATIONS
Tool to retrieve a list of Terminal Configuration objects from Stripe. Use when you need to view all terminal configurations with optional filtering and pagination.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListTerminalConfigurationsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "tic_1234567890",
        "tic_abcdefghij"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. ending_before is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_bar in order to fetch the previous page of the list."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "tic_1234567890",
        "tic_abcdefghij"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. starting_after is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include starting_after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list."
    },
    "is_account_default": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Account Default",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "If present, only return the account default or non-default configurations."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing Stripe Terminal configurations."
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_TERMINAL_LOCATIONS
Retrieves a list of Stripe terminal locations with pagination support. Use when you need to view all terminal locations for managing physical card readers.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListTerminalLocationsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        "10",
        "25",
        "100"
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "tml_12345",
        "tml_67890"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. ending_before is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_bar in order to fetch the previous page of the list."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "tml_12345",
        "tml_67890"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. starting_after is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include starting_after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing Stripe terminal locations."
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_TERMINAL_READERS
Tool to list all Stripe Terminal Readers with optional filtering. Use when you need to retrieve readers by device type, location, serial number, or status.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListTerminalReadersRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10."
    },
    "status": {
      "enum": [
        "offline",
        "online"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Status",
      "examples": [
        "online",
        "offline"
      ],
      "description": "A status filter to filter readers to only offline or online readers."
    },
    "location": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Location",
      "examples": [
        "tml_1234567890abcdef",
        "tml_abcdefghijklmnop"
      ],
      "description": "A location ID to filter the response list to only readers at the specific location."
    },
    "device_type": {
      "enum": [
        "bbpos_chipper2x",
        "bbpos_wisepad3",
        "bbpos_wisepos_e",
        "mobile_phone_reader",
        "simulated_stripe_s700",
        "simulated_wisepos_e",
        "stripe_m2",
        "stripe_s700"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Device Type",
      "examples": [
        "stripe_m2",
        "bbpos_wisepad3"
      ],
      "description": "Filters readers by device type. Use to retrieve only readers of a specific device model."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "tmr_1234567890abcdef",
        "tmr_abcdefghijklmnop"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. Defines your place in the list for backward navigation. Use the ID of the first reader from the previous page."
    },
    "serial_number": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Serial Number",
      "examples": [
        "STRM2-123456",
        "WPE-789012"
      ],
      "description": "Filters readers by serial number. Use to retrieve a specific reader by its serial number."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "tmr_1234567890abcdef",
        "tmr_abcdefghijklmnop"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. Defines your place in the list for forward navigation. Use the ID of the last reader from the previous page."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_TEST_CLOCKS
Retrieves a paginated list of test clocks. Use when you need to view all test clocks for testing time-dependent functionality.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListTestClocksRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10."
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "clock_789",
        "clock_012"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. ending_before is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_bar in order to fetch the previous page of the list."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "clock_123",
        "clock_456"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination. starting_after is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include starting_after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**

## STRIPE_LIST_TOPUPS
Tool to retrieve a list of existing top-ups from Stripe. Use when you need to view top-ups with optional filtering by amount, status, or creation date, and pagination support.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListTopupsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        "25",
        "100"
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of top-ups to return (1-100, default is 10 if not specified)."
    },
    "amount": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Amount",
      "examples": [
        "{'gte': 10000, 'lte': 50000}",
        "{'gt': 5000}"
      ],
      "description": "Filters top-ups by transfer amount using a dictionary with comparison operators like 'gt', 'gte', 'lt', 'lte' and integer values in smallest currency unit (e.g., cents).",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "status": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Status",
      "examples": [
        "succeeded",
        "pending"
      ],
      "description": "Only return top-ups that have the given status. One of: canceled, failed, pending, or succeeded."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Created",
      "examples": [
        "{'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}",
        "{'lt': 1640995200}"
      ],
      "description": "Filters top-ups by creation date using a dictionary with keys like 'gt', 'gte', 'lt', 'lte' and Unix timestamp values.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "tu_12345"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for pagination. A top-up ID that defines your place in the list; returns top-ups listed before this top-up. Use a top-up ID from a previous response to fetch the previous page."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "tu_67890"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor for pagination. A top-up ID that defines your place in the list; returns top-ups listed after this top-up. Use a top-up ID from a previous response to fetch the next page."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_LIST_TRANSFERS
List all transfers sent to connected accounts. Transfers are returned in reverse chronological order. Use when you need to retrieve transfer history or monitor funds sent to connected accounts.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListTransfersRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10."
    },
    "created": {

          "lte": 1640995200
        },
        {
          "gt": 1609459200
        }
      ],
      "description": "Filter transfers by their creation date range. Provide a dictionary with keys like 'gt' (greater than), 'gte' (greater than or equal to), 'lt' (less than), or 'lte' (less than or equal to) and Unix timestamp values (seconds since epoch). For instance, `{'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}` filters for transfers created from January 1, 2021, to January 1, 2022.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer"
      }

    "destination": {

      ],

    },
    "ending_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ending Before",
      "examples": [
        "tr_1AbCdEfGhIjKlMnO",
        "tr_1XyZ123456789"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination to fetch the previous page of results. `ending_before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if a list request returns objects starting with `tr_XYZ`, your subsequent call can include `ending_before='tr_XYZ'` to fetch the previous page."
    },
    "starting_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Starting After",
      "examples": [
        "tr_1AbCdEfGhIjKlMnO",
        "tr_1XyZ123456789"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for use in pagination to fetch the next page of results. `starting_after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if a list request returns objects and the last object's ID is `tr_ABC`, your subsequent call can include `starting_after='tr_ABC'` to fetch the next page."
    },
    "transfer_group": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Transfer Group",
      "examples": [
        "ORDER_12345",
        "group_abc123"
      ],
      "description": "Only return transfers with the specified transfer group."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for listing transfers in Stripe."
```

## STRIPE_LIST_V2_CORE_EVENTS
Tool to list v2 core events from Stripe. Use when you need to retrieve a list of events with thin payloads containing references to changed objects. These events are unversioned and require fetching the related object for full details.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListV2CoreEventsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "page": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Page",
      "description": "The requested page. Use the next_page or previous_page URL from a previous response to paginate through results."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "The page size. Maximum number of events to return per page."
    },
    "types": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Types",
      "examples": [
        [
          "v1.billing.meter.error_report_triggered"
        ],
        [
          "v1.billing.meter.error_report_triggered",
          "v1.billing.meter.no_meter_found"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "An array of up to 20 strings containing specific event names to filter by. Only events matching these types will be returned."
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "CreatedFilter",
      "properties": {
        "gt": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Gt",
          "examples": [
            "2024-09-26T17:46:22.134Z"
          ],
          "description": "Return events created after this ISO 8601 timestamp (exclusive). Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ"
        },
        "lt": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Lt",
          "examples": [
            "2024-09-26T17:46:22.134Z"
          ],
          "description": "Return events created before this ISO 8601 timestamp (exclusive). Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ"
        },
        "gte": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Gte",
          "examples": [
            "2024-09-26T17:46:22.134Z"
          ],
          "description": "Return events created after or at this ISO 8601 timestamp (inclusive). Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ"
        },
        "lte": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Lte",
          "examples": [
            "2024-09-26T17:46:22.134Z"
          ],
          "description": "Return events created before or at this ISO 8601 timestamp (inclusive). Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ"
        }
      },
      "description": "Timestamp range filter for event creation time.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "object_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Id",
      "examples": [
        "ch_3NMBxOLkdIwHu7ix0SNM0cFf"
      ],
      "description": "Primary object ID used to retrieve related events. Filter events to only those related to this specific object."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for listing v2 core events."
}
```

## STRIPE_MARK_INVOICE_UNCOLLECTIBLE
Tool to mark a Stripe invoice as uncollectible for bad debt accounting purposes. Use when you need to write off an unpaid invoice that is unlikely to be collected.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "MarkInvoiceUncollectibleRequest",
  "required": [
    "invoice"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "invoice": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Invoice",
      "pattern": "^in_[a-zA-Z0-9]+$",
      "examples": [
        "in_1ShVoyQvM72TjFrbhGiU9Ap3",
        "in_1MtG0nLkdIwHu7ixAaUw3Cb4"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the invoice to mark as uncollectible. Must start with 'in_' followed by alphanumeric characters."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for marking an invoice as uncollectible."
}
```
