## STRIPE_MIGRATE_SUBSCRIPTION
Migrate a subscription from classic to flexible billing mode. Use when upgrading billing mode to enable flexible proration and invoice calculation. Requires Stripe API version 2025-06-30.basil or later.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "MigrateSubscriptionRequest",
  "required": [
    "subscription",
    "billing_mode"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "billing_mode": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Billing Mode",
      "required": [
        "type"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "flexible",
          "title": "Type",
          "description": "Controls the calculation and orchestration of prorations and invoices. Must be 'flexible' for migration."
        },
        "flexible": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "BillingModeFlexible",
          "properties": {
            "proration_discounts": {
              "enum": [
                "included",
                "itemized"
              ],
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Proration Discounts",
              "description": "Controls how invoices and invoice items display proration amounts and discount amounts. 'included' means amounts are net of discounts, 'itemized' means amounts are gross of discounts."
            }
          },
          "description": "Configuration for flexible billing mode.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      },
      "description": "Controls how prorations and invoices are calculated and orchestrated. Type must be 'flexible' to migrate from classic billing mode.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "subscription": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subscription",
      "examples": [
        "sub_1ShVoIQvM72TjFrbXu1vqLAN"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the subscription to migrate from classic to flexible billing mode."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for migrating a subscription to flexible billing mode."
}
```

## STRIPE_PAY_INVOICE
Tool to pay an invoice manually outside the normal collection schedule. Use when you need to manually trigger payment on an invoice or mark it as paid externally using paid_out_of_band parameter.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PayInvoiceRequest",
  "required": [
    "invoice"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "source": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Source",
      "examples": [
        "card_1J2x3y4z5A6b7c8d"
      ],
      "description": "Payment source ID belonging to the associated customer."
    },
    "forgive": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Forgive",
      "description": "When true, charges available amount up to invoice total and forgives the difference if insufficient funds exist. Defaults to false."
    },
    "invoice": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Invoice",
      "examples": [
        "in_1MtGmCLkdIwHu7ix6PgS6g8S"
      ],
      "description": "The invoice ID to pay."
    },
    "mandate": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mandate",
      "examples": [
        "mandate_1J2x3y4z5A6b7c8d"
      ],
      "description": "Mandate ID corresponding to the payment method used."
    },
    "off_session": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Off Session",
      "description": "Indicates whether customer is present during payment. Defaults to true."
    },
    "payment_method": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Method",
      "examples": [
        "pm_card_visa"
      ],
      "description": "PaymentMethod ID belonging to the associated customer."
    },
    "paid_out_of_band": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Paid Out Of Band",
      "description": "Marks invoice as paid externally without charging. Defaults to false."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for paying an invoice manually outside normal collection schedule."
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_BILLING_CREDIT_GRANTS_VOID_CREDIT_GRANT
Voids a billing credit grant, preventing it from being applied to future invoices. This operation is irreversible and marks the credit grant with a voided_at timestamp.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostBillingCreditGrantsVoidCreditGrantRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "credgr_test_61TqtkJaF5MLr3Cfb41QvM72TjFrbGYK"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier for the credit grant object to be voided. Typically starts with 'credgr_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for voiding a billing credit grant."
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_CHARGES_CHARGE
Updates a Stripe charge with the specified parameters; unspecified fields remain unchanged. Use when you need to modify charge details like customer association, description, fraud details, metadata, receipt email, shipping information, or transfer group.

## STRIPE_POST_CUSTOMERS_SOURCES_VERIFY_THE_BANK_ACCOUNT
Verifies a bank account for a customer using microdeposit amounts. Use when you need to confirm ownership of a bank account by providing the amounts of two microdeposits sent to the account.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostCustomersSourcesVerifyTheBankAccountRequest",
  "required": [
    "customer_id",
    "bank_account_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "amounts": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "integer"
      },
      "title": "Amounts",
      "examples": [
        [
          32,
          45
        ],
        [
          12,
          67
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Two positive integers, in cents, equal to the values of the microdeposits sent to the bank account. Used to verify ownership of the bank account. Each value should be between 1 and 99 cents."
    },
    "customer_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer Id",
      "examples": [
        "cus_TepTNlDoJqf3p8",
        "cus_9s6XI9OFIdpjIg"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier for the customer. Must start with 'cus_' followed by alphanumeric characters."
    },
    "bank_account_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Bank Account Id",
      "examples": [
        "ba_1ShVovQvM72TjFrbr8pdkf6o",
        "ba_1MvoIJ2eZvKYlo2CO9f0MabO"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier for the bank account to verify. Must start with 'ba_' followed by alphanumeric characters."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for verifying a customer's bank account."
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_FILE_LINKS_LINK
Tool to update an existing file link in Stripe. Use when you need to modify the expiration time or metadata of a file link. Note: Expired links cannot be updated.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostFileLinksLinkRequest",
  "required": [
    "link"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "link": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Link",
      "examples": [
        "link_1ShVotQvM72TjFrbaj0PKTxy",
        "link_1Mr23jLkdIwHu7ix65betcoo"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the file link to update."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "order_id": "12345",
          "test_key": "test_value"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs for storing additional information about the file link. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to metadata.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "expires_at": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "integer"
        },
        {
          "type": "string"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Expires At",
      "examples": [
        1735689600,
        "now"
      ],
      "description": "A future timestamp after which the link will no longer be usable, or the string 'now' to expire the link immediately. If null, the link never expires."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating an existing file link in Stripe."
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_PAYMENT_RECORDS_REPORT_PAYMENT
Tool to report a payment record in terminal state or for initialization. Use when you need to report payments that occurred on- or off-Stripe to create a unified payment history.

## STRIPE_POST_SETUP_INTENTS_INTENT
Updates a SetupIntent object to modify configuration parameters and metadata. Use when you need to update an existing SetupIntent before completion.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostSetupIntentsIntentRequest",
  "required": [
    "intent"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "intent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Intent",
      "examples": [
        "seti_1ShVroQvM72TjFrbWwY5yqwF"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the SetupIntent to update."
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "Customer ID to associate with this SetupIntent; payment method will attach to Customer on successful setup."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "test_key": "test_value"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Key-value pairs for structured data storage; individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value, all keys can be unset by posting an empty value to metadata.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "examples": [
        "Updated SetupIntent for testing"
      ],
      "description": "Arbitrary string for display purposes."
    },
    "attach_to_self": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Attach To Self",
      "description": "If set, attaches the payment method to the Stripe Account for money movement flows like transfers; cannot be true when setting up for a Customer."
    },
    "payment_method": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Method",
      "examples": [
        "pm_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "ID of existing PaymentMethod, Card, or Source to attach; pass empty string to unset."
    },
    "flow_directions": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "enum": [
          "inbound",
          "outbound"
        ],
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Flow Directions",
      "examples": [
        [
          "inbound"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Indicates money movement direction: 'inbound' or 'outbound'."
    },
    "customer_account": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer Account",
      "examples": [
        "acct_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "Account ID to associate; payment method attaches to Account on successful setup."
    },
    "payment_method_types": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Payment Method Types",
      "examples": [
        [
          "card",
          "us_bank_account"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of allowed payment method types."
    },
    "payment_method_configuration": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Method Configuration",
      "examples": [
        "pmc_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "ID of payment method configuration (max 100 characters)."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating a SetupIntent."
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_SUBSCRIPTION_ITEMS_ITEM
Tool to update a subscription item's plan, quantity, billing thresholds, discounts, or metadata. Use when you need to modify an existing subscription item. Changes may trigger prorations.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostSubscriptionItemsItemRequest",
  "required": [
    "item"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "item": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Item",
      "examples": [
        "si_123abc"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the subscription item to update."
    },
    "price": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Price",
      "examples": [
        "price_123abc"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the price object. Either price or price_data is required if changing the price."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "order_id": "12345",
          "department": "sales"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs for storing additional structured information about the subscription item.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "quantity": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Quantity",
      "examples": [
        1,
        5,
        10
      ],
      "description": "Quantity of the subscription item."
    },
    "discounts": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "Discount",
        "properties": {
          "coupon": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Coupon",
            "examples": [
              "coupon_123"
            ],
            "description": "ID of the coupon to create a new discount. Mutually exclusive with discount and promotion_code."
          },
          "discount": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Discount",
            "examples": [
              "di_123"
            ],
            "description": "ID of an existing discount. Mutually exclusive with coupon and promotion_code."
          },
          "promotion_code": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Promotion Code",
            "examples": [
              "promo_123"
            ],
            "description": "ID of the promotion code to create a new discount. Mutually exclusive with coupon and discount."
          }
        },
        "description": "Discount to apply to the subscription item."
      },
      "title": "Discounts",
      "description": "List of discounts to apply to this subscription item. Replaces existing discounts."
    },
    "tax_rates": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Tax Rates",
      "examples": [
        [
          "txr_123",
          "txr_456"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of tax rate IDs to override the subscription's default tax rates for this item."
    },
    "price_data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "PriceData",
      "required": [
        "currency",
        "product",
        "recurring"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "product": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Product",
          "examples": [
            "prod_123"
          ],
          "description": "ID of the product this price is for."
        },
        "currency": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Currency",
          "examples": [
            "usd",
            "eur",
            "gbp"
          ],
          "description": "Three-letter ISO currency code in lowercase."
        },
        "recurring": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Recurring",
          "required": [
            "interval"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "interval": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Interval",
              "examples": [
                "month",
                "year"
              ],
              "description": "Billing frequency. One of: day, week, month, or year."
            },
            "interval_count": {
              "type": "integer",
              "title": "Interval Count",
              "examples": [
                1,
                3,
                12
              ],
              "description": "Number of intervals between billings. Maximum 36 months if interval is month."
            }
          },
          "description": "Recurring components of the price such as interval and interval_count.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "unit_amount": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Unit Amount",
          "examples": [
            1000,
            2500
          ],
          "description": "Amount in cents for the price. Required if unit_amount_decimal is not provided."
        },
        "tax_behavior": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Tax Behavior",
          "examples": [
            "inclusive",
            "exclusive"
          ],
          "description": "Tax treatment for the price. One of: inclusive, exclusive, or unspecified."
        },
        "unit_amount_decimal": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Unit Amount Decimal",
          "examples": [
            "1000.50",
            "2499.99"
          ],
          "description": "Decimal amount in cents. Required if unit_amount is not provided. Supports up to 12 decimal places."
        }
      },
      "description": "Inline price object generation for the subscription item.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "off_session": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Off Session",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Indicates if the payment is being made off-session. Defaults to false."
    },
    "proration_date": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Proration Date",
      "examples": [
        1609459200
      ],
      "description": "Unix timestamp to calculate prorations as if the update occurred at this time."
    },
    "payment_behavior": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Behavior",
      "examples": [
        "allow_incomplete",
        "error_if_incomplete"
      ],
      "description": "Payment behavior when payment collection fails. One of: allow_incomplete, default_incomplete, error_if_incomplete, pending_if_incomplete."
    },
    "billing_thresholds": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "BillingThresholds",
      "required": [
        "usage_gte"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "usage_gte": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Usage Gte",
          "examples": [
            1000,
            5000
          ],
          "description": "Usage threshold that triggers the subscription to advance to a new billing period."
        }
      },
      "description": "Usage-based billing thresholds for the subscription item.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "proration_behavior": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Proration Behavior",
      "examples": [
        "create_prorations",
        "none"
      ],
      "description": "How to handle prorations during billing changes. One of: create_prorations (default), always_invoice, none."
    }
  },
  "description": "Parameters for updating a subscription item."
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_TERMINAL_CONFIGURATIONS_CONFIGURATION
Tool to update a Stripe Terminal Configuration. Use when you need to modify terminal reader settings including device-specific configurations, offline transaction capabilities, security settings, reboot windows, WiFi credentials, or tipping configurations. Changes can take up to 10 minutes to reflect on target readers.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostTerminalConfigurationsConfigurationRequest",
  "required": [
    "configuration"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Updated Configuration",
        "Store Configuration"
      ],
      "maxLength": 100,
      "description": "Configuration identifier/name. Maximum 100 characters."
    },
    "wifi": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "WiFiSettings",
      "required": [
        "type"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "enum": [
            "personal_psk",
            "enterprise_eap_peap",
            "enterprise_eap_tls"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Type",
          "examples": [
            "personal_psk",
            "enterprise_eap_peap"
          ],
          "description": "WiFi security type. Must be one of: personal_psk (WPA-Personal), enterprise_eap_peap (WPA-Enterprise EAP-PEAP), or enterprise_eap_tls (WPA-Enterprise EAP-TLS)."
        },
        "personal_psk": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "WiFiPersonalPsk",
          "required": [
            "ssid",
            "password"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "ssid": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Ssid",
              "examples": [
                "MyNetwork",
                "Office_WiFi"
              ],
              "description": "Network name (SSID) for the WiFi network."
            },
            "password": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Password",
              "examples": [
                "mypassword123"
              ],
              "maxLength": 63,
              "description": "Network password. Maximum 63 characters."
            }
          },
          "description": "WPA-Personal (PSK) WiFi credentials.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "enterprise_eap_tls": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "WiFiEnterpriseEapTls",
          "required": [
            "ssid",
            "client_certificate_file",
            "private_key_file"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "ssid": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Ssid",
              "examples": [
                "SecureNetwork"
              ],
              "description": "Network name (SSID) for the WiFi network."
            },
            "private_key_file": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Private Key File",
              "examples": [
                "file_privatekey123"
              ],
              "description": "File ID for the RSA private key PEM file."
            },
            "ca_certificate_file": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Ca Certificate File",
              "examples": [
                "file_cacert123"
              ],
              "description": "File ID for the server certificate PEM file."
            },
            "client_certificate_file": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Client Certificate File",
              "examples": [
                "file_clientcert123"
              ],
              "description": "File ID for the client certificate PEM file."
            },
            "private_key_file_password": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Private Key File Password",
              "examples": [
                "keypassword"
              ],
              "description": "Password for the private key file, if encrypted."
            }
          },
          "description": "WPA-Enterprise EAP-TLS WiFi credentials.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "enterprise_eap_peap": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "WiFiEnterpriseEapPeap",
          "required": [
            "ssid",
            "username",
            "password"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "ssid": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Ssid",
              "examples": [
                "EnterpriseNetwork"
              ],
              "description": "Network name (SSID) for the WiFi network."
            },
            "password": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Password",
              "examples": [
                "securepassword"
              ],
              "description": "Authentication password for the network."
            },
            "username": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Username",
              "examples": [
                "user@company.com"
              ],
              "description": "Authentication username for the network."
            },
            "ca_certificate_file": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Ca Certificate File",
              "examples": [
                "file_cert123"
              ],
              "description": "File ID for the server certificate PEM file."
            }
          },
          "description": "WPA-Enterprise EAP-PEAP WiFi credentials.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      },
      "description": "WiFi network credentials for terminal readers.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "offline": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "OfflineSettings",
      "required": [
        "enabled"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "enabled": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Enabled",
          "examples": [
            true,
            false
          ],
          "description": "Enable offline transactions. When true, the reader can process payments while disconnected from the internet."
        }
      },
      "description": "Offline transaction settings.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "tipping": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Tipping",
      "examples": [
        {
          "usd": {
            "percentages": [
              10,
              15,
              20
            ],
            "fixed_amounts": [
              100,
              200,
              300
            ]
          }
        }
      ],
      "description": "Tipping configuration by currency code (e.g., 'usd', 'eur'). Supports: AED, AUD, BGN, CAD, CHF, CZK, DKK, EUR, GBP, GIP, HKD, HUF, JPY, MXN, MYR, NOK, NZD, PLN, RON, SEK, SGD, USD.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "CurrencyTippingSettings",
        "properties": {
          "percentages": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "integer"
                },
                "maxItems": 10
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "title": "Percentages",
            "default": null,
            "examples": [
              [
                10,
                15,
                20
              ],
              [
                15,
                18,
                22
              ]
            ],
            "description": "Percentage tip options to display. Maximum of 10 values."
          },
          "fixed_amounts": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "integer"
                },
                "maxItems": 10
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "title": "Fixed Amounts",
            "default": null,
            "examples": [
              [
                100,
                200,
                300
              ],
              [
                500,
                1000,
                1500
              ]
            ],
            "description": "Fixed tip amounts to display (in smallest currency unit, e.g., cents). Maximum of 10 values."
          },
          "smart_tip_threshold": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "integer"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "title": "Smart Tip Threshold",
            "default": null,
            "examples": [
              10000,
              20000
            ],
            "description": "Threshold amount (in smallest currency unit) for switching from fixed amounts to percentage tips."
          }
        },
        "description": "Tipping configuration for a specific currency."
      }
    },
    "stripe_s700": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "DeviceSplashscreen",
      "properties": {
        "splashscreen": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Splashscreen",
          "examples": [
            "file_1234567890abcdef"
          ],
          "description": "File ID for the splash screen image to display on the device."
        }
      },
      "description": "Device-specific splash screen settings.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "configuration": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Configuration",
      "examples": [
        "tmc_1234567890abcdef",
        "tmc_test_61TqpHTmP4zMHAj9T41QvM72TjFrb6To"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the terminal configuration to update."
    },
    "reboot_window": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "RebootWindowSettings",
      "required": [
        "start_hour",
        "end_hour"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "end_hour": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "End Hour",
          "maximum": 23,
          "minimum": 0,
          "examples": [

          ],
          "description": "End hour of the reboot window (0-23). Must differ from start_hour."
        },
        "start_hour": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Start Hour",
          "maximum": 23,
          "minimum": 0,
          "examples": [
            2,
            3
          ],
          "description": "Start hour of the reboot window (0-23). The reader will reboot during this window."
        }
      },
      "description": "Customized reboot time window for terminal readers.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "verifone_p400": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "DeviceSplashscreen",
      "properties": {
        "splashscreen": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Splashscreen",
          "examples": [
            "file_1234567890abcdef"
          ],
          "description": "File ID for the splash screen image to display on the device."
        }
      },
      "description": "Device-specific splash screen settings.",
```

## STRIPE_POST_TERMINAL_READERS_READER_PROCESS_PAYMENT_INTENT
Initiates a payment flow on a Stripe Terminal Reader to process a PaymentIntent. Use when you need to hand off a PaymentIntent to a physical card reader for customer payment. The reader must be online and not currently processing another action, and the PaymentIntent must be in requires_capture or requires_payment_method state. The response returns immediately with action status 'in_progress'; poll the Reader object or use webhooks to determine completion.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostTerminalReadersReaderProcessPaymentIntentRequest",
  "required": [
    "reader",
    "payment_intent"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "reader": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reader",
      "examples": [
        "tmr_1234567890",
        "tmr_GUdgOws6gw46M7"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the Reader device that will process the payment."
    },
    "payment_intent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Intent",
      "examples": [
        "pi_1234567890",
        "pi_3ShVtcQvM72TjFrb0TYzTAuc"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the PaymentIntent to process on the reader."
    },
    "process_config": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "ProcessConfig",
      "properties": {
        "tipping": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "ProcessConfigTipping",
          "properties": {
            "amount_eligible": {
              "type": "integer",
              "title": "Amount Eligible",
              "examples": [
                1000,
                2500
              ],
              "description": "Amount for calculating tip suggestions. Must be positive and in smallest currency unit (e.g., 100 cents = $1.00)."
            }
          },
          "description": "Configuration for tipping behavior.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "return_url": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Return Url",
          "examples": [
            "https://example.com/return"
          ],
          "description": "Redirect destination after payment authentication or cancellation."
        },
        "skip_tipping": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Skip Tipping",
          "description": "Override showing a tipping selection screen on this transaction."
        },
        "allow_redisplay": {
          "enum": [
            "always",
            "limited",
            "unspecified"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Allow Redisplay",
          "description": "Determines if payment method appears in future checkout flows. Can be 'always', 'limited', or 'unspecified'."
        },
        "enable_customer_cancellation": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Enable Customer Cancellation",
          "description": "Enables cancel button on transaction screens, permitting customers to cancel during processing."
        }
      },
      "description": "Transaction configuration overrides.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for processing a PaymentIntent on a Terminal Reader."
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_TERMINAL_READERS_READER_SET_READER_DISPLAY
Configures a Stripe terminal reader to display cart information on screen. Use when you need to show customers their purchase details on a physical terminal device during checkout. Supported on Verifone P400, BBPOS WisePOS E, and Stripe Reader S700.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostTerminalReadersReaderSetReaderDisplayRequest",
  "required": [
    "reader",
    "type",
    "cart"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "cart": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Cart",
      "required": [
        "currency",
        "line_items",
        "total"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "tax": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Tax",
          "examples": [
            150,
            500,
            0
          ],
          "description": "The tax amount included in the total, in the smallest currency unit. If provided, must be a non-negative integer."
        },
        "total": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Total",
          "examples": [
            1500,
            5000,
            12500
          ],
          "description": "The total amount of the cart in the smallest currency unit. Should equal the sum of all line item amounts (amount \u00d7 quantity). Must be a positive integer."
        },
        "currency": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Currency",
          "examples": [
            "usd",
            "eur",
            "gbp"
          ],
          "description": "Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in lowercase (e.g., 'usd', 'eur', 'gbp'). Must match a currency supported by Stripe."
        },
        "line_items": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "LineItem",
            "required": [
              "amount",
              "description",
              "quantity"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "amount": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Amount",
                "examples": [
                  1000,
                  500,
                  2500
                ],
                "description": "The price of the item in the smallest currency unit (e.g., 1000 for $10.00 USD). Must be a positive integer."
              },
              "quantity": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Quantity",
                "examples": [
                  1,
                  2,
                  5
                ],
                "description": "The quantity of this item being purchased. Must be a positive integer."
              },
              "description": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Description",
                "examples": [
                  "Coffee Mug",
                  "T-Shirt",
                  "Wireless Headphones"
                ],
                "description": "The name or description of the product being purchased. This will be displayed to the customer on the reader."
              }
            },
            "description": "Line item in the shopping cart."
          },
          "title": "Line Items",
          "description": "Array of line items representing products in the cart. Each item includes amount, description, and quantity."
        }
      },
      "description": "Cart object containing the line items, total, currency, and optional tax to display on the reader.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "type": {
      "type": "string",
      "const": "cart",
      "title": "Type",
      "description": "The type of information to display on the reader. Currently only 'cart' is supported."
    },
    "reader": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reader",
      "examples": [
        "tmr_GUdgOws6gw46M7",
        "tmr_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the terminal reader to update. Typically starts with 'tmr_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to set the display on a Stripe terminal reader."
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_TERMINAL_READERS_SET_READER_DISPLAY
Tool to configure a terminal reader's display to show cart details. Use when you need to display line items, amounts, and currency information on a Stripe Terminal reader screen.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostTerminalReadersSetReaderDisplayRequest",
  "required": [
    "reader_id",
    "type",
    "cart"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "cart": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Cart",
      "required": [
        "currency",
        "total",
        "line_items"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "tax": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Tax",
          "examples": [
            100,
            250
          ],
          "description": "The tax amount in the smallest currency unit."
        },
        "total": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Total",
          "examples": [
            5000,
            10000
          ],
          "description": "Total balance of cart due with tax and shipping in the smallest currency unit (e.g., 100 cents to charge $1.00)."
        },
        "currency": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Currency",
          "examples": [
            "usd",
            "eur",
            "gbp"
          ],
          "description": "Three-letter ISO currency code in lowercase. Must be a supported currency."
        },
        "line_items": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "LineItem",
            "required": [
              "amount",
              "description",
              "quantity"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "amount": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Amount",
                "examples": [
                  1000,
                  2500
                ],
                "description": "The price of the item in the smallest currency unit (e.g., 100 cents to charge $1.00)."
              },
              "quantity": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Quantity",
                "examples": [
                  1,
                  2,
                  5
                ],
                "description": "The quantity of the item being purchased."
              },
              "description": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Description",
                "examples": [
                  "T-shirt",
                  "Coffee Mug"
                ],
                "description": "The description or name of the item."
              }
            },
            "description": "Individual line item to display on the reader."
          },
          "title": "Line Items",
          "description": "Array of line items representing the items in the cart."
        }
      },
      "description": "Cart object containing the cart's total, tax, currency, and line items.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Type",
      "examples": [
        "cart"
      ],
      "description": "Type of information to display. Currently only 'cart' is supported."
    },
    "reader_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reader Id",
      "examples": [
        "tmr_GUdgOws6gw46M7",
        "tmr_FDOt2wlRZEdpd7"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the terminal reader. Must start with 'tmr_' followed by alphanumeric characters."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for setting reader display."
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_V1_ACCOUNTS_CAPABILITIES_CAPABILITIES
Updates an existing account capability for a Stripe connected account. Use when you need to request a new capability or remove a non-permanent capability. There may be a delay before the requested capability becomes active, and the response includes any activation requirements.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostV1AccountsCapabilitiesCapabilitiesRequest",
  "required": [
    "account",
    "capability"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "account": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Account",
      "examples": [
        "acct_1Q11MrQvM72TjFrb"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the Stripe account for which to update the capability. Typically starts with 'acct_'."
    },
    "requested": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Requested",
      "description": "Set to true to request a new capability for the account; pass false to remove non-permanent capabilities. There can be a delay before the requested capability becomes active."
    },
    "capability": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Capability",
      "examples": [
        "card_payments",
        "giropay_payments",
        "transfers"
      ],
      "description": "The specific capability name to update (e.g., card_payments, transfers, giropay_payments, us_bank_account_ach_payments)."
    },
    "experimental": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Experimental",
      "description": "When true, assigns the experimental onboarding policy to the capability. Use with caution as this may affect the capability activation process."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating an account capability."
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_V1_BALANCE_SETTINGS_OVERVIEW
Tool to update balance settings for a Stripe account. Use when customizing payout schedules, settlement timing, or negative balance handling for a connected account.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostV1BalanceSettingsOverviewRequest",
  "properties": {
    "payments": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Payments",
      "properties": {
        "payouts": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Payouts",
          "properties": {
            "schedule": {
              "type": "object",
              "title": "PayoutsSchedule",
              "properties": {
                "interval": {
                  "enum": [
                    "manual",
                    "daily",
                    "weekly",
                    "monthly"
                  ],
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Interval",
                  "examples": [
                    "daily",
                    "weekly",
                    "monthly"
                  ],
                  "description": "The frequency of payouts. One of: manual, daily, weekly, or monthly."
                },
                "weekly_payout_days": {
                  "type": "array",
                  "items": {
                    "type": "string"
                  },
                  "title": "Weekly Payout Days",
                  "examples": [
                    [
                      "monday",
                      "wednesday"
                    ],
                    [
                      "friday"
                    ]
                  ],
                  "description": "Array of weekday strings when interval is 'weekly'. Valid values: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday."
                },
                "monthly_payout_days": {
                  "type": "array",
                  "items": {
                    "type": "integer"
                  },
                  "title": "Monthly Payout Days",
                  "examples": [
                    [
                      5,
                      20
                    ],
                    [
                      15
                    ]
                  ],
                  "description": "Array of integers (1-31) specifying days of the month for monthly payouts. Days 29-31 resolve to month-end."
                }
              },
              "description": "Payout schedule configuration.",
              "additionalProperties": false
            },
            "statement_descriptor": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Statement Descriptor",
              "examples": [
                "ACME Corp Payout",
                "Marketplace Earnings"
              ],
              "description": "Specifies the text that appears on the bank account statement for payouts."
            },
            "minimum_balance_by_currency": {
              "type": "object",
              "title": "Minimum Balance By Currency",
              "examples": [
                {
                  "cad": 8000,
                  "usd": 1500
                }
              ],
              "description": "Defines the minimum balance amount to retain per currency after automatic payouts. Only funds in excess of that currency are paid out. Hash with currency codes as keys and amounts (in cents) as values.",
              "additionalProperties": {
                "type": "integer"
              }
            }
          },
          "description": "Payout-specific settings.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "settlement_timing": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "SettlementTiming",
          "properties": {
            "delay_days_override": {
              "anyOf": [
                {
                  "type": "integer"
                },
                {
                  "type": "string"
                }
              ],
              "title": "Delay Days Override",
              "examples": [
                3,
                7,
                15,
                ""
              ],
              "description": "Can be set to a number up to 31 to customize settlement delay, or set to empty string to reset to default."
            }
          },
          "description": "Settlement timing configuration for pending funds.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "debit_negative_balances": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Debit Negative Balances",
          "description": "A Boolean indicating whether Stripe should try to reclaim negative balances from an attached bank account."
        }
      },
      "description": "Payment-related settings.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "stripe_account": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Stripe Account",
      "examples": [
        "acct_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "The connected account ID for which to update balance settings. If not provided, updates settings for the authenticated account."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating balance settings."
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_V1_CHECKOUT_SESSIONS_RETRIEVE_A_CHECKOUT
Tool to update and retrieve a Checkout Session object from Stripe. Use when you need to update metadata or other fields while retrieving the session details.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostV1CheckoutSessionsRetrieveACheckoutRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "cs_test_a1rJTOb7Ezslvi7qrd9G8tDolXhWD7NcjcPdCDkiZok4f1OH8nnhINHMgx"
      ],
      "description": "The checkout session identifier, typically starting with 'cs_'."
    },
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "customer",
          "payment_intent"
        ],
        [
          "line_items"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded. Supports nested expansion using dot notation (e.g., 'payment_intent.customer'). Common expandable fields include: customer, payment_intent, subscription, invoice, line_items, payment_link."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "order_id": "12345",
          "test_key": "test_value"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to the session object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the session in a structured format.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating and retrieving a checkout session."
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_V1_CREDIT_NOTES_CREDIT_NOTE2
Tool to update an existing credit note in Stripe by modifying its memo or metadata. Use when you need to add context or store additional information on an already-issued credit note.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostV1CreditNotesCreditNote2Request",
  "required": [
    "credit_note_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "memo": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Memo",
      "examples": [
        "Updated via API test",
        "Refund for order #12345"
      ],
      "description": "Credit note memo text that appears on the PDF sent to customers. Use this to provide context or explanation for the credit note."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "order_id": "12345",
          "test_key": "test_value"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting empty values to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to metadata.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "credit_note_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Credit Note Id",
      "examples": [
        "cn_1ShVoeQvM72TjFrbADJWTHBR"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the credit note to update."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating an existing credit note in Stripe.\nOnly memo and metadata fields can be modified after a credit note is created."
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_V1_CUSTOMERS_FUNDING_INSTRUCTIONS_FUND_A_TEST
Creates or retrieves funding instructions for a customer cash balance via bank transfer. Returns bank account details (ABA, IBAN, etc.) that can be used to fund the customer's account. If funding instructions already exist for the customer, the same instructions will be returned.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostV1CustomersFundingInstructionsFundATestRequest",
  "required": [
    "customer_id",
    "funding_type",
    "currency",
    "bank_transfer"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "currency": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Currency",
      "examples": [
        "usd",
        "eur",
        "gbp"
      ],
      "description": "Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in lowercase. Determines which bank account details are returned (e.g., 'usd' for US bank accounts, 'eur' for IBAN)."
    },
    "customer_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer Id",
      "examples": [
        "cus_TepdDhbY0CO9Ub",
        "cus_ABC123xyz"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the customer for whom to create or retrieve funding instructions. Must be a valid Stripe customer ID starting with 'cus_'."
    },
    "funding_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Funding Type",
      "examples": [
        "bank_transfer"
      ],
      "description": "The funding method type. Currently only 'bank_transfer' is supported."
    },
    "bank_transfer": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Bank Transfer",
      "required": [
        "type"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Type",
          "examples": [
            "us_bank_transfer",
            "eu_bank_transfer",
            "gb_bank_transfer"
          ],
          "description": "The type of bank transfer. Must be one of: 'eu_bank_transfer', 'gb_bank_transfer', 'jp_bank_transfer', 'mx_bank_transfer', 'us_bank_transfer'."
        },
        "eu_bank_transfer": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Eu Bank Transfer",
          "examples": [
            {
              "country": "DE"
            },
            {
              "country": "FR"
            }
          ],
          "description": "Additional configuration for EU bank transfers. Should include 'country' field with a two-letter country code. Supported: 'BE', 'DE', 'ES', 'FR', 'IE', 'NL'.",
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "requested_address_types": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Requested Address Types",
          "examples": [
            [
              "aba"
            ],
            [
              "iban",
              "swift"
            ],
            [
              "sort_code"
            ]
          ],
          "description": "The list of address types that should be returned in the financial_addresses response. Supported types: 'aba', 'iban', 'sort_code', 'spei', 'swift', 'zengin'."
        }
      },
      "description": "Configuration specifying the type of bank transfer and optional parameters like requested address types and EU country.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for creating or retrieving customer funding instructions."
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_V1_CUSTOMERS_SEARCH_CUSTOMERS
Tool to search for Stripe customers using a search query. Use when you need to find customers by email, name, metadata, or other fields using Stripe's Search Query Language.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostV1CustomersSearchCustomersRequest",
  "required": [
    "query"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "page": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Page",
      "examples": [
        "cus_page_1234567890",
        "cus_NffrFeUfNV2Hib_next"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for pagination. Use the next_page value returned in a previous response to fetch the next page of results. Omit this parameter for the first page."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        5,
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of results to return per page. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 10 if not specified."
    },
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "examples": [
        "email:'[email protected]'",
        "metadata['foo']:'bar'",
        "created>1609459200",
        "name:'John Doe'"
      ],
      "description": "The search query string using Stripe's Search Query Language. Supports exact matches, range queries, boolean operators, and metadata searches. For detailed syntax, refer to https://docs.stripe.com/search#search-query-language."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for searching customers in Stripe."
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_V1_INVOICES_FINALIZE_VOID_AN_INVOICE
Voids a finalized invoice and maintains a papertrail. Use when you need to void a finalized invoice that has not been paid. Once voided, the invoice cannot be undone and maintains audit history.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostV1InvoicesFinalizeVoidAnInvoiceRequest",
  "required": [
    "invoice_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "invoice_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Invoice Id",
      "examples": [
        "in_1ShVoyQvM72TjFrbhGiU9Ap3",
        "in_1MtGmCLkdIwHu7ix6PgS6g8S"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the invoice to void. Must be a finalized invoice that hasn't been paid or marked as uncollectible."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for voiding an invoice."
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_V1_INVOICES_LINES_OVERVIEW
Updates an invoice's line item before finalization. Use when you need to modify details of a line item such as description, metadata, amount, or tax settings before the invoice is finalized.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostV1InvoicesLinesOverviewRequest",
  "required": [
    "invoice",
    "line_item_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "amount": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Amount",
      "examples": [
        1500,
        -500,
        10000
      ],
      "description": "The amount to charge in cents. Use negative values for credits."
    },
    "period": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Period",
      "required": [
        "end",
        "start"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "end": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "End",
          "examples": [
            1735689600,
            1767225600
          ],
          "description": "End of the period (inclusive). Must be greater than or equal to start."
        },
        "start": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Start",
          "examples": [
            1704067200,
            1735603200
          ],
          "description": "Start of the period (inclusive)."
        }
      },
      "description": "Period associated with the line item.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "invoice": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Invoice",
      "examples": [
        "in_1ShVr9QvM72TjFrbxAxe7bsk"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the invoice containing the line item to update."
    },
    "pricing": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Pricing",
      "properties": {
        "price": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Price",

          ],
          "description": "The ID of the Price object to use for this line item."
        }
      },
      "description": "Pricing information for the invoice item.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "test_key": "test_value",
          "updated_by": "curl_tester_agent"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs for storing additional structured information about this line item.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "quantity": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Quantity",
      "examples": [

      "description": "Non-negative integer specifying the quantity of units for the line item."

            "type": "string",
            "title": "Discount",
            "examples": [
              "di_1ABC123"
            ],
            "description": "ID of an existing discount. Mutually exclusive with coupon and promotion_code."
          },
          "promotion_code": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Promotion Code",
            "examples": [
              "promo_1ABC123"
            ],
            "description": "ID of the promotion code to apply. Mutually exclusive with coupon and discount."
          }
        },
        "description": "Discount to apply to the line item."
      },
      "title": "Discounts",
```

## STRIPE_POST_V1_INVOICES_REMOVE_LINES_OVERVIEW
Tool to remove multiple line items from a draft Stripe invoice. Use when you need to delete or unassign specific line items from an invoice that hasn't been finalized yet.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostV1InvoicesRemoveLinesOverviewRequest",
  "required": [
    "invoice_id",
    "lines"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "lines": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "LineToRemove",
        "required": [
          "id",
          "behavior"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id",
            "examples": [
              "il_1ShVrhQvM72TjFrbPcn9I8uQ"
            ],
            "description": "ID of an existing line item on the invoice to remove."
          },
          "behavior": {
            "enum": [
              "delete",
              "unassign"
            ],
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Behavior",
            "examples": [
              "delete",
              "unassign"
            ],
            "description": "Action to take on the line item. Use 'delete' to remove the line item from the invoice and delete it permanently, or 'unassign' to remove it from the invoice but move it into a pending state for potential reuse."
          }
        },
        "description": "A line item to remove from the invoice."
      },
      "title": "Lines",
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "Array of line items to remove from the invoice. Each line item must specify an ID and a behavior (delete or unassign)."
    },
    "invoice_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Invoice Id",
      "examples": [
        "in_1ShVr9QvM72TjFrbxAxe7bsk"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the draft invoice from which to remove line items."
    },
    "invoice_metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Invoice Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "reason": "customer_request",
          "updated_by": "admin"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Optional key-value pairs to update on the invoice object itself after removing lines. Useful for storing additional information.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for removing line items from a draft Stripe invoice."
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_V1_INVOICES_SEND_VOID_AN_INVOICE
Tool to void a finalized Stripe invoice. Use when you need to permanently void an invoice while preserving an audit trail. This operation cannot be undone and only works on finalized invoices.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostV1InvoicesSendVoidAnInvoiceRequest",
  "required": [
    "invoice_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "invoice_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Invoice Id",
      "examples": [
        "in_1ShVz0QvM72TjFrb3fI56XNx"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the finalized invoice to void."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for voiding a Stripe invoice."
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_V1_INVOICES_VOID_AN_INVOICE
Tool to permanently void a finalized Stripe invoice. Use when an invoice needs to be canceled while maintaining an audit trail. This operation is irreversible and only applies to finalized invoices.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostV1InvoicesVoidAnInvoiceRequest",
  "required": [
    "invoice_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "invoice_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Invoice Id",
      "examples": [
        "in_1ShVyNQvM72TjFrb3VjedJqp",
        "in_1MtGmCLkdIwHu7ix6PgS6g8S"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the finalized invoice to void."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for voiding an invoice."
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_V1_PAYMENT_METHOD_CONFIGS_LIST_PAYMENT_METHOD2
Updates a payment method configuration to control which payment methods are displayed at checkout. Use when modifying payment method availability or display settings.

## STRIPE_POST_V1_PAYMENT_METHOD_DOMAINS_PAYMENT_METHOD
Updates an existing payment method domain to enable or disable it. Use when you need to control whether payment methods requiring domain verification will appear in Elements or Embedded Checkout.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostV1PaymentMethodDomainsPaymentMethodDomains2Request",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "pmd_1ShRUjQvM72TjFrbBqaUJtO0"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the payment method domain to update. Typically starts with 'pmd_'."
    },
    "enabled": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Enabled",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Determines if the payment method domain is active. When disabled (false), associated payment methods won't display in Elements or Embedded Checkout. When enabled (true), payment methods requiring domain verification will appear in Elements or Embedded Checkout."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating a payment method domain."
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_V1_PAYMENT_RECORDS_REPORT_ATTEMPT
Tool to report a payment attempt on a Stripe Payment Record. Use when updating a Payment Record with payment attempt details such as initiation time and outcome status.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostV1PaymentRecordsReportPaymentAttemptOverviewRequest",
  "required": [
    "payment_record_id",
    "initiated_at",
    "outcome"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "outcome": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Outcome",
      "examples": [
        "guaranteed"
      ],
      "description": "The outcome of the payment attempt (e.g., 'guaranteed', 'failed')."
    },
    "guaranteed": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "GuaranteedDetails",
      "required": [
        "guaranteed_at"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "guaranteed_at": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Guaranteed At",
          "examples": [
            1734960300
          ],
          "description": "Unix timestamp when the payment was guaranteed."
        }
      },
      "description": "Details for guaranteed payment outcome.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "initiated_at": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Initiated At",
      "examples": [
        1734960200
      ],
      "description": "Unix timestamp when the payment attempt was initiated."
    },
    "payment_record_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Record Id",
      "examples": [
        "pr_test_65Tqu2YCAmmSKoS5wnv41QvM72TjFrbGcq"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the Payment Record."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for reporting a payment attempt on a payment record."
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_V1_PAYMENT_RECORDS_REPORT_CANCELED
Tool to report that the most recent payment attempt was canceled. Use when you need to update a Payment Record to reflect a canceled payment attempt.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostV1PaymentRecordsReportPaymentAttemptCanceledOverviewRequest",
  "required": [
    "id",
    "canceled_at"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "pr_test_65Tqu1EdnfhFTBzFcFB41QvM72TjFrbIBU",
        "pr_5RV730PrHyAEi"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the Payment Record to update. Format: pr_* (e.g., pr_test_65Tqu1EdnfhFTBzFcFB41QvM72TjFrbIBU)"
    },
    "canceled_at": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Canceled At",
      "examples": [
        1734900300
      ],
      "description": "When the reported payment was canceled. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_V1_PAYMENT_RECORDS_REPORT_GUARANTEED
Reports that a payment attempt was guaranteed for a specific Payment Record. Use when confirming that a payment has been successfully guaranteed by the payment processor at a specific timestamp.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostV1PaymentRecordsReportPaymentAttemptGuaranteedOverviewRequest",
  "required": [
    "id",
    "guaranteed_at"
  ],
  "properties": {
```

## STRIPE_POST_V1_PAYMENT_RECORDS_REPORT_INFO
Tool to report additional payment attempt information for a payment record. Use when you need to add informational details about a payment attempt.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostV1PaymentRecordsReportPaymentAttemptInformationalOverviewRequest",
  "required": [
    "payment_record_id",
    "description"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "examples": [
        "Additional payment attempt information"
      ],
```

## STRIPE_POST_V1_PAYMENT_RECORDS_REPORT_REFUND_OVERVIEW
Reports that the most recent payment attempt on a Payment Record was refunded. Use when you need to record a refund for a successfully processed payment to maintain accurate payment records. Multiple partial refunds can be reported until the full amount is refunded.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostV1PaymentRecordsReportRefundRequest",
  "required": [
    "id",
    "outcome",
    "processor_details",
    "refunded"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",

      "examples": [
        "pr_test_65Tqu0hjAqhrChSc6rw41QvM72TjFrb8DA"
      ],
      "description": "The Payment Record identifier."
    },
    "amount": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "AmountDetails",
      "required": [
        "value",
        "currency"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "value": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Value",
          "examples": [
            3000
          ],
          "description": "Amount in the currency's smallest unit (e.g., cents)."
        },
        "currency": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Currency",
          "examples": [
            "usd",
            "eur",
            "gbp"
          ],
          "description": "Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase (e.g., 'usd')."
        }
      },
      "description": "Refund amount details.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "outcome": {
      "type": "string",
      "const": "refunded",
      "title": "Outcome",
      "examples": [
        "refunded"
      ],
      "description": "Must be set to 'refunded' to report a refund."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs for storing additional information in a structured format.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "refunded": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Refunded",
      "required": [
        "refunded_at"
      ],
      "properties": {

          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Refunded At",
          "examples": [

          ],
          "description": "Unix epoch timestamp when the refund was completed."
        }
      },
      "description": "Information about the payment attempt refund.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "initiated_at": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Initiated At",

      ],
      "description": "Unix epoch timestamp when the refund was initiated."
    },
    "processor_details": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Processor Details",
      "required": [
        "type",
        "custom"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Type",
          "examples": [
            "custom"
          ],
          "description": "Type of processor (e.g., 'custom')."
        },
        "custom": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Custom",
          "required": [
            "refund_reference"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "refund_reference": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Refund Reference",
              "examples": [
                "ref_test_12345"
              ],
              "description": "Unique external refund reference from the processor."
            }
          },
          "description": "Custom processor details including refund reference.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      },
      "description": "Processor information for the refund.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_V1_PAYOUTS_RETRIEVE_A_PAYOUT
Updates a payout's metadata and returns the updated payout object. This endpoint ONLY allows updating the metadata field - no other payout properties (amount, destination, status, etc.) can be modified. To remove a specific metadata key, pass an empty string as its value. To clear all metadata, pass an empty dictionary. Use this when you need to attach or update custom information on an existing payout.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostV1PayoutsRetrieveAPayoutRequest",
  "required": [
    "payout_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "order_id": "12345",
          "customer_name": "John Doe"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs to attach or update on the payout object. Useful for storing additional information. Keys and values must be strings. To remove a specific key, pass an empty string as its value. To clear all metadata, pass an empty dictionary.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "payout_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payout Id",
      "examples": [
        "po_1RSpV5QvM72TjFrbXevfQeUM"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the payout to update. This ID typically starts with 'po_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating and retrieving a payout."
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_V1_PLANS_OVERVIEW
Tool to update a Stripe plan by setting passed parameter values. Use when modifying plan details like nickname, metadata, or active status.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostV1PlansOverviewRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "price_1ShVuAQvM72TjFrbIPUjdtbY",
        "plan_abc123"
      ],
      "description": "The identifier of the plan to be updated."
    },
    "active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Active",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Whether the plan is currently available for new subscriptions."
    },
    "product": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Product",
      "examples": [
        "prod_abc123"
      ],
      "description": "The product the plan belongs to. Cannot be changed once used in a subscription or subscription schedule."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "order_id": "6735"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs for storing additional structured information. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "nickname": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Nickname",
      "examples": [
        "Updated Test Plan",
        "Premium Monthly"
      ],
      "description": "A brief description of the plan, hidden from customers."
    },
    "trial_period_days": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Trial Period Days",
      "examples": [
        7,
        14,
        30
      ],
      "description": "Default number of trial days when subscribing a customer to this plan using trial_from_plan=true."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating a Stripe plan via POST /v1/plans/{id}."
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_V1_PROMOTION_CODES_PROMOTION_CODE
Updates an existing promotion code. Most fields are not editable by design. Use this to activate/deactivate codes, update metadata, or modify currency-specific restrictions.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostV1PromotionCodesPromotionCodeRequest",
  "required": [
    "promotion_code"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Active",
      "description": "Whether the promotion code is currently active and can be redeemed. A promotion code can only be reactivated when the underlying coupon is still valid."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs for storing additional structured information about the promotion code. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "restrictions": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Restrictions",
      "properties": {
        "minimum_amount": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Minimum Amount",
          "examples": [
            1000,
            2500
          ],
          "description": "Minimum purchase amount required to redeem the promotion code, in the currency's smallest unit."
        },
        "currency_options": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Currency Options",
          "description": "Per-currency promotion codes using three-letter ISO currency codes as keys. Each currency can have its own minimum_amount requirement.",
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "CurrencyOptionsRestriction",
            "required": [
              "minimum_amount"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "minimum_amount": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Minimum Amount",
                "examples": [
                  1000,
                  5000
                ],
                "description": "Minimum purchase amount required in this currency's smallest unit (e.g., cents)."
              }
            },
            "description": "Per-currency minimum amount restrictions."
          }
        },
        "first_time_transaction": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "First Time Transaction",
```
