## STRIPE_POST_V1_SHIPPING_RATES_OVERVIEW2
Tool to update an existing Stripe shipping rate. Use when you need to modify shipping rate properties such as active status, fixed amounts, metadata, or tax behavior.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateShippingRateRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "shr_1ShW0fQvM72TjFrbz0hJxSNz"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the shipping rate to update."
    },
    "active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Active",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Whether the shipping rate can be used for new purchases. Defaults to true."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "order_id": "6735",
          "user_segment": "premium"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object for storing additional information. Keys up to 40 characters, values up to 500 characters.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "fixed_amount": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "FixedAmount",
      "properties": {
        "currency_options": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Currency Options",
          "examples": [
            {
              "usd": {
                "amount": 1500,
                "tax_behavior": "exclusive"
              }
            }
          ],
          "description": "Shipping rates defined in each available currency option. Each key is a three-letter ISO currency code.",
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "CurrencyOption",
            "required": [
              "amount"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "amount": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Amount",
                "minimum": 0,
                "examples": [
                  1500,
                  2000,
                  500
                ],
                "description": "Non-negative integer in cents representing the charge amount for this currency."
              },
              "tax_behavior": {
                "anyOf": [
                  {
                    "enum": [
                      "inclusive",
                      "exclusive",
                      "unspecified"
                    ],
                    "type": "string"
                  },
                  {
                    "type": "null"
                  }
                ],
                "title": "Tax Behavior",
                "default": null,
                "description": "Specifies whether the rate is considered inclusive of taxes or exclusive of taxes."
              }
            },
            "description": "Currency-specific pricing configuration for shipping."
          }
        }
      },
      "description": "Fixed amount charge details for shipping.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating an existing Stripe shipping rate."
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_V1_SUBSCRIPTION_SCHEDULES_RELEASE_OVERVIEW
Tool to release a subscription schedule. Releases a subscription schedule immediately, stops scheduling future phases but leaves the existing subscription in place.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostV1SubscriptionSchedulesReleaseOverviewRequest",
  "required": [
    "schedule_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "schedule_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Schedule Id",
      "examples": [
        "sub_sched_1ShW1PQvM72TjFrbbyTUM5wb"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the subscription schedule to release."
    },
    "preserve_cancel_date": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Preserve Cancel Date",
      "description": "Keep any cancellation date on the underlying subscription that the schedule previously set. If false (default), any previously set cancellation date will be cleared."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_V1_SUBSCRIPTIONS_LIST_SUBSCRIPTIONS
Updates an existing Stripe subscription's properties including metadata, description, payment method, billing settings, trial periods, and cancellation behavior. Use this to modify subscription configuration, change payment methods, update billing cycles, manage trials, or schedule cancellations. This action does not modify subscription items (prices/products) - use separate actions for that.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostV1SubscriptionsListSubscriptionsRequest",
  "required": [
    "subscription_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "order_id": "6735",
          "internal_ref": "ABC123"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs for storing additional information about the subscription. Keys can be up to 40 characters and values up to 500 characters.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "trial_end": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "integer"
        },
        {
          "type": "string"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Trial End",
      "examples": [
        1735689600,
        "now"
      ],
      "description": "Unix timestamp for when the trial period ends, or 'now' to end the trial immediately. Use this to grant or modify trial periods."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "examples": [
        "Premium Plan Subscription",
        "Monthly billing for Team Plan"
      ],
      "description": "Customer-facing description for the subscription. Maximum 500 characters."
    },
    "days_until_due": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Days Until Due",
      "examples": [
        7,
        14,
        30
      ],
      "description": "Number of days a customer has to pay invoices. Only valid when collection_method is 'send_invoice'."
    },
    "default_source": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Default Source",
      "examples": [
        "card_1234567890abcdef"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the payment source to use as the default for the subscription. Must belong to the subscription's customer."
    },
    "subscription_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subscription Id",
      "examples": [
        "sub_1ShVqPQvM72TjFrbFlaiDC09"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the subscription to update (required)."
    },
    "collection_method": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Collection Method",
      "examples": [
        "charge_automatically",
        "send_invoice"
      ],
      "description": "How invoices are paid. Use 'charge_automatically' to automatically charge the default payment method, or 'send_invoice' to email the customer an invoice."
    },
    "proration_behavior": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Proration Behavior",
      "examples": [
        "create_prorations",
        "none",
        "always_invoice"
      ],
      "description": "How to handle prorations when subscription is updated. Options: 'create_prorations' (default), 'none', or 'always_invoice'."
    },
    "billing_cycle_anchor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Billing Cycle Anchor",
      "examples": [
        "now",
        "unchanged"
      ],
      "description": "Use 'now' to reset the billing cycle anchor to the current time, or 'unchanged' to keep it as is."
    },
    "cancel_at_period_end": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Cancel At Period End",
      "description": "Set to true to cancel the subscription at the end of the current billing period. Set to false to undo a pending cancellation."
    },
    "default_payment_method": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Default Payment Method",
      "examples": [
        "pm_1234567890abcdef"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the payment method to use as the default for this subscription. Must belong to the subscription's customer."
    }
  },
  "description": "Parameters for updating an existing Stripe subscription. All fields except subscription_id are optional."
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_V1_TAX_RATES_TAX_RATE2
Tool to update an existing Stripe tax rate. Use when you need to modify tax rate properties such as display name, description, or active status.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateTaxRateRequest",
  "required": [
    "tax_rate_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "state": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "State",
      "examples": [
        "NY",
        "CA",
        "TX",
        "ON"
      ],
      "description": "ISO 3166-2 subdivision code without country prefix (e.g., 'NY' for New York in the US, 'ON' for Ontario in Canada)."
    },
    "active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Active",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Flag determining whether the tax rate is active or inactive (archived). Inactive tax rates cannot be used with new applications or Checkout Sessions."
    },
    "country": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Country",
      "examples": [
        "US",
        "CA",
        "GB",
        "DE"
      ],
      "description": "Two-letter country code per ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 standard."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "order_id": "6735"
        },
        {
          "internal_code": "TAX-001"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "tax_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Tax Type",
      "examples": [
        "sales_tax",
        "vat",
        "gst",
        "hst"
      ],
      "description": "The high-level tax type, such as vat or sales_tax. One of: amusement_tax, communications_tax, gst, hst, igst, jct, lease_tax, pst, qst, retail_delivery_fee, rst, sales_tax, service_tax, or vat."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "examples": [
        "Updated test tax rate",
        "State sales tax"
      ],
      "description": "An arbitrary string attached to the tax rate for your own reference. It is not visible to your customers."
    },
    "tax_rate_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Tax Rate Id",
      "examples": [
        "txr_1ShW3KQvM72TjFrbZiM10uTd"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the tax rate to update."
    },
    "display_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Display Name",
      "examples": [
        "Updated Tax Rate",
        "Sales Tax",
        "VAT"
      ],
      "description": "The display name of the tax rate as shown to customers on receipts and invoices. Maximum 50 characters."
    },
    "jurisdiction": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Jurisdiction",
      "examples": [
        "California",
        "New York",
        "Ontario"
      ],
      "description": "The jurisdiction for the tax rate. You can use this label field for tax reporting purposes. Maximum 50 characters."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating an existing Stripe tax rate.\nOnly include fields that need to be modified; unspecified fields will remain unchanged."
}
```

## STRIPE_POST_V2_BILLING_METER_EVENT_ADJUSTMENTS_METER_EVENT
Creates a billing meter event adjustment to cancel a previously sent meter event. Use when you need to cancel a meter event within 24 hours of Stripe receiving it.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostV2BillingMeterEventAdjustmentsMeterEventAdjustmentsRequest",
  "required": [
    "event_name",
    "type",
    "cancel"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "type": {
      "type": "string",
      "const": "cancel",
      "title": "Type",
      "examples": [
        "cancel"
      ],
      "description": "Specifies adjustment type. Currently only 'cancel' is supported for single events."
    },
    "cancel": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Cancel",
      "required": [
        "identifier"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "identifier": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Identifier",
          "examples": [
            "test_adj_evt_1766498054"
          ],
          "description": "Unique identifier for the event to cancel. You can only cancel events within 24 hours of Stripe receiving them."
        }
      },
      "description": "Object containing cancellation details with the identifier of the event to cancel.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "event_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Event Name",
      "examples": [
        "api_request"
      ],
      "description": "The name of the meter event. Corresponds with the event_name field on a meter."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json

  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "CancelDetailsResponse": {
      "type": "object",
```

## STRIPE_PRESENT_PAYMENT_METHOD
Tool to present a payment method on a simulated terminal reader for testing purposes. Use when testing payment flows, simulating card acceptance, or validating terminal reader integrations in test mode.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PresentPaymentMethodRequest",
  "required": [
    "reader_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "card": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "CardData",
      "required": [
        "number",
        "exp_month",
        "exp_year"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "cvc": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Cvc",
          "examples": [
            "123",
            "456"
          ],
          "description": "Card security code (CVV/CVC)."
        },
        "number": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Number",
          "examples": [
            "4242424242424242",
            "5555555555554444"
          ],
          "description": "Card number without separators."
        },
        "exp_year": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Exp Year",
          "examples": [
            2025,
            25
          ],
          "description": "Two- or four-digit number representing the card's expiration year."
        },
        "exp_month": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Exp Month",
          "examples": [
            12,
            1
          ],
          "description": "Two-digit number representing the card's expiration month."
        }
      },
      "description": "Simulated card payment data.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "type": {
      "enum": [
        "card",
        "card_present",
        "interac_present"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Type",
      "examples": [
        "card",
        "card_present"
      ],
      "description": "Simulated payment type. Must be one of: 'card', 'card_present', or 'interac_present'."
    },
    "reader_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reader Id",
      "examples": [
        "tmr_GUdgOws6gw46M7",
        "tmr_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the terminal reader to present the payment method on."
    },
    "amount_tip": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Amount Tip",
      "examples": [
        500,
        1000
      ],
      "description": "Simulated on-reader tip amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g., 100 cents to represent $1.00)."
    },
    "card_present": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "CardPresentData",
      "properties": {
        "number": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Number",
          "examples": [
            "4242424242424242"
          ],
          "description": "Card number without separators."
        }
      },
      "description": "Simulated card_present payment data.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "interac_present": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "InteracPresentData",
      "properties": {
        "number": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Number",
          "examples": [
            "4506445006931933"
          ],
          "description": "Interac card number without separators."
        }
      },
      "description": "Simulated Interac payment data.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for presenting a payment method on a terminal reader."
}
```

## STRIPE_PROCESS_SETUP_INTENT
Initiates a SetupIntent flow on a Stripe Terminal Reader to save payment details. Use when you need to collect and save payment method information for future use.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ProcessSetupIntentRequest",
  "required": [
    "reader_id",
    "setup_intent",
    "customer_consent_collected"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "reader_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reader Id",
      "examples": [
        "tmr_GUdgOws6gw46M7"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the terminal reader to process the setup intent on."
    },
    "setup_intent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Setup Intent",
      "examples": [
        "seti_1ShVuSQvM72TjFrbq3vVVRXG"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the SetupIntent to process on the reader."
    },
    "process_config": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "ProcessConfigOptions",
      "properties": {
        "enable_customer_cancellation": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Enable Customer Cancellation",
          "description": "Enables cancel button on transaction screens, allowing customers to cancel the operation."
        }
      },
      "description": "Configuration overrides for setup operations.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "allow_redisplay": {
      "enum": [
        "always",
        "limited",
        "unspecified"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Allow Redisplay",
      "examples": [
        "always",
        "limited",
        "unspecified"
      ],
      "description": "Indicates whether this payment method can be shown again to its customer in a checkout flow. Controls visibility in Stripe products like Checkout and Elements."
    },
    "customer_consent_collected": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Customer Consent Collected",
      "description": "Set to true when customer consent has been collected. Required by regulations in some jurisdictions to confirm the customer agreed to save their payment method."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_RESUME_SUBSCRIPTION
Resumes a paused Stripe subscription with billing cycle and proration options. Use when a customer wants to restart payment collection on a previously paused subscription.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ResumeSubscriptionRequest",
  "required": [
    "subscription_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "proration_date": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Proration Date",
      "examples": [
        1609459200
      ],
      "description": "Calculates prorations as if resumed at specified time; useful for matching preview calculations. Unix timestamp in seconds."
    },
    "subscription_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subscription Id",
      "examples": [
        "sub_1ShW35QvM72TjFrbbRPWY9yE"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the subscription to resume."
    },
    "proration_behavior": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Proration Behavior",
      "examples": [
        "always_invoice",
        "create_prorations",
        "none"
      ],
      "description": "Controls proration handling when anchor is 'unchanged'. Options: 'always_invoice' (immediate invoicing), 'create_prorations' (conditional invoicing), or 'none' (disable prorations). Default: 'create_prorations'."
    },
    "billing_cycle_anchor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Billing Cycle Anchor",
      "examples": [
        "now",
        "unchanged"
      ],
      "description": "Determines timing for resumption. Options: 'now' (reset anchor to current UTC time) or 'unchanged' (advance to surrounding period). Default: 'now'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for resuming a paused Stripe subscription."
}
```

## STRIPE_RETRIEVE_CHARGE
Retrieves full details for an existing Stripe charge using its unique ID.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "RetrieveChargeRequest",
  "required": [
    "charge_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "charge_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Charge Id",
      "examples": [
        "ch_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "Identifier for the charge, typically starting with 'ch_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Specifies the charge ID to retrieve."
}
```

```json
  "title": "RetrieveChargeResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",

        "id",
        "object",
        "amount",

          "title": "Amount",
          "description": "Amount intended to be collected by this payment. A positive integer representing how much to charge in the smallest currency unit."
        },
        "object": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Object",
          "description": "String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value."
        },
        "review": {

          "title": "Review",
          "description": "ID of the review associated with this charge if one exists."
        },

              "title": "Type",

            },

              "type": "string",
              "title": "Reason",

            },
            "risk_score": {
              "type": "integer",
```

## STRIPE_RETRIEVE_CHECKOUT_SESSION
Tool to retrieve a Checkout Session object from Stripe. Use when you need to get the current state of a checkout session, including payment status, customer details, and line items.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "RetrieveCheckoutSessionRequest",
  "required": [
    "session"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "customer",
          "payment_intent"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded. Supports nested expansion using dot notation (e.g., 'payment_intent.customer'). Common expandable fields include: customer, payment_intent, subscription, invoice, line_items, payment_link."
    },
    "session": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Session",
      "examples": [
        "cs_test_a11YYufWQzNY63zpQ6QSNRQhkUpVph4WRmzW0zWJO2znZKdVujZ0N0S22u"
      ],
      "description": "The identifier of the checkout session to retrieve, typically starting with 'cs_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Specifies the checkout session ID to retrieve."
}
```

## STRIPE_RETRIEVE_CUSTOMER
Retrieves detailed information for an existing Stripe customer using their unique customer ID.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "RetrieveCustomerRequest",

      "type": "string",

      "examples": [
        "cus_NffrFeUfNV2Hib"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the Stripe customer to retrieve. This ID typically starts with 'cus_'."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_RETRIEVE_PAYMENT_INTENT
Retrieves a PaymentIntent by its ID; `client_secret` is required if a publishable API key is used.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "RetrievePaymentIntentRequest",
  "required": [
    "payment_intent_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "client_secret": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Client Secret",
      "examples": [
        "pi_1234567890_secret_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "Client secret for the PaymentIntent. Required if using a publishable key for authentication."
    },
    "payment_intent_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Intent Id",
      "examples": [
        "pi_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the PaymentIntent to retrieve."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for retrieving a PaymentIntent."
}
```

## STRIPE_RETRIEVE_PROMOTION_CODE
Tool to retrieve a Stripe promotion code by its ID. Use when you need to get details about a specific promotion code including its associated coupon, usage restrictions, and redemption statistics.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "RetrievePromotionCodeRequest",
  "required": [
    "promotion_code_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "promotion_code_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Promotion Code Id",
      "examples": [
        "promo_1ShVzsQvM72TjFrboLV6vMMU"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the promotion code to retrieve, typically starting with 'promo_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Specifies the promotion code ID to retrieve."
}
```

## STRIPE_RETRIEVE_UPCOMING_INVOICE
Tool to preview the upcoming invoice for a customer, showing all pending charges including subscription renewals and invoice items. Use when you need to preview invoice amounts before they are finalized, test the effects of subscription updates including prorations, or estimate future billing.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "RetrieveUpcomingInvoiceRequest",
  "properties": {
    "coupon": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Coupon",
      "examples": [
        "SUMMER25",
        "SAVE10"
      ],
      "description": "The code of the coupon to apply to the invoice preview. If multiple discounts needed, use the discounts parameter instead."
    },
    "issuer": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Issuer",

        {
          "type": "self"
        },
        {
          "type": "account",
          "account": "acct_1234"
        }
      ],

      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Currency",
      "examples": [
        "usd",
        "eur",
        "gbp"
      ],
      "description": "The currency for the invoice preview. Three-letter ISO currency code. Defaults to customer's currency."
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_NffrFeUfNV2Hib"
      ],
      "description": "The identifier of the customer whose upcoming invoice to retrieve. Required if subscription is not specified."
    },
    "schedule": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Schedule",
      "examples": [

      ],

    },

        "additionalProperties": {
          "type": "string"
        }
      },

            "coupon": "SUMMER25"
          },
          {
            "discount": "di_1234"
          }
        ]
      ],

    },
    "on_behalf_of": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "On Behalf Of",
      "examples": [

      ],
      "description": "The account (if any) for which the funds of the invoice payment are intended. Used with Stripe Connect."

      "title": "Preview Mode",
      "examples": [

      ],

    },

      "title": "Subscription",
      "examples": [
        "sub_1ShW2DQvM72TjFrb20tP6wRp"
      ],
      "description": "The identifier of the subscription for which you'd like to retrieve the upcoming invoice. If not specified, uses the customer's default subscription."
    },

    "subscription_start_date": {

      ],

    "subscription_proration_date": {

    "subscription_trial_from_plan": {

      "description": "List of tax rate IDs to apply to the subscription items in this preview."
    },
    "subscription_proration_behavior": {

      "title": "Subscription Proration Behavior",
      "examples": [

    "subscription_billing_cycle_anchor": {
      "anyOf": [

      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Boolean indicating whether the subscription should cancel at the end of the current period."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for previewing an upcoming invoice."
}
```

## STRIPE_SEARCH_CHARGES
Search charges using Stripe's Search Query Language. Use when you need to find historical charges by status, amount, customer, metadata, or other criteria.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SearchChargesRequest",
  "required": [
    "query"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "page": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Page",
      "examples": [
        "page_QWRhbXRvbiBTdGV2ZW5zb24"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor for a specific page; omit entirely for the first page. Use `next_page` from a previous response for subsequent pages."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of results per page (default is 10)."
    },
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "examples": [
        "status:'succeeded'",
        "amount>999 AND metadata['order_id']:'6735'",
        "amount:1250 OR amount:2500 OR amount:5000",
        "customer:'cus_123456' AND currency:'usd'"
      ],
      "description": "The search query string, adhering to Stripe's Search Query Language. Supports exact matches, range queries, boolean operators (AND/OR), and metadata searches. CRITICAL LIMITATION: You CANNOT mix AND and OR operators in the same query - use either all AND or all OR, never both. Parentheses are not supported. Combine up to 10 clauses with spaces (defaults to AND logic) or explicit AND/OR keywords. For detailed syntax, refer to https://docs.stripe.com/search#search-query-language."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for searching charges in Stripe."
}
```

## STRIPE_SEARCH_CUSTOMERS
Retrieves a list of Stripe customers matching a search query that adheres to Stripe's Search Query Language.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SearchCustomersRequest",
  "required": [
    "query"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "page": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Page",
      "examples": [
        "WzE3Njk2OTcyNjMsNDU2NDg5NTBd"
      ],
      "description": "Cursor token for pagination. MUST be the exact `next_page` value from a previous search response - NOT a numeric page number like '1' or '2'. Omit this parameter on the first request. Only provide this when `has_more` is true in the previous response."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        "25",
        "100"
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of results per page (default is 10)."
    },
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "examples": [
        "email:'[email protected]'",
        "created>0",
        "email~'example'",
        "metadata['foo']:'bar'",
        "name:'John' AND created>1609459200"
      ],
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The search query string using Stripe's Search Query Language. IMPORTANT: Every query must include at least one field:value condition - standalone wildcards like '*' are NOT supported and will fail. Supported operators: ':' for exact match (case-insensitive), '~' for substring match (minimum 3 characters), comparison operators (>, <, >=, <=) for numeric/date fields. Combine clauses with AND, OR, or prefix with '-' for negation. To retrieve many/all customers, use 'created>0'. For partial text matching, use the ~ operator (e.g., email~'example')."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for searching customers in Stripe."
}
```

## STRIPE_SEARCH_INVOICES
Searches for invoices using Stripe's Search Query Language. Use when you need to find invoices by status, total amount, customer, currency, or other criteria. Data is typically searchable within one minute, though propagation can lag up to an hour during outages.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SearchInvoicesRequest",
  "required": [
    "query"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "page": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Page",
      "examples": [
        "in_1N2M3O4P5Q6R7S8T_page_2"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor for a specific page; omit for the first page. Use `next_page` from a previous response for subsequent pages."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        "25",
        "100"
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of results per page (default is 10)."
    },
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "examples": [
        "total>100000",
        "status:'paid'",
        "customer:'cus_123456'",
        "currency:'usd' AND status:'open'",
        "number:'INV-2024-001'",
        "subscription:'sub_123456'",
        "last_finalization_error_type:'invalid_request_error'",
        "metadata['order_id']:'12345'"
      ],
      "description": "The search query string using Stripe's Search Query Language. Supported search fields for invoices: `created` (timestamp), `currency` (3-letter ISO code), `customer` (customer ID), `last_finalization_error_code` (error code from finalization), `last_finalization_error_type` (error type from finalization), `metadata` (key-value pairs), `number` (invoice number), `receipt_number` (receipt number), `status` (draft/open/paid/uncollectible/void), `subscription` (subscription ID), `total` (amount in cents). Supports exact matches, range queries (>, <, >=, <=), boolean operators (AND, OR, NOT), and metadata search. Can combine up to 10 query clauses. Cannot mix AND with OR in the same query. For detailed syntax, refer to https://docs.stripe.com/search#search-query-language."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for searching invoices in Stripe."
}
```

## STRIPE_SEARCH_PAYMENT_INTENTS
Searches for PaymentIntents using Stripe's Search Query Language. Use when you need to find payments by status, amount, customer, or other criteria.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SearchPaymentIntentsRequest",
  "required": [
    "query"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "page": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Page",
      "examples": [
        "pi_1N2M3O4P5Q6R7S8T_page_2"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor for a specific page; omit for the first page. Use `next_page` from a previous response for subsequent pages."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        "25",
        "100"
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of results per page (default is 10)."
    },
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "examples": [
        "status:'succeeded'",
        "amount>1000",
        "currency:'usd'",
        "customer:'cus_123456'"
      ],
      "description": "The search query string, adhering to Stripe's Search Query Language. This language supports features like exact matches, range queries, boolean operators, and searching by metadata. For detailed syntax, refer to https://docs.stripe.com/search#search-query-language."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for searching payment intents in Stripe."
}
```

## STRIPE_SEARCH_PRICES
Search for prices using Stripe's Search Query Language. Use when you need to find prices by status, currency, product, or other criteria with flexible query syntax.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SearchPricesRequest",
  "required": [
    "query"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "page": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Page",
      "examples": [
        "price_1N2M3O4P5Q6R7S8T_page_2"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor for a specific page; omit for the first page. Use `next_page` from a previous response for subsequent pages."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of results per page (default is 10, maximum is 100)."
    },
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "examples": [
        "active:\"true\"",
        "currency:'usd'",
        "metadata['key']:'value'"
      ],
      "description": "The search query string, adhering to Stripe's Search Query Language. This language supports features like exact matches, range queries, boolean operators, and searching by metadata. For detailed syntax, refer to https://docs.stripe.com/search#search-query-language."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for searching prices in Stripe."
}
```

## STRIPE_SEARCH_PRODUCTS
Tool to search for products using Stripe's Search Query Language. Use when you need to find products based on specific criteria like active status, name, or metadata.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SearchProductsRequest",
  "required": [
    "query"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "page": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Page",
      "examples": [
        "prod_1N2M3O4P5Q6R7S8T_page_2"
      ],
      "description": "A cursor for pagination across multiple pages of results. Don't include this parameter on the first call. Use the next_page value returned in a previous response to request subsequent results."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        10,
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10."
    },
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "examples": [
        "active:\"true\"",
        "name:\"Premium\"",
        "name~\"govcon\"",
        "name~\"premium\" OR name~\"basic\"",
        "metadata[\"category\"]:\"electronics\"",
        "active:\"true\" AND name~\"subscription\""
      ],
      "description": "The search query string using Stripe's Search Query Language. CRITICAL: All string values MUST be enclosed in double quotes (\"), not single quotes ('). The substring match operator is ~ (tilde), placed immediately after the field name with no colon, e.g., name~\"value\". Combine up to 10 clauses with AND or OR operators. Minimum 3 characters for substring matches."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for searching products in Stripe."
}
```

## STRIPE_SEARCH_SUBSCRIPTIONS
Searches for subscriptions using Stripe's Search Query Language. Use when you need to find subscriptions by status, metadata, created timestamp, or canceled_at timestamp.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SearchSubscriptionsRequest",
  "required": [
    "query"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "page": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Page",
      "examples": [
        "sub_1N2M3O4P5Q6R7S8T_page_2"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor for a specific page; omit for the first page. Use `next_page` from a previous response for subsequent pages."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        25,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of results per page (default is 10, max is 100)."
    },
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "examples": [
        "status:'active'",
        "status:'canceled' AND metadata['order_id']:'6735'",
        "created>1620310503 AND status:'active'"
      ],
      "description": "The search query string using Stripe's Search Query Language. Supported search fields for subscriptions: status (e.g., 'active', 'canceled'), metadata (custom key-value pairs), created (Unix timestamp), canceled_at (Unix timestamp). Supports exact matches, range queries (>, <, >=, <=), and boolean operators (AND, OR). For detailed syntax, refer to https://docs.stripe.com/search#search-query-language."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for searching subscriptions in Stripe."
}
```

## STRIPE_SEND_INVOICE
Tool to manually send a finalized Stripe invoice to the customer outside the automatic billing schedule. Use when you need to deliver an invoice for manual payment. Note: In test mode, no emails are sent, but webhook events (invoice.sent) are still generated.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SendInvoiceRequest",
  "required": [
    "invoice"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "invoice": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Invoice",
      "examples": [
        "in_1ShVpQQvM72TjFrbc9sVyhd2"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the invoice to send to the customer. Must be a finalized invoice with 'send_invoice' collection method."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for sending a Stripe invoice for manual payment."
}
```

## STRIPE_SET_READER_DISPLAY
Configures a Stripe Terminal reader to display cart information on its screen. Use when you need to show transaction details to customers during checkout.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SetReaderDisplayRequest",
  "required": [
    "reader",
    "cart"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "cart": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Cart",
      "required": [
        "currency",
        "line_items",
        "total"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "tax": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Tax",
          "examples": [
            500,
            1000
          ],
          "description": "The tax amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g., 100 cents equals $1.00)."
```

## STRIPE_SET_TERMINAL_READER_DISPLAY
Tool to set the display on a Stripe Terminal reader to show cart details. Use when you need to display line items, totals, and tax information on a physical terminal reader screen.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SetReaderDisplayRequest",
  "required": [
    "reader_id",
    "type"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "cart": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Cart",
      "required": [
        "currency",
        "line_items",
        "total"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "tax": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Tax",
          "examples": [
            100,
            500
          ],
          "description": "Tax amount in smallest currency unit (e.g., cents). Must be a non-negative integer."
        },
        "total": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Total",
          "examples": [
            5200,
            10000
          ],
          "description": "Total cart balance in smallest currency unit (e.g., cents). Must be a positive integer."
        },
        "currency": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Currency",
          "examples": [
            "usd",
            "eur",
            "gbp"
          ],
          "description": "Three-letter ISO currency code in lowercase (e.g., 'usd'). Must be a supported currency."
        },
        "line_items": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "LineItem",
            "required": [
              "amount",
              "description",
              "quantity"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "amount": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Amount",
                "examples": [
                  5100,
                  1000
                ],
                "description": "Item price in smallest currency unit (e.g., cents). Must be a positive integer."
              },
              "quantity": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Quantity",
                "examples": [
                  1,
                  2,
                  5
                ],
                "description": "Quantity of the item. Must be a positive integer."
              },
              "description": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Description",
                "examples": [
                  "Red t-shirt",
                  "Premium subscription"
                ],
                "description": "Item name or description to display on the reader."
              }
            },
            "description": "Individual item displayed in the cart."
          },
          "title": "Line Items",
          "description": "Collection of items being purchased. At least one item is required."
        }
      },
      "description": "Cart information to display on the terminal reader.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Type",
      "examples": [
        "cart"
      ],
      "description": "Display type. Currently only 'cart' is supported."
    },
    "reader_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reader Id",
      "examples": [
        "tmr_GUdgOws6gw46M7",
        "tmr_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the terminal reader to set the display for. Must be an existing terminal reader ID (format: tmr_xxx). Obtain this from listing terminal readers or after creating one."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to set the display on a Stripe Terminal reader."
}
```

## STRIPE_SUCCEED_TEST_TERMINAL_READER_INPUT_COLLECTION
Simulates successful completion of an ongoing input collection on a Terminal reader. This test helper allows you to test your integration's handling of successfully collected customer inputs (signature, email, phone, etc.) without requiring physical hardware or actual customer interaction. The reader must have an active input collection in progress (initiated via collect_inputs endpoint). Note: This endpoint only works in test mode with test API keys.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostTestHelpersTerminalReadersReaderSucceedInputCollectionRequest",
  "required": [
    "reader"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "location"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded. Each item has a maximum length of 5000 characters."
    },
    "reader": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reader",
      "examples": [
        "tmr_GUdgOws6gw46M7"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the terminal reader to simulate successful input collection on."
    },
    "skip_non_required_inputs": {
      "enum": [
        "all",
        "none"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Skip Non Required Inputs",
      "examples": [
        "all",
        "none"
      ],
      "description": "Defines which non-required inputs should be skipped during simulation. Use 'all' to skip all non-required inputs (simulating customer skipping optional fields), or 'none' to collect all inputs including non-required ones (simulating customer completing all fields)."
    }
  }
}
```

## STRIPE_TIMEOUT_TEST_TERMINAL_READER_INPUT_COLLECTION
Simulate an input collection timeout on a Stripe Terminal reader. This test helper endpoint allows you to simulate timeout scenarios during input collection operations on Terminal readers without needing physical hardware. When called, it marks the current reader action as failed with a timeout error, useful for testing error handling in your integration. **Important**: This endpoint is ONLY available in test mode. You must use test API keys (sk_test_...) to call this endpoint. Calling with live mode keys will result in an error. Use this when testing: - Timeout error handling in your application - Input collection failure scenarios - Reader action recovery flows

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostTestHelpersTerminalReadersReaderTimeoutInputCollectionRequest",
  "required": [
    "reader"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "location"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded. Each item has a maximum length of 5000 characters."
    },
    "reader": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reader",
      "examples": [
        "tmr_GUdgOws6gw46M7",
        "tmr_FPzZ4H9Fy6vJ8g"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the Terminal reader to simulate timeout on. Must be a valid reader ID (starts with 'tmr_') that has an active input collection operation. The timeout will fail the current reader action."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for simulating timeout on Terminal reader."
}
```

## STRIPE_UPDATE_BILLING_CREDIT_GRANT
Updates an existing billing credit grant. Use when you need to modify the expiration time or metadata of a credit grant.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateBillingCreditGrantRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "credgr_test_61TqtkqqPp0s5PxGj41QvM72TjFrbWLA"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier for the credit grant object to update. Typically starts with 'credgr_'."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "order_id": "12345",
          "test_update": "updated_value"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "expires_at": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Expires At",
      "examples": [
        1800000000
      ],
      "description": "Unix timestamp when the billing credits created by this credit grant expire. If set to empty, the billing credits never expire."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating a billing credit grant."
}
```

## STRIPE_UPDATE_BILLING_METER
Tool to update a billing meter's display name. Use when you need to modify the name of an existing billing meter.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateBillingMeterRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "mtr_test_61TqteDNJ7lrm4G7B41QvM72TjFrbSZU"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the billing meter to update."
    },
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "event_name"
        ],
        [
          "customer_mapping"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded. Available on all API requests and applies to the response of that request only."
    },
    "display_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Display Name",
      "examples": [
        "Updated API Usage Meter - Test",
        "Production API Requests"
      ],
      "description": "The meter's name. Not visible to the customer. Maximum length: 250 characters."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating a billing meter in Stripe."
}
```

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",

  "required": [

      ],

      "description": "Whether the configuration is active for creating portal sessions."
    },

          "properties": {
            "enabled": {
              "type": "boolean",
              "title": "Enabled",
              "description": "Whether the customer update feature is enabled."
            },
            "allowed_updates": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "title": "Allowed Updates",
              "examples": [
                [
                  "email",
                  "phone",
                  "address"
                ]
              ],
              "description": "Allowed customer update types: address, email, name, phone, shipping, tax_id."
            }
          },
          "description": "Configuration for customer update feature.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "invoice_history": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "InvoiceHistoryFeature",
          "required": [
            "enabled"
          ],
```

## STRIPE_UPDATE_CASH_BALANCE
Tool to update a customer's cash balance settings in Stripe. Use when you need to modify how funds transferred to a customer's cash balance are applied to payment intents and invoices.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateCashBalanceRequest",
  "required": [
    "customer_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "settings": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "CashBalanceSettings",
      "properties": {
        "reconciliation_mode": {
          "enum": [
            "automatic",
            "manual",
            "merchant_default"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Reconciliation Mode",
          "examples": [
            "automatic",
            "manual",
            "merchant_default"
          ],
          "description": "Controls how funds are applied to payment intents and invoices. 'automatic' applies funds automatically, 'manual' requires explicit action, 'merchant_default' uses the account's default setting."
        }
      },
      "description": "Settings for the cash balance.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "customer_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer Id",
      "examples": [
        "cus_TepLHOuTXo29sh",
        "cus_NffrFeUfNV2Hib"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the Stripe customer whose cash balance settings you want to update. This ID typically starts with 'cus_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating a customer's cash balance settings."
}
```

## STRIPE_UPDATE_CHARGE
Tool to update a Stripe charge object with provided parameters. Use when you need to modify charge details such as description, metadata, fraud assessment, receipt email, shipping information, or transfer group.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateChargeRequest",
  "required": [
    "charge_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of an existing customer to associate with this charge. Only updatable if the charge has no existing customer."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "test_key": "test_value",
          "updated_at": "2025-12-23"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs for storing structured information. Individual keys can be unset by posting empty values.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "shipping": {
```

## STRIPE_UPDATE_CHARGE_DISPUTE
Tool to update metadata on a charge's dispute. Use when you need to attach structured information to a dispute for tracking or internal reference purposes.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateChargeDisputeRequest",
  "required": [
    "charge"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "charge": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Charge",
      "examples": [
        "ch_3ShRXAQvM72TjFrb0GekfkTi"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the charge to update the dispute for. Must start with 'ch_'."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "order_id": "ORDER-123456"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Key-value pairs to attach to the dispute for storing structured additional information. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for updating a charge dispute."
}
```

## STRIPE_UPDATE_CHARGE_REFUND
Tool to update a specified refund within a charge. Use when you need to modify the metadata of an existing refund.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateChargeRefundRequest",
  "required": [
    "refund"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "refund": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Refund",
      "examples": [
        "re_3ShVn7QvM72TjFrb08NdaqLa"
      ],
      "description": "The identifier of the refund to update. This ID typically starts with 're_'."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "order_id": "test_12345",
          "updated_by": "curl_tester"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to the refund object for storing additional information in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to metadata.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    }
  },
  "description": "Defines the request parameters for updating a specific refund from a charge."
}
```

## STRIPE_UPDATE_CHECKOUT_SESSION
Tool to update a Stripe Checkout Session dynamically. Use when you need to modify customer information, line items, or shipping options on an existing checkout session. Line item updates require retransmitting the entire array.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateCheckoutSessionRequest",
  "required": [
    "session"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "session": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Session",
      "examples": [
        "cs_test_a1efaSGxRcVworqBocakuV6vsigh1F0ylQXbm3QYg7rz7WWgnYe0JgK3kK"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the Checkout Session to update."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "description": "Key-value pairs for storing additional structured information about the checkout session.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "line_items": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "LineItem",
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id",
            "description": "Existing line item ID for updates or retention. Required to update or retain an existing line item."
          },
          "price": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Price",
            "description": "Price ID for existing prices. Required if price_data is not provided."
          },

            "type": "object",
            "title": "Metadata",

            "additionalProperties": {
              "type": "string"
            }

              5

            "type": "object",

                "properties": {
```

## STRIPE_UPDATE_COUPON
Updates a Stripe coupon's metadata, name, or currency options. Other coupon details (currency, duration, amount_off, percent_off) are, by design, not editable. Use when you need to modify coupon metadata, display name, or add new currency-specific discount amounts.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateCouponRequest",
  "required": [
    "coupon"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Updated Test Coupon",
        "Holiday Sale",
        "VIP Discount"
      ],
      "description": "Name of the coupon displayed to customers on invoices or receipts. Maximum length is 40 characters. Defaults to the coupon ID if not set."
    },
    "coupon": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Coupon",
      "examples": [
        "TLxuLKlD",
        "SUMMER25",
        "HOLIDAY20"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the coupon to update."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "test_key": "test_value",
          "environment": "testing"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs for storing additional information in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to metadata.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "currency_options": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Currency Options",
      "description": "Coupons defined in each available currency option (amount-based coupons only). Each key must be a three-letter ISO currency code with a nested amount_off value. Only applicable for amount-based coupons. Note: You can only add new currencies, not modify existing currency options.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "CurrencyOption",
        "required": [
          "amount_off"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "amount_off": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Amount Off",
            "examples": [
              500,
              1000,
              2500
            ],
            "description": "Amount (in the smallest currency unit) to subtract from invoices for this currency option."
          }
        },
        "description": "Currency-specific coupon configuration."
      }
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating a Stripe coupon.\nOnly metadata, name, and currency_options can be updated; other coupon details are immutable by design."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "CouponAppliesTo": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "CouponAppliesTo",
      "required": [
        "products"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "products": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Products",
          "description": "A list of product IDs this coupon applies to."
        }
      },
      "description": "Contains information about which products the coupon applies to."
    },
    "CouponCurrencyOption": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "CouponCurrencyOption",
      "required": [
        "amount_off"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "amount_off": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Amount Off",
          "description": "Amount (in the smallest currency unit) to subtract from invoices for this currency option."
        }
      },
      "description": "Currency-specific coupon configuration in the response."
    },
    "UpdateCouponResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "UpdateCouponResponse",
      "required": [
        "id",
        "object",
        "created",
        "duration",
        "livemode",
        "metadata",
        "times_redeemed",
        "valid"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Id",
          "description": "Unique identifier for the coupon."
        },
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "description": "Name of the coupon displayed to customers on invoices or receipts."
        },
        "valid": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Valid",
          "description": "Taking account of the above properties, whether this coupon can still be applied to a customer."
        },
        "object": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Object",
          "description": "String representing the object's type. Value is 'coupon'."
        },
        "created": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Created",
          "description": "Time at which the object was created, measured in seconds since the Unix epoch."
        },
        "currency": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Currency",
          "description": "If amount_off has been set, the three-letter ISO code for the currency of the amount to take off."
        },
        "duration": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Duration",
          "description": "One of forever, once, or repeating. Describes how long a customer who applies this coupon will get the discount."
        },
        "livemode": {
```

Updates an existing Stripe customer, identified by customer_id, with only the provided details; unspecified fields remain unchanged.

## STRIPE_UPDATE_CUSTOMER_BALANCE_TXN
Updates an existing customer balance transaction's description and metadata. Use when you need to modify the description or add/update metadata on a customer balance transaction. Most transaction fields are immutable after creation.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateCustomerBalanceTxnRequest",
  "required": [
    "customer_id",
    "transaction_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "source": "api_test",
          "order_id": "12345"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "customer_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer Id",
      "pattern": "^cus_[a-zA-Z0-9]+$",
      "examples": [
        "cus_TzIzTnoKV9wPT4",
        "cus_NhD8HD2bY8dP3V"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier for the customer. Must start with 'cus_' followed by alphanumeric characters."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "examples": [
        "Updated balance transaction description",
        "Payment received"
      ],
      "maxLength": 350,
      "description": "An arbitrary string attached to the object. Often useful for displaying to users. Maximum length is 350 characters."
    },
    "transaction_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Transaction Id",

}
```

## STRIPE_UPDATE_CUSTOMER_SUBSCRIPTION
Tool to update a subscription on a customer in Stripe. Use when modifying subscription items, billing settings, payment methods, or metadata. Requires both customer ID and subscription ID. Supports updating items, metadata, billing cycle, cancellation settings, and more.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateCustomerSubscriptionRequest",
  "required": [
```

## STRIPE_UPDATE_DISPUTE
Tool to update a Stripe dispute by submitting evidence or updating metadata. Use when responding to payment disputes to provide documentation countering the dispute claim.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateDisputeRequest",
  "required": [
    "dispute"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "submit": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Submit",
      "description": "When true, submits evidence immediately to the bank; when false, stages evidence for later submission. Default: true."
    },
    "dispute": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Dispute",
      "examples": [
        "du_1ShRXCQvM72TjFrbDgp87FQx"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the dispute to update."
    },
    "evidence": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Evidence",
      "properties": {
        "receipt": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Receipt",
          "description": "File ID of receipt or charge notification sent to customer."

          "title": "Service Date",
          "description": "When service was received/began."

              "additionalProperties": {

              }
            }
          },

          "additionalProperties": false
        },

        },
        "uncategorized_file": {

        },
        "uncategorized_text": {

          "description": "Additional text evidence (max 20,000 chars)."
        },
        "access_activity_log": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Access Activity Log",

        },
        "cancellation_policy": {

          "title": "Cancellation Policy",
          "description": "File ID of subscription cancellation policy shown to customer."
        },

          "description": "Customer's email address."
        },
        "shipping_documentation": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Shipping Documentation",
          "description": "File ID of shipment receipt or shipping label."
        },
        "refund_policy_disclosure": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Refund Policy Disclosure",
          "description": "Documentation demonstrating customer was shown refund policy prior to purchase (max 20,000 chars)."
        },
        "shipping_tracking_number": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Shipping Tracking Number",
          "description": "Tracking number from delivery service."
        },
        "refund_refusal_explanation": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Refund Refusal Explanation",

        },

        },
        "duplicate_charge_documentation": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Duplicate Charge Documentation",
          "description": "File ID of receipt or label identifying prior charge."
        }
      },
      "description": "Documentation to counter the dispute.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "description": "Custom key-value pairs for storing structured data about the dispute. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating a Stripe dispute."
}
```

## STRIPE_UPDATE_ENTITLEMENT_FEATURE
Tool to update a feature's properties or deactivate it. Use when you need to modify an existing entitlements feature's metadata, name, or active status.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateEntitlementFeatureRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "feat_test_61TqtlHidwNVvhv3441QvM72TjFrb2IS",
        "feat_12345"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the feature to update. This ID typically starts with 'feat_'."
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Premium Support",
        "Advanced Analytics"
      ],
      "description": "The feature's internal name for your own identification purposes, not meant to be displayed to customers. Maximum length is 80 characters."
    },
    "active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Active",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "When set to false, prevents the feature from being attached to new products and excludes it from the features list endpoint. When true, the feature is active and available."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "timestamp": "1735000000",
          "test_update": "executed_by_agent"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs for storing additional structured information about the feature. You can specify up to 50 keys, with key names up to 40 characters long and values up to 500 characters long.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating an entitlements feature in Stripe."
}
```
