## STRIPE_UPDATE_INVOICEITEM
Updates an invoice item on a draft invoice. Use when modifying invoice item properties like amount, description, discounts, or tax settings before invoice finalization.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateInvoiceitemRequest",
  "required": [
    "invoiceitem_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "amount": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Amount",
      "examples": [
        3500,
        1000,
        -500
      ],
      "description": "The integer amount in cents of the charge to be applied to the upcoming invoice. To apply a credit, pass a negative value."
    },
    "period": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "PeriodUpdate",
      "required": [
        "start",
        "end"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "end": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "End",
          "examples": [
            1612137600,
            1643673600
          ],
          "description": "End of the period (Unix timestamp in seconds). Must be after the start of the period."
        },
        "start": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Start",
          "examples": [
            1609459200,
            1640995200
          ],
          "description": "Start of the period (Unix timestamp in seconds). Must be before or equal to the end of the period."
        }
      },
      "description": "Time period for invoice item.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "pricing": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "PricingUpdate",
      "required": [
        "price"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "price": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Price",
          "examples": [
            "price_1ShVomQvM72TjFrb"
          ],
          "description": "The ID of the price object to use for this invoice item."
        }
      },
      "description": "Pricing details for the invoice item.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "order_id": "12345",
          "customer_type": "premium"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to metadata.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "quantity": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Quantity",
      "examples": [
        1,
        5,
        10
      ],
      "description": "Non-negative integer. The quantity of units for the invoice item."
    },
    "tax_code": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Tax Code",
      "examples": [
        "txcd_10000000"
      ],
      "description": "A tax code ID."
    },
    "discounts": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "DiscountUpdate",
        "properties": {
          "coupon": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Coupon",
            "examples": [
              "coupon_123",
              "SUMMER20"
            ],
            "description": "ID of the coupon to create a new discount. Mutually exclusive with discount and promotion_code."
          },
          "discount": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Discount",
            "examples": [
              "di_1ShVomQvM72TjFrb"
            ],
            "description": "ID of an existing discount to reuse. Mutually exclusive with coupon and promotion_code."
          },
          "promotion_code": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Promotion Code",
            "examples": [
              "promo_1ShVomQvM72TjFrb"
            ],
            "description": "ID of the promotion code to apply. Mutually exclusive with coupon and discount."
          }
        },
        "description": "Discount to apply to the invoice item."
      },
      "title": "Discounts",
      "description": "The coupons, promotion codes & existing discounts which apply to the invoice item. Item discounts are applied before invoice discounts. Pass an empty array to remove previously-defined discounts."
    },
    "tax_rates": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Tax Rates",
      "examples": [
        [
          "txr_1ShVomQvM72TjFrb"
        ],
        []
      ],
      "description": "The tax rates which apply to the invoice item. When set, the default_tax_rates on the invoice do not apply to this invoice item. Pass an empty array to remove previously-defined tax rates."
    },
    "price_data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "PriceDataUpdate",
      "required": [
        "currency",
        "product"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "product": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Product",
          "examples": [
            "prod_1ShVomQvM72TjFrb"
          ],
          "description": "The ID of the product that this price will belong to."
        },
        "currency": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Currency",
          "examples": [
            "usd",
            "eur",
            "gbp"
          ],
          "description": "Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase."
        },
        "unit_amount": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Unit Amount",
          "examples": [
            1000,
            2500,
            5000
          ],
          "description": "A positive integer in cents representing how much to charge. One of unit_amount or unit_amount_decimal is required."
        },
        "tax_behavior": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Tax Behavior",
          "examples": [
            "inclusive",
            "exclusive",
            "unspecified"
          ],
          "description": "Specifies whether the price is considered inclusive of taxes or exclusive of taxes. One of inclusive, exclusive, or unspecified."
        },
        "unit_amount_decimal": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Unit Amount Decimal",
          "examples": [
            "10.50",
            "25.99",
            "100.00"
          ],
          "description": "Same as unit_amount, but accepts a decimal value with at most 12 decimal places. One of unit_amount or unit_amount_decimal is required."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data to create a new price inline.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "examples": [
        "Updated description via API",
        "Monthly subscription fee"
      ],
      "description": "An arbitrary string which you can attach to the invoice item. The description is displayed in the invoice for easy tracking."
    },
    "discountable": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Discountable",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Controls whether discounts apply to this invoice item. Defaults to false for prorations or negative invoice items, and true for all other invoice items."
    },
    "tax_behavior": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Tax Behavior",
      "examples": [
        "inclusive",
        "exclusive",
        "unspecified"
      ],
      "description": "Only required if a default tax behavior was not provided in the Stripe Tax settings. Specifies whether the price is considered inclusive of taxes or exclusive of taxes. One of inclusive, exclusive, or unspecified."
    },
    "invoiceitem_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Invoiceitem Id",
      "examples": [
        "ii_1ShVomQvM72TjFrbfkLA3S8C"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the invoice item to update. Must start with 'ii_' followed by alphanumeric characters."
    },
    "unit_amount_decimal": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Unit Amount Decimal",
      "examples": [
        "10.50",
        "25.99"
      ],
      "description": "Same as unit_amount, but accepts a decimal value with at most 12 decimal places."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating an invoice item."
}
```

## STRIPE_UPDATE_INVOICE_LINES
Tool to bulk update multiple line items on a draft invoice. Use when you need to modify descriptions, amounts, quantities, discounts, or other properties of existing line items on an invoice that is still in draft status. This operation only works with draft invoices; finalized invoices cannot be updated using this endpoint.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateInvoiceLinesRequest",
  "required": [
    "invoice",
    "lines"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "lines": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "LineItemUpdate",
        "required": [
          "id"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id",
            "examples": [
              "il_1ShVpQQvM72TjFrb9ap8OyZt"
            ],
            "description": "ID of an existing line item on the invoice to update."
          },
          "amount": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Amount",
            "examples": [
              1000,
              -500
            ],
            "description": "The integer amount in cents of the charge to be applied to the upcoming invoice. Can be negative for credits."
          },
          "period": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "LineItemPeriod",
            "required": [
              "start",
              "end"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "end": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "End",
                "examples": [
                  1640995200
                ],
                "description": "The end of the period (Unix timestamp). Must be on or after the period start."
              },
              "start": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Start",
                "examples": [
                  1609459200
                ],
                "description": "The start of the period (Unix timestamp). Must be before or equal to the period end."
              }
            },
            "description": "Period for the line item.",
            "additionalProperties": false
          },
          "pricing": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Pricing",
            "required": [
              "price"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "price": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Price",
                "examples": [
                  "price_1J2x3y4z5A6b7c8d"
                ],
                "description": "The ID of the price object."
              }
            },
            "description": "Pricing information for the line item.",
            "additionalProperties": false
          },
          "metadata": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Metadata",
            "examples": [
              {
                "order_id": "12345"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. For type='invoiceitem', incoming metadata replaces existing metadata. For type='subscription', metadata is merged.",
            "additionalProperties": {
              "type": "string"
            }
          },
          "quantity": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Quantity",
            "examples": [
              1,
              5,
              10
            ],
            "description": "Non-negative integer. The quantity of units for the line item."
          },
          "discounts": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "title": "LineItemDiscount",
              "properties": {
                "coupon": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Coupon",
                  "examples": [
                    "SUMMER25OFF"
                  ],
                  "description": "ID of the coupon to create a new discount for. Mutually exclusive with 'discount' and 'promotion_code'."
                },
                "discount": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Discount",
                  "examples": [
                    "di_1J2x3y4z5A6b7c8d"
                  ],
                  "description": "ID of an existing discount. Mutually exclusive with 'coupon' and 'promotion_code'."
                },
                "promotion_code": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Promotion Code",
                  "examples": [
                    "promo_1J2x3y4z5A6b7c8d"
                  ],
                  "description": "ID of the promotion code to create a new discount for. Mutually exclusive with 'coupon' and 'discount'."
                }
              },
              "description": "Discount to apply to a line item."
            },
            "title": "Discounts",
            "description": "The coupons, promotion codes, and/or discounts to apply to the line item. Pass an empty array to remove previously-defined discounts."
          },
          "tax_rates": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "title": "Tax Rates",
            "examples": [
              [
                "txr_1J2x3y4z5A6b7c8d"
              ]
            ],
            "description": "The tax rates that apply to this line item. Pass an empty array to remove previously-defined tax rates. Cannot be mixed with tax_amounts."
          },
          "price_data": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "PriceData",
            "required": [
              "currency"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "product": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Product",
                "examples": [
                  "prod_1J2x3y4z5A6b7c8d"
                ],
                "description": "The ID of the product that this price will belong to. Mutually exclusive with 'product_data'."
              },
              "currency": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Currency",
                "examples": [
                  "usd",
                  "eur"
                ],
                "description": "Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase."
              },
              "unit_amount": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Unit Amount",
                "examples": [
                  1000,
                  2500
                ],
                "description": "A positive integer in cents (or 0 for a free price) representing how much to charge. One of 'unit_amount' or 'unit_amount_decimal' is required."
              },
              "product_data": {
                "type": "object",
                "title": "ProductData",
                "required": [
                  "name"
                ],
                "properties": {
                  "name": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Name",
                    "examples": [
                      "Premium Widget"
                    ],
                    "description": "The product's name, meant to be displayable to the customer."
                  },
                  "images": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "title": "Images",
                    "examples": [
                      [
                        "https://example.com/image1.png",
                        "https://example.com/image2.png"
                      ]
                    ],
                    "description": "A list of up to 8 URLs of images for this product."
                  },
                  "metadata": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "title": "Metadata",
                    "examples": [
                      {
                        "internal_id": "widget_123"
                      }
                    ],
                    "description": "Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object.",
                    "additionalProperties": {
                      "type": "string"
                    }
                  },
                  "tax_code": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Tax Code",
                    "examples": [
                      "txcd_99999999"
                    ],
                    "description": "A tax code ID for the product."
                  },
                  "description": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Description",
                    "examples": [
                      "High-quality premium widget"
                    ],
                    "description": "The product's description, meant to be displayable to the customer."
                  }
                },
                "description": "Product data for creating a new product inline.",
                "additionalProperties": false
              },
              "tax_behavior": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Tax Behavior",
                "examples": [
                  "exclusive",
                  "inclusive"
```

## STRIPE_UPDATE_PAYMENT_INTENT
Updates a Stripe PaymentIntent with new values for specified parameters; note that if `currency` is updated, `amount` might also be required, and certain updates (e.g., to `payment_method`) can necessitate re-confirmation by the customer.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdatePaymentIntentRequest",
  "required": [
    "payment_intent_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "amount": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Amount",
      "examples": [
        "2000"
      ],
      "description": "The amount intended to be collected by this PaymentIntent, in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for USD). This is a positive integer."
    },
    "currency": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Currency",
      "pattern": "^[a-zA-Z]{3}$",
      "examples": [
        "usd"
      ],
      "description": "The three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase (e.g., 'usd', 'eur'). Must be a supported currency."
    },
    "customer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Customer",
      "examples": [
        "cus_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the Customer this PaymentIntent should be associated with."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "user_id": "usr_abc123",
          "order_id": "6735"
        }
      ],
      "description": "A set of key-value pairs to store additional structured information about the PaymentIntent. Keys can be up to 40 characters long and values can be up to 500 characters long.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "shipping": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Shipping",
      "examples": [
        "{\"name\": \"Jenny Rosen\", \"phone\": \"+15555555555\", \"address\": {\"line1\": \"123 Main Street\", \"city\": \"San Francisco\", \"state\": \"CA\", \"postal_code\": \"94107\", \"country\": \"US\"}}"
      ],
      "description": "Shipping information for the PaymentIntent. This is a dictionary that should contain the recipient's `name`, `phone`, and an `address` object with `line1`, `line2` (optional), `city`, `state`, `postal_code`, and `country`.",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "examples": [
        "Order #123 for Widget X"
      ],
      "description": "An arbitrary string providing a description of the PaymentIntent, often displayed to users."
    },
    "receipt_email": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Receipt Email",
      "examples": [
        "customer@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "The email address to which Stripe will send a receipt for a successful payment. "
    },
    "payment_method": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Method",
      "examples": [
        "pm_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the PaymentMethod to attach to this PaymentIntent."
    },
    "payment_intent_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Intent Id",
      "examples": [
        "pi_1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the PaymentIntent to be updated."
    },
    "setup_future_usage": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Setup Future Usage",
      "examples": [
        "off_session",
        "on_session"
      ],
      "description": "Indicates if you intend to use the payment method attached to this PaymentIntent for future payments. Allowed values are 'on_session' or 'off_session'."
    },
    "statement_descriptor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Statement Descriptor",
      "examples": [
        "MYSHOP ORDER"
      ],
      "maxLength": 22,
      "description": "String for customer's credit card statement (max 22 characters)."
    },
    "statement_descriptor_suffix": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Statement Descriptor Suffix",
      "examples": [
        "JULY SPECIAL"
      ],
      "maxLength": 22,
      "description": "Additional info for customer's card statement, appended to `statement_descriptor` (max 22 characters)."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating a payment intent."
}
```

## STRIPE_UPDATE_PAYMENT_LINK
Updates an existing payment link with new configuration details. Use when modifying payment link settings, tax configurations, custom fields, metadata, or post-completion behavior.

## STRIPE_UPDATE_PAYMENT_METHOD
Updates an existing PaymentMethod object in Stripe. Use when you need to modify billing details, expiration dates, or metadata for a payment method. The payment method must be attached to a customer before updates can be applied.

## STRIPE_UPDATE_PRICE
Updates a Stripe price by setting passed parameter values; unspecified parameters remain unchanged. Use when you need to modify price metadata, active status, lookup key, or nickname. Note: Price amounts cannot be modified via API.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdatePriceRequest",
  "required": [
    "price"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "price": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Price",
      "examples": [
        "price_1ShVqBQvM72TjFrbzsC327Co"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the price to update."
    },
    "active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Active",
      "description": "Whether the price can be used for new purchases. Defaults to true."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "description": "Key-value pairs for storing additional information. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to metadata.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "nickname": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Nickname",
      "examples": [
        "Monthly Standard Plan",
        "Annual Premium Plan"
      ],
      "description": "Internal price description (hidden from customers)."
    },
    "lookup_key": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Lookup Key",
      "examples": [
        "standard_monthly",
        "premium_annual"
      ],
      "description": "Retrieval identifier (max 200 characters)."
    },
    "tax_behavior": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Tax Behavior",
      "examples": [
        "inclusive",
        "exclusive",
        "unspecified"
      ],
      "description": "Tax classification: 'inclusive', 'exclusive', or 'unspecified'. Once specified, it cannot be changed."
    },
    "currency_options": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Currency Options",
      "description": "Per-currency pricing configuration. Keys must be ISO 4217 three-letter currency codes.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "CurrencyOption",
        "properties": {
          "tiers": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "title": "PriceTier",
                  "required": [
                    "up_to"
                  ],
                  "properties": {
                    "up_to": {
                      "anyOf": [
                        {
                          "type": "integer"
                        },
                        {
                          "type": "string"
                        }
                      ],
                      "title": "Up To",
                      "examples": [
                        100,
                        "inf"
                      ],
                      "description": "Tier upper bound; use 'inf' for fallback tier."
                    },
                    "flat_amount": {
                      "anyOf": [
                        {
                          "type": "integer"
                        },
                        {
                          "type": "null"
                        }
                      ],
                      "title": "Flat Amount",
                      "default": null,
                      "description": "Fixed tier cost regardless of unit count in smallest currency unit."
                    },
                    "unit_amount": {
                      "anyOf": [
                        {
                          "type": "integer"
                        },
                        {
                          "type": "null"
                        }
                      ],
                      "title": "Unit Amount",
                      "default": null,
                      "description": "Per-unit cost for tier in smallest currency unit."
                    },
                    "flat_amount_decimal": {
                      "anyOf": [
                        {
                          "type": "string"
                        },
                        {
                          "type": "null"
                        }
                      ],
                      "title": "Flat Amount Decimal",
                      "default": null,
                      "description": "Decimal version of flat_amount in minor currency units (up to 12 decimal places)."
                    },
                    "unit_amount_decimal": {
                      "anyOf": [
                        {
                          "type": "string"
                        },
                        {
                          "type": "null"
                        }
                      ],
                      "title": "Unit Amount Decimal",
                      "default": null,
                      "description": "Decimal per-unit cost (up to 12 decimal places)."
                    }
                  },
                  "description": "Represents a pricing tier for tiered billing."
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "title": "Tiers",
            "default": null,
            "description": "Tiered pricing structure (requires billing_scheme=tiered)."
          },
          "unit_amount": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "integer"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "title": "Unit Amount",
            "default": null,
            "description": "Price in smallest currency unit (0 for free)."
          },
          "tax_behavior": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "string"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "title": "Tax Behavior",
            "default": null,
            "examples": [
              "inclusive",
              "exclusive",
              "unspecified"
            ],
            "description": "Tax treatment: 'inclusive', 'exclusive', or 'unspecified'. Cannot change once set."
          },
          "custom_unit_amount": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "object",
                "title": "CustomUnitAmount",
                "required": [
                  "enabled"
                ],
                "properties": {
                  "preset": {
                    "anyOf": [
                      {
                        "type": "integer"
                      },
                      {
                        "type": "null"
                      }
                    ],
                    "title": "Preset",
                    "default": null,
                    "description": "Default unit amount customers can modify during checkout."
                  },
                  "enabled": {
                    "type": "boolean",
                    "title": "Enabled",
                    "description": "Set true to enable custom amounts, allowing customers to specify their own unit price."
                  },
                  "maximum": {
                    "anyOf": [
                      {
                        "type": "integer"
                      },
                      {
                        "type": "null"
                      }
                    ],
                    "title": "Maximum",
                    "default": null,
                    "description": "Upper limit for customer-specified unit amount in smallest currency unit."
                  },
                  "minimum": {
                    "anyOf": [
                      {
                        "type": "integer"
                      },
                      {
                        "type": "null"
                      }
                    ],
                    "title": "Minimum",
                    "default": null,
                    "description": "Lower limit for customer-specified unit amount in smallest currency unit."
                  }
                },
                "description": "Configuration for customer-adjustable amounts during checkout."
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "default": null,
            "description": "Enables customer-adjustable amounts during checkout for this currency."
          },
          "unit_amount_decimal": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "string"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "title": "Unit Amount Decimal",
            "default": null,
            "description": "Decimal price in smallest currency unit (max 12 decimals)."
          }
        },
        "description": "Per-currency pricing configuration."
      }
    },
    "transfer_lookup_key": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Transfer Lookup Key",
      "description": "When true, atomically moves lookup key from another price to this one."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating an existing Stripe price. Only include fields to modify; unspecified fields remain unchanged."
}
```

## STRIPE_UPDATE_PRODUCT
Tool to update an existing product in Stripe. Use when you need to modify product details like name, description, pricing, or availability.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateProductRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "prod_TepW3APrEDWu1g",

      "description": "Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to metadata.",

    "marketing_features": {

            "title": "Name",
            "examples": [
              "24/7 support",

        "description": "Represents a marketing feature to be displayed on pricing tables."

          "examples": [

          ],
          "description": "Package width in inches (max 2 decimal places)."
        },
        "height": {
          "type": "number",
          "title": "Height",
          "minimum": 0,
          "examples": [

          ],
          "description": "Package height in inches (max 2 decimal places)."

        "length": {

          "title": "Length",
          "minimum": 0,

          ],
          "description": "Package length in inches (max 2 decimal places)."
        },
        "weight": {
          "type": "number",
          "title": "Weight",
          "minimum": 0,
          "examples": [

            32.5
          ],
          "description": "Package weight in ounces (max 2 decimal places)."
        }
      },
      "description": "The dimensions of the product for shipping purposes.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "statement_descriptor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Statement Descriptor",
      "examples": [

        "MYSHOP COM"
      ],
      "description": "An arbitrary string to be displayed on your customer's credit card or bank statement. While most banks display this information consistently, some may display it incorrectly or not at all. This may be up to 22 characters."
    }
  },
  "description": "Parameters for updating an existing product in Stripe."
}
```

## STRIPE_UPDATE_PROMOTION_CODE
Updates an existing Stripe promotion code by setting the values of the parameters passed. Use when you need to activate/deactivate a promotion code, update its metadata, or modify redemption restrictions. Most promotion code fields are intentionally non-editable after creation.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdatePromotionCodeRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "promo_1ShVzsQvM72TjFrboLV6vMMU",
        "promo_abc123"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the promotion code to update."
    },
    "active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Active",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Whether the promotion code is currently active. Set to true to reactivate (requires a valid coupon and redeemable status), or false to deactivate."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "timestamp": "1766497500",
          "test_field": "updated_value"
        },
        {
          "order_id": "12345"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs for storing additional structured information. Keys can be up to 40 characters, values up to 500 characters. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "restrictions": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Restrictions",
      "properties": {
        "currency_options": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Currency Options",
          "examples": [
            {
              "eur": {
                "minimum_amount": 900
              },
              "usd": {
                "minimum_amount": 1000
              }
            }
          ],
          "description": "Promotion code definitions per currency using three-letter ISO currency codes as keys. Each currency can have its own minimum_amount requirement.",
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "CurrencyOptions",
            "properties": {
              "minimum_amount": {
                "anyOf": [
                  {
                    "type": "integer"
                  },
                  {
                    "type": "null"
                  }
                ],
                "title": "Minimum Amount",
                "default": null,
                "examples": [
                  1000,
                  5000
                ],
                "description": "Minimum order amount required to redeem the promotion code in this currency. Amount is in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for USD)."
              }
            },
            "description": "Currency-specific minimum amount for promotion code redemption."
          }
        }
      },
      "description": "Settings controlling promotion code redemption conditions.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating an existing Stripe promotion code.\nOnly include fields that need to be modified; unspecified fields will remain unchanged."
}
```

## STRIPE_UPDATE_QUOTE
Tool to update an existing Stripe quote with new values. Use when modifying quote details like description, line items, metadata, or other quote parameters.

## STRIPE_UPDATE_SOURCE
Updates a Stripe source with specified parameters. Use when you need to modify source metadata, owner information, or mandate details. NOTE: The Stripe Sources API is deprecated. Stripe recommends migrating to the Payment Methods API for new integrations. This action only works with sources created before the API deprecation.

## STRIPE_UPDATE_SUBSCRIPTION
Updates an existing, non-canceled Stripe subscription by its ID, ensuring all referenced entity IDs (e.g., prices, coupons) are valid and automatic tax liability is correctly specified if enabled.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateSubscriptionRequest",
  "required": [
    "subscription_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "items": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "SubscriptionItemUpdate",
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id",
            "examples": [
              "si_123abc456def"
            ],
            "description": "ID of the subscription item to update; required to modify. If omitted with `price`, new item behavior varies; explicit creation often preferred."
          },
          "price": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Price",
            "examples": [
              "price_123abc456def",
              "price_new_tier_monthly"
            ],
            "description": "ID of the new price for this item, changing its pricing plan. Using `price_data` for inline creation is not directly supported here."
          },
          "quantity": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Quantity",
            "examples": [
              "1",
              "5",
              "10"
            ],
            "description": "Quantity of this item; affects metered billing amount or sets units for licensed billing."
          },
          "discounts": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "title": "Discount",
              "properties": {
                "coupon": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Coupon",
                  "examples": [
                    "coupon_id_123",
                    "christmas_special"
                  ],
                  "description": "The ID of a coupon to apply. Mutually exclusive with `promotion_code` and `discount`."
                },
                "discount": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Discount",
                  "examples": [
                    "di_abcdef123456"
                  ],
                  "description": "The ID of an existing discount object to apply. This is less common than using `coupon` or `promotion_code`. Mutually exclusive with `coupon` and `promotion_code`."
                },
                "promotion_code": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Promotion Code",
                  "examples": [
                    "promo_code_abc",
                    "SUMMERDEAL"
                  ],
                  "description": "The ID of a promotion code to apply. Mutually exclusive with `coupon` and `discount`."
                }
              }
            },
            "title": "Discounts",
            "description": "List of discounts (by coupon, promotion code, or discount ID) to apply, replacing existing item discounts."
          },
          "tax_rates": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "title": "Tax Rates",
            "examples": [
              "'''[\"txr_123abc\", \"txr_456def\"]'''",
              "'''[]'''"
            ],
            "description": "List of tax rate IDs (max 5) to apply, overriding subscription-level rates for this item. Empty list removes all."
          },
          "billing_thresholds": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "BillingThresholds",
            "properties": {
              "amount_gte": {
                "type": "integer",
                "title": "Amount Gte",
                "examples": [
                  "1000",
                  "50000"
                ],
                "description": "Monetary threshold (smallest currency unit, e.g., cents) that triggers billing when usage meets or exceeds it. E.g., 1000 for $10.00 USD."
              },
              "reset_billing_cycle_anchor": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "title": "Reset Billing Cycle Anchor",
                "examples": [
                  true,
                  false
                ],
                "description": "If true, resets billing cycle anchor to threshold billing time, adjusting renewal date."
              }
            },
            "description": "Usage-based billing thresholds for this item; meeting a threshold generates an invoice for its usage.",
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        "description": "Defines the parameters for updating a specific item within a subscription."
      },
      "title": "Items",
      "description": "List of subscription item updates (max 20). Item `id` usually required for modification."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        "'''{'order_id': '6735', 'user_segment': 'enterprise'}'''",
        "'''{}'''"
      ],
      "description": "Key-value pairs for custom information (max 50 keys: 40 chars; values: 500 chars). Replaces existing; empty dict removes all.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "examples": [
        "Annual Premium Plan for cust_123",
        "Monthly Standard Access - Widget Corp"
      ],
      "description": "Arbitrary string for user display or internal tracking."
    },
    "automatic_tax": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "AutomaticTax",
      "required": [
        "enabled"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "enabled": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Enabled",
          "examples": [
            true,
            false
          ],
          "description": "Determines whether Stripe automatically calculates taxes for this subscription. If true, `liability` may be required."
        },
        "liability": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "AutomaticTaxLiability",
          "required": [
            "connected_account"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "connected_account": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Connected Account",
              "description": "Stripe account ID liable for this subscription's taxes; required if `automatic_tax[enabled]` is true and subscription isn't a top-up."
            }
          },
          "description": "The account that's liable for tax. Required if `enabled` is `true` and the subscription is not a top-up.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      },
      "description": "Stripe Tax settings for automatic tax calculation. `liability` may be required if `enabled` is true.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "subscription_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subscription Id",
      "examples": [
        "sub_123abc456defGHIJKL"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the subscription to update."
    },
    "payment_behavior": {
      "enum": [
        "allow_incomplete",
        "error_if_incomplete",
        "pending_if_incomplete"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Behavior",
      "examples": [
        "allow_incomplete",
        "error_if_incomplete",
        "pending_if_incomplete"
      ],
      "description": "Payment handling for invoices."
    },
    "collection_method": {
      "enum": [
        "charge_automatically",
        "send_invoice"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Collection Method",
      "examples": [
        "charge_automatically",
        "send_invoice"
      ],
      "description": "How invoices are paid."
    },
    "proration_behavior": {
      "enum": [
        "create_prorations",
        "none",
        "always_invoice"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Proration Behavior",
      "examples": [
        "create_prorations",
        "none",
        "always_invoice"
      ],
      "description": "How to handle prorations on changes."
    },
    "billing_cycle_anchor": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "integer"
        },
        {
          "type": "string"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Billing Cycle Anchor",
      "examples": [
        "1609459200",
        "now"
      ],
      "description": "Unix timestamp (seconds) or 'now' to anchor billing cycle and renewal. Changes may cause proration."
    },
    "cancel_at_period_end": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Cancel At Period End",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "If true, schedules cancellation at current period's end; if false, undoes scheduled cancellation."
    },
    "default_payment_method": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Default Payment Method",
      "examples": [
        "pm_123abc456defGHIJKL"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the default payment method; updates subscription's default payment source if provided."
    }
  },
  "description": "Parameters for updating an existing Stripe subscription. Allows modification of items, billing, payment methods, and metadata."
}
```

```json
  "title": "UpdateSubscriptionResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",

  ],

    "data": {
      "type": "object",

      "required": [
        "id",
        "object",
        "automaticTax",

        "created",

        "currentPeriodStart",

      ],
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Id",
          "description": "Unique identifier for the subscription."
        },

          "type": "object",
          "title": "Items",
          "required": [
            "object",
            "data",
            "hasMore",
            "url"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "url": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Url",
              "description": "The URL where this list can be accessed."
            },

              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "object",
                "title": "SubscriptionItemResponse",
                "required": [
                  "id",
                  "object",
                  "created",
                  "currentPeriodEnd",
                  "currentPeriodStart",
                  "metadata",
                  "price",
                  "subscription"
                ],
                "properties": {
                  "id": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Id",
                    "description": "Unique identifier for the subscription item."
                  },

                    "type": "object",

                    "required": [
                      "id",
                      "object",
                      "active",
                      "billingScheme",
                      "created",
                      "currency",
                      "livemode",
                      "metadata",
                      "product",
                      "type"
                    ],
                    "properties": {
                      "id": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "title": "Id",
                        "description": "Unique identifier for the price."
                      },
                      "type": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "title": "Type",
                        "description": "One of one_time or recurring depending on whether the price is for a one-time purchase or a recurring (subscription) purchase."
                      },
                      "tiers": {
                        "type": "array",
                        "items": {
                          "type": "object",
                          "title": "PriceTier",
                          "properties": {
                            "upTo": {
                              "type": "integer",
                              "title": "Up To",
                              "description": "Up to and including to this quantity will be contained in the tier."
                            },
                            "flatAmount": {
                              "type": "integer",
                              "title": "Flat Amount",
                              "description": "Price for the entire tier."
                            },
                            "unitAmount": {
                              "type": "integer",
                              "title": "Unit Amount",
                              "description": "Per unit price for units relevant to the tier."
                            },
                            "flatAmountDecimal": {
                              "type": "string",
                              "title": "Flat Amount Decimal",
                              "description": "Same as flat_amount, but contains a decimal value with at most 12 decimal places."
                            },
                            "unitAmountDecimal": {
                              "type": "string",
                              "title": "Unit Amount Decimal",
                              "description": "Same as unit_amount, but contains a decimal value with at most 12 decimal places."
                            }
                          },
                          "description": "Pricing tier for tiered pricing."
                        },
                        "title": "Tiers",
                        "description": "Each element represents a pricing tier. This parameter requires billing_scheme to be set to tiered."
                      },
                      "active": {
                        "type": "boolean",
                        "title": "Active",
                        "description": "Whether the price can be used for new purchases."
                      },
                      "object": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "title": "Object",
                        "description": "String representing the object's type. Always 'price'."
                      },
                      "created": {
                        "type": "integer",
                        "title": "Created",
                        "description": "Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch."
                      },
                      "product": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "title": "Product",
                        "description": "The ID of the product this price is associated with."
                      },
                      "currency": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "title": "Currency",
                        "description": "Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase."
                      },
                      "livemode": {
```

## STRIPE_UPDATE_SUBSCRIPTION_SCHEDULE

## STRIPE_UPDATE_TAX_REGISTRATION
Tool to update an existing tax registration in Stripe. Use when you need to modify the active_from or expires_at fields of a registration. Registrations cannot be deleted after creation; use expires_at to terminate them instead.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateTaxRegistrationRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "taxreg_NkyGPRPytKq66j",
        "taxreg_1ShRXBQvM72TjFrbXWORmKfN"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier for the tax registration object to update."
    },
    "expires_at": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "integer"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Expires At",
      "examples": [
        "now",
        "1893456000"
      ],
      "description": "Time at which the registration expires. Can be 'now' or a Unix timestamp in seconds. If not set, the registration will remain active indefinitely."
    },
    "active_from": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "integer"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Active From",
      "examples": [
        "now",
        "1893456000"
      ],
      "description": "Time at which the registration becomes active. Can be 'now' or a Unix timestamp in seconds."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating an existing tax registration in Stripe."
}
```

## STRIPE_UPDATE_TAX_SETTINGS
Updates Stripe Tax Settings parameters used in tax calculations. Use to configure default tax behavior, tax codes, and business head office location for tax purposes.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateTaxSettingsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "defaults": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "TaxDefaultsRequest",
      "properties": {
        "tax_code": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Tax Code",
          "examples": [
            "txcd_10000000",
            "txcd_99999999"
          ],
          "description": "A tax code ID for product classification (e.g., 'txcd_10000000' for general tangible goods)."
        },
        "tax_behavior": {
          "enum": [
            "exclusive",
            "inclusive",
            "inferred_by_currency"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Tax Behavior",
          "examples": [
            "exclusive",
            "inclusive",
            "inferred_by_currency"
          ],
          "description": "Specifies the default tax behavior to be used when the item's price has unspecified tax behavior. 'exclusive' means taxes calculated on top of amount, 'inclusive' means taxes included in amount, 'inferred_by_currency' means Stripe determines based on currency. Once specified, cannot revert to null."
        }
      },
      "description": "Default tax configuration settings.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "head_office": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "HeadOfficeRequest",
      "required": [
        "address"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "address": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Address",
          "properties": {
            "city": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "City",
              "examples": [
                "San Francisco",
                "Berlin"
              ],
              "description": "City, district, suburb, town, or village."
            },
            "line1": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Line1",
              "examples": [
                "123 Main St",
                "Hauptstra\u00dfe 1"
              ],
              "description": "Address line 1 (e.g., street, PO Box, or company name)."
            },
            "line2": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Line2",
              "examples": [
                "Suite 100",
                "Floor 3"
              ],
              "description": "Address line 2 (e.g., apartment, suite, unit, or building)."
            },
            "state": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "State",
              "examples": [
                "CA",
                "NY",
                "BE"
              ],
              "description": "State, county, province, or region (ISO 3166-2 subdivision code without country prefix, e.g., 'NY', 'TX')."
            },
            "country": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Country",
              "examples": [
                "US",
                "DE",
                "GB"
              ],
              "description": "Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)."
            },
            "postal_code": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Postal Code",
              "examples": [
                "94105",
                "10115"
              ],
              "description": "ZIP or postal code."
            }
          },
          "description": "The address of the business location (required when specifying head_office).",
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      },
      "description": "The place where your business is located for tax purposes.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating Stripe Tax Settings."
}
```

```json
        },

          "type": "object",
          "title": "Defaults",

            "provider"
          ],
          "properties": {

              "type": "string",

            },
            "tax_code": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Tax Code",
              "description": "Classification code for products and pricing."
            },
            "tax_behavior": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Tax Behavior",
              "description": "Whether pricing includes or excludes taxes. Values: 'exclusive' (taxes calculated on top of line item amount), 'inclusive' (taxes included in line item amount), 'inferred_by_currency' (Stripe determines treatment based on currency)."
            }
          },
          "description": "Default configuration applied to Stripe Tax calculations."
        },
        "livemode": {
          "type": "boolean",

        },

                },

                },
                "postal_code": {
```

**Input schema:**
```json

          "title": "Line2",

            "Apt 4B"
```

## STRIPE_UPDATE_TERMINAL_READER
Tool to update a Terminal Reader object by setting parameter values. Use when you need to modify the label or metadata of an existing reader device.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateTerminalReaderRequest",
  "required": [
    "reader"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "label": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Label",
      "examples": [
        "Updated Test Reader",
        "Front Desk Reader"
      ],
      "description": "Custom label name for the reader to help distinguish it from other readers. Use this to set a friendly name."
    },
    "reader": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reader",
      "examples": [
        "tmr_GUdgOws6gw46M7",
        "tmr_FDOt2wlRZEdpd7"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the Terminal Reader to update. Must start with 'tmr_' followed by alphanumeric characters."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        {
          "store_id": "12345",
          "test_key": "test_value"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.       }
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for updating a terminal reader."
}
```

## STRIPE_VALIDATE_PAYMENT_METHOD_DOMAIN
Tool to validate an existing payment method domain in Stripe to activate payment methods. Use when additional registration steps need to be completed before a payment method can be used in Elements or Embedded Checkout.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ValidatePaymentMethodDomainRequest",
  "required": [
    "payment_method_domain"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "payment_method_domain": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Payment Method Domain",
      "examples": [
        "pmd_1ShRUjQvM72TjFrbBqaUJtO0"
      ],
      "description": "The payment method domain identifier to validate (e.g., pmd_1Nnrer2eZvKYlo2Cips79tWl)."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for validating a payment method domain."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json

  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "StatusDetails": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "StatusDetails",
      "required": [
```

## STRIPE_VERIFY_MICRODEPOSITS
Verifies microdeposits on a SetupIntent object to confirm bank account ownership. Use when customer needs to verify their bank account using either amounts or descriptor code from microdeposits.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "VerifyMicrodepositsRequest",
  "required": [
    "setup_intent_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "amounts": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "integer"
      },
      "title": "Amounts",
      "examples": [
        [
          32,
          45
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Two positive integers, in cents, equal to the values of the microdeposits sent to the bank account. Provide this OR descriptor_code."
    },
    "descriptor_code": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Descriptor Code",
      "examples": [
        "SM11AA"
      ],
      "description": "A six-character code starting with SM present in the microdeposit sent to the bank account. Provide this OR amounts."
    },
    "setup_intent_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Setup Intent Id",
      "examples": [
        "seti_1ShW1TQvM72TjFrbM619nvfU"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the SetupIntent to verify microdeposits for."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for verifying microdeposits on a SetupIntent."
}
```

## STRIPE_VERIFY_MICRODEPOSITS_PAYMENT_INTENT
Verifies microdeposits on a PaymentIntent object by matching deposit amounts or descriptor code. Use after microdeposits are sent to complete bank account verification.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "VerifyMicrodepositsPaymentIntentRequest",
  "required": [
    "intent"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "intent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Intent",
      "examples": [
        "pi_3ShVrpQvM72TjFrb1BAg9jDt"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the PaymentIntent to verify microdeposits for."
    },
    "amounts": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "integer"
      },
      "title": "Amounts",
      "examples": [
        [
          32,
          45
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Two positive integers, in cents, equal to the values of the microdeposits sent to the bank account. Used to verify account ownership by matching the deposit amounts. Either amounts or descriptor_code must be provided, but not both."
    },
    "descriptor_code": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Descriptor Code",
      "examples": [
        "SM11AA"
      ],
      "description": "A six-character code starting with SM present in the microdeposit sent to the bank account. This is an alternative verification method to using amounts. Either amounts or descriptor_code must be provided, but not both."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for verifying microdeposits on a PaymentIntent."
}
```

## STRIPE_VOID_CREDIT_NOTE
Marks a credit note as void. Use when you need to void a credit note and reverse its adjustments.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "VoidCreditNoteRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "cn_1ShVoeQvM72TjFrbADJWTHBR"
      ],
      "description": "The identifier of the credit note to void. Typically starts with 'cn_'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for voiding a credit note."
}
```

## STRIPE_VOID_INVOICE
Tool to void a finalized Stripe invoice. Use when you need to mark an invoice as uncollectible while maintaining a paper trail. Voiding an invoice is permanent and cannot be undone. Only finalized invoices can be voided; draft invoices should be deleted instead.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "VoidInvoiceRequest",
  "required": [
    "invoice_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "invoice_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Invoice Id",
      "examples": [
        "in_1ShW0SQvM72TjFrbczI7Yv6W",
        "in_1MtGmCLkdIwHu7ix6PgS6g8S"
      ],
      "description": "The identifier of the invoice to void. Must be a finalized invoice. Draft invoices should be deleted instead of voided."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for voiding a finalized invoice."
}
```
